questions.exp: Nagar ushma dweep sabse zyada raat me viksit hota hai. Shahar ke kendriya kshetra ki hawa aas-paas ke gramin kshetra se garm rehti hai – oonchi imaratein-sadkein din ki garmi sokhkar raat me chhodti hain, ped kam, vahan-AC se garmi.

questions.q: Which of the following is the driving force behind Mass Wasting?
questions.exp: Vrihad kshran (mass wasting) ki pramukh prerak shakti gurutvakarshan hai – chattano ke chure/malbe ka samoohik roop se dhaal ke neeche sarakna; vayu-jal-hime bhi prabhav dalte hain par mukhya bal gurutva hai.

questions.q: Lorenz curve is linear expression of which of the following measurement?
questions.exp: Lorenz vakra prasar/apkiran (dispersion) maap ki rekhiya abhivyakti hai. Max Lorenz ke naam par; kisi shreni ke apkiran ko aalekhi vidhi se dikhane ka tarika.

questions.q: The book 'A New Soviet Heartland' is related to who among the following?
questions.exp: 'A New Soviet Heartland' (1964) David Hooson ki pustak hai – Mackinder ke heartland model ko Soviet sandarbh me punarparibhashit kiya. Cohen ki 'Geography and Politics in a Divided World' (1973); Seversky ki 'Victory Through Air Power' (1942).

questions.q:
Arrange the following straits of Indian Ocean from East to west.
I. Malacca Strait II. Bab-el-Mandep III. Strait of Hormuz IV. Palk Strait
questions.exp: Poorv se paschim: Malacca → Palk → Hormuz → Bab-el-Mandeb. Malacca – Malay prayadweep aur Sumatra ke beech; Palk – Bharat aur Shri Lanka; Hormuz – Oman aur Faras ki khadi; Bab-el-Mandeb – Adan ki khadi aur Lal sagar.

questions.q: Which of the following diagram is best for showing trends over time?
questions.exp: Samay ke saath pravritti dikhane ke liye rekha aalekh (line graph) sabse achha hai – jaise rajyon me prati vyakti aay ke aankde.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Loss of earth crust occurs in the convergence zone of plate.
Reason (R): The subduction of heavy plate occurs in the Benioff zone.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Abhisaran mandal me bhaari plate Benioff zone me halki plate ke neeche subduct hoti hai, isliye bhoo-parpati ka kshay hota hai; jwalamukhi, gehre bhookamp, valit parvat, gart bante hain. Book note: aayog ne pehle (a) maana, sahi uttar (b).

questions.q: Who among the following said that 'Regions are shorthand way of describing the variable character of an area in an efficient manner'?
questions.exp: Ye kathan Peter Haggett ka hai. Haggett ki pustakein: Locational Analysis in Human Geography (1965), Geography – A Modern Synthesis (1975); unhone geography me ganitiya-sankhyiki vidhiyon aur model nirmaan me yogdan diya.

questions.q:
Which of the following is/are a vector file format for spatial data?
a. MDB b. TAB c. DLG d. PNG
o: All a, b, c and d
questions.exp: MDB, TAB aur DLG vector file format hain; PNG raster/chhavi format hai. Vector model bindu, rekha, bahubhuj se vastu ki aakriti-sthiti dikhata hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following gasses is not the cause of urban smog?
questions.exp: Carbon monoxide nagariya dhoom kohre (smog) ka kaaran nahi. NOx, SO₂ aur ozone smog banate hain. 'Smog' shabd Dr. Henry Antoine Des Voeux ne 1905 me diya; dhuan + kohra; sooraj ki roshni me rasayanik kriya se ozone banta hai.

questions.q: The halo formed around the moon at night is caused by:
questions.exp: Chandrama ke charon or prabhamandal (halo) pakshabh aur pakshabh stari (cirrus/cirrostratus) meghon se banta hai – safed, patli doodhiya chadar; ye nikat bhavishya me chakravat aane ka sanket bhi.

questions.q: Which region in Puranas is referred to as Shalmali Dwipa?
questions.exp: Puranon me Shalmali dweep Poorvi Africa ko kaha gaya. Puranon me prithvi saat dweepon me: Jambu, Plaksha, Shalmali, Kusha, Krauncha, Shaka, Pushkar – sab Meru parvat (Pamir) ke charon or.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Local Wind) with List-II (Country/Region):
(A) Harmattan (B) Haboob (C) Bora (D) Zonda
i. Argentina ii. Adriatic Coast iii. West Africa iv. Sudan
questions.exp: Harmattan – Paschim Africa; Haboob – Sudan; Bora – Adriatic tat; Zonda – Argentina.

questions.q: Which type of vegetation is Same times called Sclerophyllous forest?
questions.exp: Bhoomadhya sagariya jhadiyon ko sclerophyll van kehte hain – patte mote, kathor; tane ki chhal moti; garmi ki shushkta sehne ke liye anukoolit. Sthaniya naam: Europe me maquis/macchia, California me chaparral, dakshin Africa me fynbos.

questions.q: Which of the following Indian Geographer is known for his work on regional development and rural planning?
questions.exp: G.S. Gosal pradeshik vikas aur gramin niyojan par kaam ke liye jaane jaate hain (krishi bhugol me bhi yogdan). R.P. Mishra kshetriy niyojan ke liye; S.P. Chatterjee bhautik bhugol aur bhaugolik vibhajan ke liye. Book note: aayog ne pehle (a) maana, sahi (d).

questions.q:
Match List-I (Techniques) with List-II (Digital Image Processing):
(A) De-Striping (B) Histogram Equalisation (C) NDVI (D) Maximum Likelihood
i. Image enhancement ii. Image classification iii. Radiometric correction iv. Image transformation
questions.exp: De-striping – radiometric sanshodhan; histogram equalisation – chhavi udbhavan; NDVI – chhavi roopantaran; maximum likelihood – chhavi vargikaran.

questions.q: Which of the following is not correctly matched? (Tribes – Race)
questions.exp: Dinaric – 'Secondary Negroid' galat hai; book ke anusaar Dinaric uttarvarti Caucasoid hain. Baaki sahi: American Indian – Mongoloid, Vedda – Caucasoid (Indo-Dravid), Bushman-Hottentot – Negroid.

questions.q: Which one of the following books is not related to Ptolemy?
questions.exp: 'Geographica' Strabo ka granth hai (Eratosthenes ne bhi likha), Ptolemy ka nahi. Ptolemy ki pustakein: Almagest, Geographia (Geographike Syntaxis), Analemma, Planetary Hypothesis.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The areas where warm and cold ocean currents meet, are the major fishing areas of the world.
Reason (R): The temperature of water of the area where warm and cold ocean currents meet, is most suitable for the breeding of fishes.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Garm aur thandi dharaon ke milan sthal par jal ka taapmaan machhliyon ke prajanan ke liye anukool, plankton badhta hai – Grand Banks, Dogger Bank jaise pramukh matsya kshetra. Book note: aayog ne (d) maana, sahi (b).

questions.q: Which is the most abundant pelagic deposit found in the Indian Ocean?
questions.exp: Hind mahasagar me sabse adhik pelagic nikshep Globigerina ooze hai – choona pradhan; ~64% calcium. Pelagic Greek 'pelagos' (samudra) se. Ye 2000–4000 fathom tak; Hind mahasagar ke poorvi aur paschimi bhaag tatha paschimi Prashant me.

questions.q: Katabatic wind is:
questions.exp: Katabatic pawan adho-dhaal (down slope) pawan hai – raat me parvatiya dhalon par vikiran se hawa thandi-bhaari hokar ghatiyon me utarti hai; ghatiyon me taap pratilomana aur pala.

questions.q: Who among the following proposed the concentric zone model of urban development?
questions.exp: Sankendriya kshetra model Ernest Burgess (1925) ka hai. Nagar 5 karyatmak pattiyon me: CBD, sankraman kshetra, swatantra shramikon ka aavas, behtar aavas, abhigaman (commuter) kshetra.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Oceanic Features) with List-II (Location):
(A) Mid Atlantic Ridge (B) Mariana Trench (C) Great barrier Reef (D) Java Trench
i. Indian Ocean ii. Atlantic Ocean iii. Pacific Ocean iv. Coral Sea
questions.exp: Mid-Atlantic Ridge – Atlantic; Mariana Trench – Prashant; Great Barrier Reef – Coral Sea; Java Trench – Hind mahasagar.

questions.q: Who supported that 'the geographical distribution of man depends on climate and weather more than any other factor'?
questions.exp: Ye vichar Ellsworth Huntington ka hai – manav ka bhaugolik vitaran kisi bhi anya kaarak se zyada jalvayu aur mausam par nirbhar. Huntington paristhitikivaadi aur jalvayu vaigyanik; Ratzel ne 'Anthropogeographie' shabd diya.

questions.q:
Arrange the following from South to North Sequence.
I. Pirpanjal range II. Zanskar range III. Greater Himalayas IV. Ladakh range
questions.exp: Dakshin se uttar: Pir Panjal → Mahan Himalaya → Zaskar → Ladakh. Himalaya me teen samantar shreniyan – Shivalik, Laghu (Pir Panjal), Mahan; trans-Himalaya me Zaskar, Ladakh, Kailash, Karakoram.

questions.q: Which one of the following methods is used to identify spatial pattern of a geographical data?
questions.exp: Bhaugolik aankdon ke sthaniya pratiroop ki pehchan nearest neighbour vishleshan se hoti hai – Clark aur Evans (1954). Basti vitaran ke aakaar-antaran ke vishleshan ke liye; Rn = vastavik ausat doori / prayashit ausat doori.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Coastal odisha is highly cyclone prone area of India.
Reason (R): Mangrove trees do not get uprooted by storms and tides because of their extensive roots.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi par (R) sahi vyakhya nahi. Odisha tat chakravat pravan hai kyunki Bangal ki khadi me chakravat (10–15°N) bante hain; mangrove ki faili jadein toofan-jwaar se ukhadti nahi aur chakravat ka prabhav kam karti hain, par ye chakravat pravanata ka kaaran nahi.

questions.q: Who is the author of book 'The Pulse of Asia'?
questions.exp: 'The Pulse of Asia' Ellsworth Huntington ki pustak hai. Anya pustakein: Civilization and Climate, Principles of Human Geography, Climatic Changes, Earth and Sun, Mainsprings of Civilization.

questions.q: Which of the following States of India is called Molasses Basin?
questions.exp: Mizoram ko 'Molasses basin' kaha jata hai – mridul aur asangathit chattano se bana. Mizoram ke poorv me Myanmar, paschim me Bangladesh, uttar me Manipur, Assam aur Tripura.

questions.q: Which of the following is the minimum deviation method in crop combination analysis?
questions.exp: Fasal sanyojan me nyuntam vichalan vidhi Weaver (1954) ki hai – 'Crop Combination Regions in the Middle West USA'. Sootra me vichalan ke sthan par prasaran σ² = Σd²/n; Kikukazu Doi ne 1959 me ise sanshodhit kiya.

questions.q: Who put forth the idea of compage?
questions.exp: Compage ka vichar Whittlesey ne diya – pradesh ke jitne tatva, utne prakaar ke pradesh; tatvon ki samanta par aadharit pradesh ko compage kaha. Chaar shreniyan: ekal vishay, bahul vishay, sampoorn vishay aur vishisht pradesh (compage).

questions.q: According to 'Malthusian Theory' how does population growth compared to food supply?
o: Population growth geometrically and food supply grow arithmetically
Population growth arithmetically and food supply grow geometrically
questions.exp: Malthus ke anusaar jansankhya jyamitiya (1, 2, 4, 8, 16…) aur khadya aapoorti ankganitiya (1, 2, 3, 4…) roop se badhti hai. Rok na ho to har 25 saal me jansankhya dugni; 200 saal me 256 guna.

questions.q: If a central place system operates in a region under the K = 7 principle, what does this value represents is the context of Chrisataller's central place theory?
questions.exp: K = 7 prashasanik siddhant hai. Christaller ke teen siddhant: bazaar (K=3), yatayat (K=4), prashasan (K=7). K maan ek shreni se agli me kendron ki sankhya ka sthir anupaat.

questions.q: Which approach in geography studies how human perceive and interact with space?
questions.exp: Vyavaharik bhugol adhyayan karta hai ki manav sthan ko kaise samajhte hain aur usse kaise antarkriya karte hain – abhiruchi, aavashyakta, chetna, kshamta jaise manasik gun mahatvapurn.

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched? (Theories of urban morphology – Geographers)
questions.exp: Dhalan (gradient) siddhant J. Garrison ka nahi; book ke anusaar Davie, Peck, King, Hartshorne se juda. Sahi: khand siddhant – Hoyt; sankendriya – Burgess; bahunabhik – C.D. Harris (Harris & Ullman).

questions.q: According to the 2011 census, which of the following States has a better female literacy rate than Uttar Pradesh?
questions.exp: 2011 jangarna me Arunachal Pradesh ki mahila saksharta (57.7%) UP (57.2%) se behtar thi. Jharkhand 55.4%, Rajasthan 52.1%, Bihar 51.5%.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a resolution related to radar system?
questions.exp: Ground, azimuth aur range – teeno radar ke vibhedan hain, isliye uttar 'none of the above'. Range vibhedan prasar disha me; azimuth vibhedan radar beam ki chaudai par nirbhar.

questions.q:
Which of the following statement with reference to A.T. Mahan is/are correct?
1. He gave more importance to Air power than sea power.
2. His famous book is 'The life of Nelson'.
questions.exp: Sirf 2 sahi. Mahan ne samudri shakti ko vayu shakti se zyada mahatva diya (kathan 1 galat). Unki pustakein: 'The Influence of Sea Power upon History', 'The Life of Nelson', 'The Problem of Asia'. Unke anusaar samudri shakti hi vishwa prabhutva ka aadhar.

questions.q:
Arrange the following rivers in order from East to West:
1. Sutlej 2. Beas 3. Ravi 4. Chenab 5. Jhelum
questions.exp: Poorv se paschim: Sutlej → Beas → Ravi → Chenab → Jhelum. Sutlej Tibet me Mansarovar ke paas Rakas Tal se; Beas Rohtang ke paas Beas Kund se; Ravi Kullu pahadiyon se; Chenab Chandra-Bhaga ke milan se; Jhelum Verinag jharne se.

questions.q:
Which of the following ocean currents are found along coastline of Africa?
1. Humboldt current 2. Agulhas current 3. Canary current 4. Benguela current
questions.exp: Agulhas, Canary aur Benguela Africa ke tat par hain; Humboldt dakshin America ke paschimi tat ki thandi dhara (Peru dhara). Agulhas – Mozambique channel se dakshin; Canary – uttar-paschim Africa thandi; Benguela – dakshin-paschim Africa thandi.

questions.q:
With reference to Christaller's central place theory, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. Regions must be an isotropic plain with homogeneous purchasing power.
2. Christaller's theory is known as 'Fixed K' theory.
3. Christaller's theory is known as 'Variable K' theory
questions.exp: 1 aur 2 sahi. Pradesh samaan kray shakti wala samdesh maidan maana jata hai; har shreni me sthir K maan hone se ise 'Fixed K' siddhant kehte hain (Lösch ka 'variable K').

questions.q: Who coined the terms 'Spread effects' and 'backwash effects'?
questions.exp: 'Prasar prabhav' aur 'paschch pravah prabhav' shabd Gunnar Myrdal ne diye – sanchayi karanatmak siddhant (circular and cumulative causation). Vikasit kendra se pichhde kshetron me prasar ki tulna me backwash adhik hota hai.

questions.q: Edward Ullman's concept of spatial interaction was based on the economy of which country?
questions.exp: Ullman ki sthaniya antarkriya ki avdharna USA ki arthvyavastha par aadharit thi. Teen aadhar: poorakata (complementarity), madhyavarti avsar, sthanantaran yogyata (1956 ka lekh 'The role of transportation and the bases for interaction').

questions.q: Which geographer emphasized on the concept of 'unity of nature'?
questions.exp: 'Prakriti ki ekta' (unity of nature) ki avdharna Humboldt ki hai – prithvi ke jaivik-ajaivik tatva ek-doosre se jude aur prabhavit; isliye prithvi ka adhyayan samagra drishti se.

questions.q: 'Dykes' structure is associated with which of the following regions?
questions.exp: 'Dyke' sanrachna paschimi Maharashtra se sambandhit hai. Lava daraaron me jamkar deewar jaisi aakriti banata hai; paschimi Maharashtra ki antarvedhit aagneya chattano (Deccan trap) me ye aakriti bahutayat me milti hai.

questions.q: In which of the following ocean red clay deposition is widely found?
questions.exp: Laal mrittika (red clay) ka sarvadhik nikshep Prashant mahasagar me hai – ye mahasagaron ke lagbhag aadhe bhaag me failti hai; 40°N–40°S ke beech; lohe ke oxide aur aluminium silicate se banti hai; mukhyatah gehre saagar ka nikshep.

questions.q: Who was the proponent of the concept of 'Lebensraum'?
questions.exp: 'Lebensraum' (rehne ki jagah) ki sankalpana Friedrich Ratzel ki hai. Rajya ek jaivik avayav ki tarah badhta hai aur use rehne ki jagah chahiye; Ratzel ko rajneetik bhugol ka janak bhi kehte hain.

questions.q: Which of the following islands or countries do/does NOT belong to Norwegian Cultural realm?
questions.exp: Finland Norwegian sanskritik pradesh me nahi aata – Finno-Ugric bhasha parivar aur bhinn sanskritik prishthabhoomi ke kaaran. Denmark, Iceland, Norway, Sweden aur Arctic dweep (Svalbard) Scandinavian sanskritik virasat ka hissa.

questions.q: Spencer and Thomas have divided the world into how many cultural world and cultural realms?
questions.exp: Spencer aur Thomas ne vishwa ko 11 sanskritik vishwa aur 50 sanskritik parimandal me baanta – Anglo-America, Latin America, Paschimi Europe, Poorvi Europe-Soviet, Arab-Muslim, Africa, Dakshin Asia, Dakshin-Poorv Asia, Cheen, Australia, Prashant.

questions.q: The geography of 1990's and of subsequent period is included in which paradigm?
questions.exp: 1990 ke dashak aur baad ka bhugol uttar-adhunikvaad me aata hai – adhunikta ki pratikriya; satya, saundarya, naitikta saapeksh; vividhta, samajik upekshit vargon aur sthaniyata par zor.

questions.q: Which one of the following statements about the coriolis force is NOT correct?
o: It is absent at the equator
It is maximum at the pole
It deflects the wind to the right direction in the northern hemisphere
It deflects the winds to the right direction in the southern hemisphere
questions.exp: Coriolis bal dakshini golardh me hawa ko baayin or modta hai, daayin nahi – isliye (d) galat. Ye vishuvat par shoonya aur dhruvon par adhiktam; uttari golardh me daayin or. Ye pawan ke veg ko nahi, disha ko prabhavit karta hai.

questions.q: The altitude of GPS satellites in 'high orbit' is:
questions.exp: GPS upgrahon ki ucch kaksha ki oonchai lagbhag 20,200 km hai; parikrama kaal ~12 ghante. GPS (NAVSTAR) USA ne banaya; prithvi aur vayumandal me vastuon ke nauvahan ke liye.

questions.q: Which of the following local winds is called 'doctor'?
questions.exp: Harmattan ko 'doctor' kehte hain. Sahara se Guinea tat ki or chalne wali garm-shushk hawa; tat ki umas aur bimariyon se rahat deti hai, isliye Guinea tat par 'doctor pawan'.

questions.q: When is the balance between incoming solar radiation and outgoing terrestrial radiation usually marked?
questions.exp: Pravishti saur vikiran aur bahirgami parthiv vikiran me santulan aam taur par dopahar 2 se 4 baje ke beech hota hai – dopahar tak satah garm hoti rehti hai, 2–4 baje ke baad aane wala vikiran ghatne lagta hai. Book note: aayog ne (c) maana, sahi (a).

questions.q: Which of the following is the India's first zero waste airport?
o: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport Ahmedabad
questions.exp: Devi Ahilyabai Holkar hawai adda, Indore Bharat ka pehla shoonya apshisht (zero waste) hawai adda ghoshit hua – lagbhag 99% kachre ka landfill se bahar prabandhan; Indore ki svachhata ke saath.

questions.q:
Which of the following information can be used to calculate the air photo scale?
1. Flying height of the aircraft 2. Focal length of the camera 3. Speed of the aircraft 4. Ground principal point
questions.exp: Vayu photo ka maapak camera ki focal length (f) aur udaan oonchai (H) se nikalta hai: scale = f/H. Vimaan ki gati aur ground principal point maapak ke liye zaroori nahi.

questions.q: Which of the following rivers has the largest catchment area?
questions.exp: Inme Kaveri ka jalgrahan kshetra sabse bada (~81,155 km²). Tapi ~65,145 km², Subarnarekha ~29,196 km², Sabarmati ~21,674 km².

questions.q: Which one of the following pair is NOT correctly matched? (UP minerals)
questions.exp: Glass sand – Meerut galat; glass sand Prayagraj (aur Shankargarh) me. Sahi: choona patthar – Sonbhadra, tamba – Lalitpur, dolomite – Mirzapur.

questions.q: Who is the propounder of 'behaviour matrix'?
questions.exp: 'Vyavaharik matrix' Pred ne diya – vyakti ke nirnay ko gyan ki matra aur upyog kshamta ke aadhar par samjhaane ka model (Behavior and Location, 1967–69). Kirk – aacharanparak paryavaran.

questions.q: The gravity model of spatial interaction is related to:
questions.exp: Sthaniya antarkriya ka gurutva model John Q. Stewart se juda hai – Newton ke gurutvakarshan niyam par aadharit; do sthanon ke beech antarkriya unki jansankhya ke gunanfal ke anupaat me aur doori ke varg ke vyutkramanupaat me (1940 ke dashak).

questions.q: Non-oscillation ecological stability is?
o: Stability in the number of species in the ecosystem
A balance in the production and consumption of each element in ecosystem
The smooth functioning of all biogeo-chemical cycles and stable concentration of all elements
questions.exp: Dolanrahit (non-oscillation) paristhitik sthirata = paristhitik tantra me prajatiyon ki sankhya me sthirata. M.J. Dunbar (1973) ne ise ye naam diya – prajatiyon ki sankhya me utaar-chadhaav nahi.

questions.q:
Arrange the following regions in order of increasing population size.
(1) Eastern Africa (2) Middle Africa (3) Northern Africa (4) Southern Africa
questions.exp: Book ke aankde: dakshini Africa 6.8 crore, madhya 19 crore, uttari 25 crore, poorvi 44 crore – sahi badhta kram 4, 2, 3, 1 hai jo kisi vikalp me nahi. Aayog ne (d) maana; book ke anusaar koi vikalp sahi nahi (*).

questions.q: Which of the following scholars coined the term 'megalopolis'?
questions.exp: 'Megalopolis' (vrihannagar) shabd Jean Gottmann ne 1957 me diya – USA ke uttar-poorvi tat par Boston se Washington tak faile vishal nagariya kshetra ke liye. Mark Jefferson ne 1939 me 'primate city' diya.

questions.q: Where does the 'Alberta Low' cyclone originate?
o: On the North-East coast of North America
On the West coast of North America
In the eastern part of the Canadian Rocky mountains
questions.exp: 'Alberta Low' chakravat Canadian Rockies ke poorvi bhaag (Alberta) me banta hai – madhya akshanshiya chakravat; Prashant se aayi aardra hawaon ka Rockies par chadhkar poorv me utarna (downslope) neeche dabaav banata hai.

questions.q: 'The fringing reefs, barrier reefs and atolls are successive stages of the development of coral reefs.' It is explained in which theory?
questions.exp: Ye Darwin ka avtalan (subsidence) siddhant hai – 1837 me pratipadit, 1842 me sanshodhit. Praval sirf chhichhle saagar me jeevit; dweep ke dheere-dheere doobne se tateey → avrodhak → atoll.

questions.q: 'Golden quadrilateral' connects which four major cities of India?
questions.exp: Swarnim chaturbhuj Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai aur Kolkata ko jodta hai (6-lane). Iske saath North-South (Srinagar–Kanyakumari) aur East-West (Silchar–Porbandar) corridor; NHAI ke adhikaar kshetra me.

questions.q: Which of the following was NOT considered by Whittlesey as a basis for delimiting the agricultural regions of the world?
o: Land use capacity and production method
Combination of crop and livestock farming
questions.exp: Whittlesey ne jeevan star (quality of life) ko aadhar nahi maana. Unke 5 aadhar (1936): fasal-pashu sahcharya, bhoomi upyog ki gahanta, krishi utpad ka sansadhan-vipanan, mashinikaran ka star, krishi bhavan aur sanrachnayein. Inse vishwa ko 13 krishi pradesh.

questions.q: Which one of the source region for the formation of air masses?
o: Very cold snow covered continents in high altitudes
questions.exp: Vayuraashiyon ka udgam kshetra ucch akshanshon ke ati-thande himachhadit mahadweep hain – vishaal samtal, samroop satah jahan hawa lambe samay tak thahar kar taap-aardrata ke gun le leti hai. Pramukh: dhruviya mahadweepiya/mahasagariya, ushna katibandhiya mahadweepiya/mahasagariya, vishuvatiya, mansoon.

questions.q:
Arrange the following gases in the increasing order of their contribution to atmospheric composition.
1. Xenon 2. Hydrogen 3. Helium 4. Krypton
questions.exp: Book ka uttar: Xenon (0.000009) → Hydrogen (0.00005) → Krypton (0.00011) → Helium (0.0005), yani 1, 2, 4, 3.

questions.q:
Which of the following are correctly matched?
1. M.A. Busteed – Geography and voting behaviour 2. Mackinder – Democratic ideals and reality 3. Cohen – Geography of peace 4. Seversky – Air power: Key to survival
questions.exp: 1, 2 aur 4 sahi; 'Geography of the Peace' Spykman ki hai, Cohen ki nahi.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): River capture is the most characteristic feature of the juvenile stage of the normal cycle of erosion.
Reason (R): During the youthful stage, river's capture the water of other smaller streams through headward erosion.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Saamanya apardan chakra ki tarunavastha me nadiyan sheersh apardan (headward erosion) se doosri chhoti dharaon ka jal apharan kar leti hain – sarita apharan; apharan karne wali nadi 'apharak' aur jiska apharan hota hai 'apahrit'.

questions.q: In which of the following continents birth rate and death rate both are very high?
questions.exp: Africa me janam aur mrityu dar dono ucch hain – vikasshil-alpvikasit desh, chikitsa suvidha kam, kuposhan, sankramak rog; bal vivah, shiksha kami, parivar niyojan suvidha ka abhav.

questions.q: The concept of 'Paradigm' was propounded by:
questions.exp: 'Paradigm' ki avdharna Thomas S. Kuhn ki hai – 'The Structure of Scientific Revolutions' (1962); doosre sanskaran (1970) me paribhasha: kisi samuday ke sadasyon dwara saajhe vishwas, moolya, takneekon ka poorn punj.

questions.q: Calcareous ooze which is pelagic sea deposit found between 2000-4000 fathoms deep. It is called a:
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (c) Radiolarian ooze – 2000–4000 fathom par milne wala, radiolarian jeevon ke kankal se bana; Prashant me 5°–25° akshansh. Pteropod ooze 1500–2000 fathom tak; diatom 600–2000 fathom; laal mrittika 2700 fathom se adhik.

questions.q: Boundaries formed by mountains are:
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar parvaton se bani seemayein anuvarti (consequent) kehlati hain. Book ki vyakhya: poorvavarti (antecedent) seemayein wo hain jinka nirmaan maujooda sanskritik roop banne se pehle hua; avashisht (relict) wo jo ab kaam nahi karti.

questions.q:
Arrange the following Indian languages in increasing order of number of people speaking them and select the correct answer from the code given below.
(1) Oriya (2) Maithili (3) Assamese (4) Kashmiri
questions.exp: Badhta kram: Kashmiri (~68 lakh) → Maithili (~1.36 crore) → Assamese (~1.53 crore) → Oriya (~3.75 crore).

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs (Regional development model–scholar) is NOT correctly matched?
questions.exp: Input-output model W.W. Rostow ka nahi, W.W. Leontief ka hai; Rostow – aarthik vriddhi ki avasthayein. Baaki sahi.

questions.q: Which type of graph is mostly suitable for displaying the average monthly rainfall and temperature for a particular place?
questions.exp: Kisi sthan ke ausat masik taapmaan aur varsha dikhane ke liye hythergraph upyukt hai – taapmaan aur varsha ko koti-bhuj ke roop me plot karke 12 bindu jode jaate hain. Griffith Taylor ne climograph diya.

questions.q: According to UNEP (United Nations Environment Programme), the Aridity Index (A.I.) for semi-arid region are
questions.exp: UNEP ke anusaar ardh-shushk kshetra ka shushkata soochkank 0.20–0.50. Ati-shushk < 0.05, shushk 0.05–0.20, shushk upaardra 0.50–0.65.

questions.q:
Arrange the following elements in the descending order of their occurrence in the earth crust
1. Oxygen 2. Aluminium 3. Magnesium 4. Iron 5. Silicon
questions.exp: Ghatta kram: Oxygen (46.8%) > Silicon (27.72%) > Aluminium (8.13%) > Iron (5.00%) > Magnesium (2.09%).

questions.q: The term 'Horst' and 'Graben' are associated with which of the following tectonic features?
questions.exp: Horst aur graben bhransh ghati (rift valley) ke vivartanik lakshan hain – bhranshan se kuch khand oopar uthte (horst) aur kuch neeche dhanste (graben); do samantar bhransh ke beech ka bhaag dhanse to rift valley.

questions.q: Who firstly propounded the theory of 'Mantle plume'?
questions.exp: Mantle plume siddhant sabse pehle J. Tuzo Wilson ne 1963 me diya; W. Jason Morgan ne 1971 me vistaar kiya. ~2900 km gehrai par core-mantle seema se garm padarth oopar uthkar hotspot banata hai – jwalamukhi kriya ka srot.

questions.q: Which is NOT a quantitative method of the regional delineation?
questions.exp: Maanchitra par adhyaropan (overlapping) vidhi matratmak nahi hai. Haggett ki chaar matratmak vidhiyan: Thiessen bahubhuj, doori nyuntamikaran, vishishtikaran pradarshak vishleshan, graph siddhant.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Despite its high altitude the North sea has high salinity.
Reason (R): The Gulf stream adds salinity to the North sea.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Ucch akshansh par hote hue bhi Uttari sagar me lavanta adhik hai kyunki Gulf Stream yahan khara garm jal laati hai; Atlantic ki khule saagar se jude hone se bhi.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Social structure influences voting pattern.
Reason (R): Many scholars have analyzed the influence of socio-economic factors on voting patterns.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi par (R) sahi vyakhya nahi. Matdan pratiroop par samajik sanrachna ka prabhav padta hai (praant, varg, jaati, dharm); Krehbiel ne 1885–1910 ke chunavon par paryavaran-samajik prabhav ka adhyayan kiya. (R) sirf ye batata hai ki vidwanon ne vishleshan kiya.

questions.q:
According to E.W. Burgess, urban expansion occurs in concentric belts around the urban centre. The correct order of the zones is from the centre outwards:
I. Central Business District II. Zone of Transition III. Zone of independent working men's houses IV. Zone of better residence V. The commuter's zone
questions.exp: Burgess (1925) ke anusaar kram: CBD → sankraman kshetra → swatantra shramikon ke aavas → behtar aavas → abhigaman (commuter) kshetra.

questions.q: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Mango shower – Kerala and Coastal areas of Karnataka
Blossom shower – Kerala and nearby areas
questions.exp: Bardoli Chheerha Assam se juda hai, Punjab se nahi. Kalbaisakhi – Assam aur paschim Bangal; aam varsha – Kerala aur tateey Karnataka; phoolon wali bauchhar – Kerala aur aas-paas.

questions.q: Which one of the earthquake waves is more destructive?
questions.exp: Dharatleey (surface/L) tarangein sabse vinashkari hain – inka veg kam par aayam aur avadhi zyada; prithvi ki satah ke sahare chalti hain, imaratein girti hain. P aur S tarangein pehle pahunchti hain.

questions.q:
Arrange the following oceans in the decreasing order of their percentage of continental shelf areas.
1. Indian ocean 2. Atlantic ocean 3. Pacific ocean
questions.exp: Mahadweepiya magntat ke pratishat ka ghatta kram: Atlantic (13.3%) > Prashant (5.7%) > Hind (4.2%). Magntat mahadweep ka jalmagn kinara – ~100 fathom gehra, dhaal 1°–3°, ausat chaudai ~48 km.

questions.q:
Arrange the following in terms of increasing albedo.
1. Forest 2. Water 3. Sand 4. Snow cover
questions.exp: Albedo ka badhta kram: jal (3–5%) < van (5–10%) < ret (20–30%) < him aavaran (70–90%). Albedo = satah se paravartit vikiran ka pratishat.

questions.q: Which one of the following is most effective factor of coral bleaching?
o: Rise in normal temperature of ocean water
questions.exp: Praval viranjan ka sabse prabhavi kaarak samudri jal ke saamanya taapmaan me vriddhi hai – zooxanthellae shaival bahar nikal jaate hain, praval safed. 1997–98 me ~2°C vriddhi se 60 se adhik deshon me bade paimane par viranjan.

questions.q: In a food chain, what percentage of energy is transferred from one trophic level to next trophic level?
questions.exp: Ek poshan star se agle star tak lagbhag 10% urja jaati hai (Lindeman ka 10% niyam); baaki shvasan aur upapachay me kho jaati hai, isliye aahar shrinkhala chhoti hoti hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Economy) with List-II (Activities):
(A) Primary (B) Secondary (C) Tertiary (D) Quaternary
1. Mining 2. Manufacturing 3. Information based 4. Financial Banking
questions.exp: Prathamik – khanan; dwitiyak – vinirmaan; tritiyak – vittiya banking; chaturthak – soochna aadharit.

questions.q: 'Inca culture' is associated with which of the following region?
o: Inaccessible mountainous region on the western coast of South America
questions.exp: Inca sanskriti dakshin America ke paschimi tateey durgam parvatiya kshetra (Andes) se sambandhit hai – ~3000 BC Peru me sabhyata; 14–15vi sadi me charam; Huari aur Tiahuanaco samrajya poorvagaami.

questions.q: Which of the following maps accurately display the distribution of population data?
questions.exp: Bindukit (dot) maanchitra jansankhya vitaran ko sabse sahi dikhata hai – har bindu ek nishchit sankhya; vitaran ke vaastavik sthan dikhte hain. Choropleth – ghanatva/dar; isopleth – taapmaan, varsha aadi.

questions.q: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
o: The amount of energy lost through respiration increases with increasing trophic levels
Species with increasing trophic level are most efficient at utilizing available energy
Higher trophic levels tend to be less discrete than the lower ones
Food chain usually try to be large
questions.exp: Aahar shrinkhala aam taur par chhoti hoti hai, badi nahi – isliye (d) galat. Har agle star par urja ka bada bhaag shvasan me kho jaata hai, isliye 4–5 star se zyada sambhav nahi.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a Geo-Bio-Chemical cycle?
questions.exp: Ozone chakra bhoo-jaiv-rasayan chakra nahi hai. Ajaivik tatvon ka jaivik aur phir ajaivik avastha me aana-jaana bhoo-jaiv-rasayan chakra hai – hydrogen, carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulphur, jaliya, khanij chakra.

questions.q: Russel and Kniffen divided the world into how many cultural world?
questions.exp: Russell aur Kniffen ne vishwa ko 7 sanskritik vishwa me baanta ('Culture Worlds', 1951): dhruviya, Europiya, America, shushk, prachya (Asiai), Africa, Prashant.

questions.q: According to Weber, the most important factor in locating a factory is:
questions.exp: Weber ke anusaar kaarkhane ki avasthiti me sabse mahatvapurn kaarak parivahan laagat hai. Pustak 'Über den Standort der Industrien' (1909); pehle nyuntam parivahan laagat bindu, phir shram aur ekatrikaran ka prabhav.

questions.q: Which of the following in India is NOT associated with production of coal?
questions.exp: Bailadila lauh ayask utpadan se juda hai, koyle se nahi (Chhattisgarh). Bokaro, Giridih, Karanpura (Jharkhand) koyla kshetra; Damodar ghati me desh ka ~80% koyla.

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched? (Landform – Process)
questions.exp: Inselberg – bhoomijal galat; inselberg pawan/apakshay se banta hai. Sahi: himod – himnadi, canyon – nadi, zeugen – pawan.

questions.q:
Arrange the following remote sensing platforms/sensors in order of increasing spatial resolution.
1. Geo Eye-I (Pan) 2. IRS (Pan) 3. NOAA 4. IKONOS (MS)
questions.exp: Sthaniya vibhedan ka badhta kram: NOAA (1.1 km) → IRS Pan (5.8 m) → IKONOS MS (4.0 m) → GeoEye-1 (0.41 m).

questions.q: Which of the following geographers has given first the concept of 'Social Darwinism'?
questions.exp: 'Samajik Darwinvaad' ki sankalpana sabse pehle Friedrich Ratzel ne di – 'Anthropogeographie' me Darwin ke vikasvaad jaisa vichar manav samaj par lagaya; Bernhard Varenius aur Kant ko aadhunik bhugol ka sansthapak maana jata hai.

questions.q: Altering the boundaries of a constituency in order to benefit a particular political party. Which of the following terms is used for this?
questions.exp: Gerrymandering – nirvachan kshetra ki seemayein badalna taaki kisi dal ko laabh mile. Shabd Massachusetts ke Governor Elbridge Gerry ke naam par; vipaksh ke samarthak kuch kshetron me kendrit kar diye jaate hain.

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
questions.exp: Isoneph samaan megh (cloud) ki rekha hai, him (snow) ki nahi – isliye (b) galat. Isocline – samaan dhaal; isohel – samaan dhoop; isobar – samaan dabaav.

questions.q:
Arrange the following seas and lakes in increasing order of their salinity.
(1) Dead Sea (2) Lake Von of Turkey (3) Caspian Sea (4) Great Salt Lake
questions.exp: Lavanta ka badhta kram: Caspian sagar → Great Salt Lake → Mrit sagar → Lake Van. Book ke aankde: Caspian ~14–17‰, Great Salt Lake ~220‰, Dead Sea ~238‰, Lake Van ~330‰.

questions.q: The functional aspect of an ecosystem mainly refers to
questions.exp: Paristhitik tantra ka karyatmak pahlu mukhyatah urja pravah hai – tantra ki karyakshamata urja pravah aur poshak padarthon ke chakran par nirbhar; urja ek disha me bahti hai, padarth chakriya margon se.

questions.q: The 'Tidal bores' of which of the following rivers is known as 'Pororoca'?
questions.exp: Amazon nadi ki jwarbhitti 'Pororoca' kehlati hai. Amazon Peru ke Andes se nikalkar ~6450 km behti hai; jwar ka asar 1600 km andar tak; muhane ke paas Marajó dweep.

questions.q: Which of the following geographers coined the term 'Geopolitics'?
questions.exp: 'Geopolitics' shabd Rudolf Kjellén (Swedish) ne diya – rajya ko bhaugolik jeev/sthaniya parighatna ke roop me; unke baad Haushofer ne German bhoo-rajneeti ko aage badhaya.

questions.q: Which one of the following pair is NOT correctly matched?
questions.exp: Jean Gottmann – 'Megalopolis' hai, 'Metropolis' nahi – isliye (c) galat. Edge city – Joel Garreau; world city – Patrick Geddes; core-periphery – John Friedmann.

questions.q: If the correlation coefficient (r) is + 0.9 what does this indicate?
questions.exp: r = +0.9 ucch dhanatmak sahsambandh dikhata hai. r ka maan –1 se +1 ke beech; 0 = koi sambandh nahi; +1 = poorn dhanatmak; –1 = poorn rinatmak.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a rapid type of mass movement?
questions.exp: Mridaprarpan (solifluction) teevra prakaar ka vrihad sanchalan nahi, mand gati ka hai. Teevra: avpatan (rock fall), bhooskhalan, mud flow, rock slump; mand: soil creep, solifluction, talus creep.

questions.q: Which of the following regions comes under Mediterranean type of climate?
questions.exp: Madhya Chile bhoomadhya sagariya jalvayu me aata hai. Ye jalvayu 30°–40° akshansh ke beech mahadweepon ke paschimi bhaag me – Rum sagar ke charon or, California, Chile, dakshin Africa ka Cape, dakshin-paschim Australia.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Steel Plant) with List-II (Nearest Iron ore mine/Region):
(A) Bhilai Steel plant (B) Rourkela Steel Plant (C) Vijaynagar Steel Plant (D) Salem Steel Plant
1. Salem 2. Hospet 3. Barsua 4. Dhalli-Rajhara
questions.exp: Bhilai – Dalli-Rajhara; Rourkela – Barsua; Vijayanagar – Hospet; Salem – Salem.

questions.q: In which stage of the demographic transition model, the population growth is highest?
questions.exp: Jansankhyiki sankraman ki doosri avastha (prarambhik vardhaman) me jansankhya vriddhi sabse zyada – janam dar ucch rehti hai par mrityu dar tez girti hai. Notestein (1945) ne siddhant ko roop diya; chaar avasthayein: ucch sthir, prarambhik vardhaman, uttar vardhaman, nimn sthir.

questions.q: Which one of the following term describes the position of a species within an ecosystem, comprising species habitat requirements as well as its functional role?
questions.exp: Ecological niche – paristhitik tantra me prajati ki sthiti, uski aavas zarooratein aur karyatmak bhoomika. Avdharna J. Grinnell (1917); Charles Elton (1927) ne vikas kiya. Ecotone – do tantron ke beech sankraman kshetra.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Books) with List-II (Authors):
(A) Radical Geography (B) Regional Geography (C) Human Geography-A Welfare Approach (D) Problems of Geography
1. W. Kirk 2. D.M. Smith 3. R. Peet 4. R. Minshull
questions.exp: Radical Geography – R. Peet; Regional Geography – R. Minshull; Human Geography: A Welfare Approach – D.M. Smith; Problems of Geography – W. Kirk.

questions.q: Who among the following geographers laid the foundation of the dichotomy of 'General Vs Special Geography'?
questions.exp: 'Saamanya banam vishesh bhugol' ke dvait ki neev Bernhard Varenius ne rakhi – saamanya bhugol me vishwa ke saamanya siddhant aur niyam; vishesh/pradeshik me pradeshon ke vishisht swaroop. Kant ko 'aaram kursi wala bhugolvetta' kaha gaya.

questions.q: On which of the following does the effect of the weathering is most slow?
questions.exp: Granite par apakshay ka prabhav sabse dheema hota hai; khandit chattanon, sangmarmar aur lohe par tez. Mausam ki vibhinn kriyaon se chattanon ka toot-foot apakshay kehlata hai.

questions.q:
Oozes are broadly classified as siliceous and calcareous ooze. Choose the siliceous ooze from the following.
1. Diatom 2. Radiolarian 3. Pteropod 4. Foraminifera
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (d) – diatom, radiolarian aur foraminifera ko silica pradhan maana. Book: silica ansh adhik hone se silica yukt ooze; choone ke kaaran calcareous; pteropod choona pradhan, diatom ooze atyant sookshm paudhon se.

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched? (Instrument – Use)
o: Opisometer – Measurement of distance on map
Planimeter – Measurement of area on map
questions.exp: Nanometer pawan veg maapne ka yantra nahi – ye lambai ki atyant sookshm ikai hai; pawan veg anemometer se. Opisometer – maanchitra par doori; planimeter – kshetrafal; barometer – vayudaab.

questions.q:
निम्नलिखित में से आग्नेय चट्टानों के बारे में कौन से कथन सही हैं?
1. आग्नेय चट्टानों का निर्माण पिघले हुए मैग्मा के ठण्डा होने, जमने एवं रवा बनने की प्रक्रिया के फलस्वरूप हुआ है।
2. आग्नेय चट्टानों में अवसादी चट्टानों की तरह परतें नहीं होतीं परन्तु पेड़-पौधों और जीवों के जीवाश्म पाए जाते हैं।
3. सभी आग्नेय चट्टानें प्रारम्भिक भूवैज्ञानिक इतिहास में निर्मित हुईं एवं वर्तमान में आग्नेय चट्टानों के निर्माण की प्रक्रिया बंद हो गयी है।
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar aagneya chattanein magma ke thanda hokar jamne aur rawa banne se banti hain; prithvi ki sabse pehli chattan yahi thi, isliye inhe 'prathamik' ya 'paitrik' chattan bhi kehte hain – baaki (avsadi, roopantarit) chattanon ka aadhar. Magma satah par aakar tezi se thanda ho to rawe bahut baarik (jaise basalt); bheetar dheere-dheere thanda ho to bade rawe (jaise granite). Book ne vikalp (b) – kathan 1 aur 2 – sahi maana; kathan 3 galat kyunki aagneya chattanon ka banna aaj bhi jaari hai (jwalamukhi).

questions.q: स्थान, जहाँ भूकम्पीय घटना का सर्वप्रथम अनुभव किया जाता है, ......... कहलाता है।
questions.exp: Book: bhookamp aane se pehle vayumandal me 'Radon' gas ki matra badh jaati hai, isliye kisi pradesh me is gas ka badhna bhookamp ka sanket hai. Jis jagah bhookampiya tarangein utpann hoti hain wo 'bhookamp mool' (focus/kendra) hai; satah par uske theek upar ka bindu jahan sabse pehle kampan mahsoos hota hai 'adhikendra' (epicentre) kehlata hai.

questions.q: मोहोरोविकिक असम्बद्धता ......... के मध्य स्थित है।
questions.exp: Book: crust ke nichle aadhar par bhookampiya tarangon ki gati achanak badh jaati hai – nichli crust me P ki gati ~6.9 km/s, crust ke aadhar par ~7.9 se 8.1 km/s. Isse nichli crust aur oopari mantle ke beech asambaddhata banti hai, jiski khoj A. Mohorovičić ne 1909 me ki – isliye Moho asambaddhata. Prithvi ki asambaddhatayein: Conrad (oopari–nichli crust), Moho (nichli crust–oopari mantle), Repetti (oopari–nichla mantle), Gutenberg (nichla mantle–bahya core), Lehmann (bahya–aantarik core).

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने पर्वत निर्माण का तापीय संकुचन सिद्धांत प्रस्तावित किया?
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar parvat nirmaan ke pramukh siddhant: taapiya sankuchan siddhant – Jeffreys; mahadweepiya fislan – Daly; sanvahan tarang – Holmes; taapiya chakra/radioactivity – Joly; bhoosanati (geosyncline) – Kober. Jeffreys ka siddhant prithvi ke thande hokar sikudne ke itihaas par aadharit hai.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए एवं नीचे दिए गए कूट से सही उत्तर चुनिए:
सूची-I (घटक): A. नदी जल B. हिमनद C. भूमिगत जल D. पवन
सूची-II (स्थलाकृति): 1. ज्यूजेन 2. ड्रमलिन 3. गोखुर झील 4. लैपीज
कूट (1 2 3 4 के सामने अक्षर):
questions.exp: Book ka sahi sumelan: nadi jal – gokhur jheel; himnad – drumlin; bhoomigat jal – lapies; pawan – zeugen. Dhyan do: is sumelan ke hisaab se kod '1-D, 2-B, 3-A, 4-C' banna chahiye, jo kisi vikalp me nahi hai; book ne uttar (b) diya hai.

questions.q: जब तीव्र दबाव के कारण वलन की दोनों भुजाएँ एक दूसरे के सामानान्तर एवं क्षैतिज अवस्था में आ जाता है, तो परिणामस्वरूप बना वलन कहलाता है:
questions.exp: Book: jab kshaitij sanchalan atyadhik teevra ho to sampeedan bhi bahut adhik hota hai aur valan ki dono bhujaein aapas me samanantar hokar kshaitij disha me ho jaati hain – ise parivalan (shayan valan / recumbent fold) kehte hain.

questions.q: ज्वालामुखी क्रिया के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: 80 प्रतिशत ज्वालामुखी अभिसारी प्लेट सीमाओं पर मिलते हैं।
पीलियन तुल्य ज्वालामुखी सबसे अधिक भयंकर एवं विस्फोटक होते हैं।
भूमध्य सागर में स्थित स्ट्राम्बोली एक प्रसुप्त ज्वालामुखी है।
जब ज्वालामुखी मृतप्राय हो जाती है तो ज्वालामुखी पाइप के जमने के बाद लावा प्लग का निर्माण होता है।
questions.exp: Stromboli prasupt (dormant) nahi, sakriya ('Bhoomadhya sagar ka prakash stambh') hai – isliye kathan (c) galat. Book: prasupt jwalamukhi udgaar ke baad shaant pad jaate hain par phir kabhi bhi udgaar kar sakte hain – jaise Italy ka Vesuvius, Indonesia ka Krakatoa, Japan ka Fujiyama.

questions.q: अपरदन चक्र के सम्बन्ध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: सवाना का अपरदन चक्र - एम. मोरीसावा
questions.exp: Savanna ka apardan chakra M. Morisawa ka nahi – book ke anusaar ye Pugh evam Thomas se juda hai. Book ki suchi: bhaugolik chakra – W.M. Davis; pediplanation – L.C. King; panplanation – C.H. Crickmay; savanna – Pugh & Thomas; panfan – Lawson; techno-geomorphic model – Marie Morisawa. 'Pediment' shabd ka prayog sabse pehle G.K. Gilbert ne 1880 me Utah ki Henry parvat shreni ke adhyayan me kiya – shushk pradeshon me nadi ke nadpar me vriddhi hone se oordhvadhar apardan ghatta hai.

questions.q: अपक्षय की वह प्रक्रिया जो खनिजों में जल की वृद्धि से होती है ......... कहलाती है।
questions.exp: Jalyojan (hydration) me chattanon ke khanij jal sokh lete hain, rasayanik parivartan hota hai aur naye khanij bante hain jinka aaytan badh jaata hai; naye khanij purane se mulayam hote hain. Udaharan: jalyojan se granite ka feldspar kaolin mitti me badal jaata hai. Note: gypsum ki sanrachna jalyojan se banti hai; jalyojan aur hydrolysis ka sabse adhik prabhav aagneya chattanon par padta hai.

questions.q: जब सागरीय लहरें एवं धाराएँ नदियों द्वारा निर्मित डेल्टा परिवर्तित एवं नष्ट कर दें, तो परिणामस्वरूप अपक्षयित डेल्टा कहलाता है।
questions.exp: Nadi dwara bane delta ke aakar aadi me saagari lehrein parivartan karti rehti hain; kabhi lehrein delta ko kaat-chhaant kar use bigaad deti hain – is tarah kate-chhante delta ko roondit (truncated) delta kehte hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन अधिक ऊँचाई का मेघ है?
questions.exp: Sabse oonchai par pakshabh-kapasi (cirrocumulus) megh hai – safed rang ke chhote-chhote golakar roop me ya lehardar roop me; ye prayah chhayaheen hote hain. Badal hawa ke rudhoshm prakriya se thanda hokar osank se neeche girne par bante hain. Antarrashtriya mausam vigyan parishad ne meghon ko 10 vargon me baanta; pakshabh-kapasi vayumandal me sarvadhik oonchai (5000–13000 m) par.

questions.q: संघनन की गुप्त ऊष्मा के मिलने पर ऊपर उठती हुई वायु के तापमान में हुई कमी कहलाती है:
questions.exp: Oopar uthti santript hawa jis dar se thandi hoti hai use aardra rudhoshm taap haas dar kehte hain. Jab tak hawa santript nahi hoti (sanghan shuru nahi), wo shushk rudhoshm dar se thandi hoti hai; sanghan shuru hone par gupt ushma milne se taap haas ki dar kam ho jaati hai – yahi aardra rudhoshm taap parivartan.

questions.q: कोपेन के जलवायु वर्गीकरण के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही नहीं है?
o: BSh: उष्ण कटिबंधीय स्टेपी जलवायु, औसत वार्षिक तापमान 18° से. से अधिक
Cf : वर्ष भर वर्षा, पश्चिमी यूरोपीय तुल्य जलवायु
Aw : मानसूनी जलवायु, संक्षिप्त शुष्क ऋतु परन्तु पर्याप्त वार्षिक वर्षा
Df : आर्द्र शीत जलवायु, कोई शुष्क ऋतु नहीं
questions.exp: Aw ushna savanna jalvayu hai, mansoon nahi – isliye (c) galat. Book: savanna me varshik ausat taapmaan 25°C se bhi adhik, greeshm ritu me adhik aur sheet me ausat ~21°C; varshik varsha ~75 cm, mukhyatah garmi me. Ye dono golardhon me 5°–20° akshansh ke beech – Africa me Sudan, Brazil ke Campos.

questions.q: स्पेन एवं फ्रांस में उत्तर-पश्चिम से दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशा में बहने वाली स्थानीय पवन कहलाती है:
questions.exp: Mistral ek thandi dhruviya pawan hai jo Rum sagar ke uttar-paschim se dakshin-poorv disha me Spain aur France me Rhone ghati se hokar behti hai; iske aane se taapmaan himank se neeche gir jaata hai. Book ki anya sheetal hawayein: Bora – Adriatic sagar; Blizzard – dhruviya kshetra; Buran – Rus aur Madhya Asia; Norther – USA; Levanter – Spain; Bise – France; Purga – Rusi tundra; Pampero – Argentina, Chile, Uruguay; Papagayo – Mexico tat.

questions.q: वर्षा के सम्बन्ध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्रक्रियाओं का अनुक्रम सही है?
questions.exp: Jal ka gaseey avastha se taral/thos me badalna sanghan hai. Jab hawa ki saapeksh aardrata 100% ho jaati hai to use santript hawa kehte hain; jis taapmaan par hawa santript hoti hai use osank kehte hain, aur uske baad hawa thandi hone par sanghan shuru hota hai. Isliye kram: asantript hawa → osank → sanghan → varshan.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (चक्रवात का प्रकार): 1. टाइफून 2. बैगिओ 3. हरिकेन 4. विली-विली
सूची-II (क्षेत्र): A. ऑस्ट्रेलिया B. यू.एस.ए. C. फिलीपीन्स D. चीन
questions.exp: Typhoon – China; Baguio – Philippines; Hurricane – USA; Willy-willy – Australia.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक जेट स्ट्रीम की विशेषता नहीं है?
o: ये हवाएँ ऊपरी क्षोभमण्डल में पश्चिम से पूर्व की ओर संकरी पट्टी में प्रवाहित होती हैं।
जेट स्ट्रीम का संचार केवल उत्तरी गोलार्द्ध में ही होता है।
इन हवाओं का मार्ग लहरदार एवं विसर्पण लिए हुए है।
जेट स्ट्रीम के वायु वेग में ऋतु के अनुसार परिवर्तन होते हैं।
questions.exp: Jet stream sirf uttari golardh me nahi, dono golardhon me chalti hai – isliye (b) galat. Book: kshobhmandal ki oopari seema par saikdon km chaudi patti me paschim se poorv bahne wali teevra pawan; dono golardhon me 20° akshansh se dhruvon ke beech 7.5–14 km oonchai par; maarg vakrakaar/lehardar; veg mausam ke saath badalta – sheetkaal me garmi se lagbhag dugna; adhiktam ~480 km/h; avasthiti ke aadhar par 5 prakaar.

questions.q:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) का नाम दिया गया है।
अभिकथन (A): विषुवतीय क्षेत्र वर्षभर वर्षा प्राप्त करते हैं।
कारण (R): विषुवतीय क्षेत्र में उच्च आर्द्रता एवं उच्च तापमान संवहनी वर्षा उत्पन्न करते हैं।
o: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
(A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Vishuvat rekha ke uttar-dakshin 5°–10° akshansh tak ushna katibandhiya tar jalvayu; din-raat lagbhag barabar; sarvadhik suryatap se ucch taapmaan (~20°C se upar), ucch aardrata se roz dopahar baad sanvahani varsha – kapasi-varsha badal aur moosladhar varsha; ausat ~200 cm se adhik.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वायु राशियों की उत्पत्ति के लिए एक आदर्श दशा नहीं है?
o: समान तापमान सहित एक विस्तृत समान पृथ्वी का धरातल
एक लम्बी अवधि तक वायुमण्डलीय दशाएँ स्थिर होनी चाहिए।
उत्पत्ति क्षेत्र स्थलीय या महासागरीय होना चाहिए।
questions.exp: Vayuraashi ke liye hawa ka abhisaran nahi, apsaran hona chahiye – abhisaran se taapiya vishamta aur asthirata aati hai. Aadarsh dashayein: vishal samroop kshetra (samaan taapmaan-aardrata), lambe samay tak sthir vayumandaliya dashayein, sthaliya ya mahasagariya udgam kshetra.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रदेश में भूमध्यसागरीय जलवायु की विशेषताएँ नहीं मिलती हैं?
questions.exp: Uttar-paschim Europe me bhoomadhya sagariya jalvayu nahi (wahan paschimi Europe tulya jalvayu). Ye jalvayu bhoomadhya rekha ke dono or 30°–40° akshansh ke beech mahadweepon ke paschimi bhaagon me – bhoomadhya sagar ke tateey kshetra, dakshin California, dakshin-paschim Australia, dakshin Africa ka paschimi bhaag; paschimi pawan aur marusthaliya jalvayu ke beech.

questions.q: यदि एक मानचित्र का प्रदर्शक भिन्न 1 : 3000 है जिसे तीन गुना छोटा किया जाए, तो छोटे किए गए मानचित्र का प्रदर्शक भिन्न क्या होगा?
questions.exp: 1 cm = 3000 cm doori dikhti hai; maapak ko 3 guna chhota karne par 1 cm = 9000 cm, yani 1 : 9000.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से सही कथन को चुनिए:
o: एक स्थान पर तापमान एवं वायुदाब के बीच का सहसम्बन्ध गुणांक 3.5 है।
प्रमाप विचलन केन्द्रीय प्रवृत्ति का एक माप है।
प्रमाप विचलन का वर्ग विचरण गुणांक कहलाता है।
लॉरेंज वक्र किसी समंक श्रेणी के अपकिरण को प्रदर्शित करने की एक आलेखी विधि है।
questions.exp: Lorenz vakra kisi samank shreni ke apkiran ko dikhane ki aalekhi vidhi hai – ye sahi; baaki teeno galat (sahsambandh gunank –1 se +1 ke beech hota hai; maanak vichalan apkiran ka maap hai, kendriya pravritti ka nahi; maanak vichalan ka varg prasaran (variance) hai).

questions.q: समुद्र का खारापन सर्वाधिक है:
questions.exp: Mahasagaron me sarvadhik lavanta 20°–40° uttari akshansh aur 10°–30° dakshini akshansh ke beech (uposhna katibandh) – kyunki yahan ucch taapmaan aur ucch vashpikaran ke saath nimn aardrata hoti hai. Is kshetra me mahasagariya jal ki lavanta ~35‰.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (समुद्री धारा): 1. आयोशिओ धारा 2. बेंगुला धारा 3. हम्बोल्ट धारा 4. कनारी धारा
सूची-II (महासागर का नाम): A. उत्तरी अटलांटिक महासागर B. उत्तरी प्रशांत महासागर C. दक्षिणी प्रशांत महासागर D. दक्षिणी अटलांटिक महासागर
questions.exp: Oyashio – uttari Prashant; Benguela – dakshini Atlantic; Humboldt – dakshini Prashant; Canary – uttari Atlantic.

questions.q:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
1. महाद्वीपीय मग्न तट का औसत ढाल 5° से 8° है।
2. महाद्वीपीय मग्न तट नदियों के मुहाने पर सामान्यतया चौड़े होते हैं।
3. अन्तःसागरीय कंदराएँ सामान्यतया महाद्वीपीय मग्न तट के समानान्तर मिलती हैं।
questions.exp: Sirf 2 sahi. Saamanyatah magn tat nadiyon ke muhane par adhik chaude hote hain (Narmada, Tapi ke prayaksh udaharan). Magn tat ka ausat dhaal 1°–3° hota hai (5°–8° nahi). Magn tat tatha magn dhaal par nadiyon ki gehri, khadi deewar wali ghatiyan – antahsagariya kandarein (canyon) – tat ke samanantar nahi, lambvat hoti hain.

questions.q: प्रवाल भित्तियों निर्माण का स्थिर स्थल सिद्धांत किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.exp: Sthir sthal siddhant John Murray ka hai. Book: praval bhittiyan moonga/praval jeevon ke asthi-panjaron ke jamav aur sanyojan se banti hain. Praval bhittiyon ki utpatti ke siddhant: avtalan – Darwin; sthir sthal – Murray; himani niyantran – Daly. Murray ke alawa Agassiz, Gardiner aur Daly ke siddhant bhi sthal khand ki sthirata par aadharit hain.

questions.q: प्रवाल के विकास के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी अनुकूल दशा है?
o: 100 मीटर से अधिक की महासागरीय गहराई
35 प्रतिशत से ज्यादा महासागरीय जल की लवणता
महासागरीय जल का तापमान 20°C से 22°C के हो
questions.exp: Praval ke vikas ke liye ausat samudri taapmaan 20°–21°C (book 20–22°C) chahiye. Kam gehrai (200–250 ft / 66–77 m) par paaye jaate hain kyunki adhik gehrai par suryaprakash aur oxygen ka abhav. Ati lavanta haanikarak; ausat lavanta 27‰–30‰ honi chahiye. Poorn swachh jal bhi haanikarak, isliye nadiyon ke muhane ke paas praval nahi milte.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी ग्रीन हाउस गैस नहीं है?
questions.exp: Chlorine green house gas nahi. Book: green house prabhav ki khoj 1824 me Joseph Fourier ne ki aur 1896 me pehli baar Svante Arrhenius ne iski matratmak jaanch ki. Pramukh green house gaisein: jalvashp (36–72%), CO₂ (9–26%), methane (4–9%), ozone (3–7%); anya – nitrous oxide, CFC, HFC, PFC, sulphur hexafluoride aadi.

questions.q: दो पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों के मध्य के संक्रमण क्षेत्र को कहते हैं:
questions.exp: Do paristhitik tantron ke beech ka sankraman kshetra ecotone kehlata hai. Book: paristhitik tantra bhootal ke nishchit kshetra ko dharan karne wali aadharbhoot karyasheel ikai hai, jisme jaivik samuday aur ajaivik (bhautik) sanghatkon ke sakal samuchchay ki antarkriyayein shamil hoti hain.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (पोषण स्तर): 1. स्वपोषी 2. शाकाहारी 3. मांसाहारी 4. सर्वाहारी
सूची-II (जीव): A. मानव B. घास C. भेड़ D. तेंदुआ
questions.exp: Swaposhi – ghaas; shakahari – bhed; mansahari – tendua; sarvahari – manav.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने भूगोल को "पृथ्वी के धरातल का मानव के निवास के रूप में अध्ययन" बताया?
questions.exp: Carl Ritter ke anusaar bhugol prithvi ke dharatal ka manav ke niwas ke roop me adhyayan hai. Ritter uddeshyavaadi aur ishwar me prabal vishwas wale 'aaram kursi' bhugolvetta kahe jaate hain; unhone tulnatmak vidhi viksit ki aur bhugol ko 'Erdkunde' (bhoovigyan) maana. Unke anusaar prithvi manushya ke liye aur manushya prithvi ke liye bana hai. Ritter ko pradeshik bhugol ka janak bhi kaha jata hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भूगोल का विषय क्षेत्र है?
questions.exp: Diye gaye saare vikalp bhugol ke vishay kshetra me aate hain. Sampoorn prithvi par manav na hota to bhugol ka astitva samapt ho jaata; manav paryavaran se saamanjasya banakar vikas karta hai aur apni avasthiti ke dwara hi pradeshikaran me safal hota hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भूगोल के विकास के इतिहास का सही अनुक्रम है?
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar sahi kram: Yunan → Roman → Andhyug → Arab bhugolvetta. 600 BC se 300 AD tak ka kaal Yunan ka swarn kaal; bhugol ke namkaran aur prarambhik vyavasthit vikas ka shrey Yunani bhugolvettaon ko. Yunani samrajya ke patan ke baad Roman samrajya me bhaugolik gyan charam par; uske patan ke baad andhyug aaya jisme bhaugolik gyan ki pragati ruki; baad me punarjagaran kaal me bhugol ka punah anveshan.

questions.q:
सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-I (स्कूल): 1. जर्मन 2. फ्रांसीसी 3. ब्रिटिश 4. अमेरिकन
सूची-II (विद्वानों का नाम): A. ए.हेटनर B. मार्क जेफरसन C. जीन ब्रूंश D. ए.जे. हरबर्टसन
questions.exp: German – A. Hettner; Francisi – Jean Brunhes; British – A.J. Herbertson; American – Mark Jefferson.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा गलत सुमेलित है?
o: ब्रिटेन एण्ड द ब्रिटिश सीज़ - डडले स्टॉम्प
