questions.exp: Bharat me nimnatam sthaan Kuttanad Kerala me sthit hai. Kuttanad Kerala ke chawal ka katora ke roop me prasiddh hai; yah apne vishisht nimn stareey sthaan par krishi karne ke liye jaana jaata hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक भू-आकृति में पुनर्युवन का स्थलाकृतिक प्रभाव (साक्ष्य) नहीं है?
questions.exp: Bhoo-aakriti me navonmesh (punaryuvan) ka sthalakritik bahuchakriya sthalakriti nimnlikhit hai: (i) adhah kartit visarp (ii) yugmit ghati vedikaein (ghati ke andar ghati) (iii) bahu-chakriya ghati (iv) nick point (v) utthit samprapya. Sanrachnatmak bench punaryuvan ka saakshya nahi.

questions.q: वाल्टर क्रिस्टालर का k=7 संजाल (नेटवर्क) निम्नलिखित सिद्धांतों में किस पर आधारित है?
questions.exp: Walter Christaller ka K=7 sanjaal (network) prashasan siddhant par aadharit hai. Prashasan siddhant me kendra sthalon ka vikas K = 7 ke anusaar hoga jisme 7 puron ko ek seva pahunchayega ya nagar 2401 puron ki seva 343 kasbon 49 seva kendron ke madhyam se karega. Christaller ka padanukram: K = 3 bazaar; K = 4 parivahan; K = 7 prashasan. 'Bhugol me bastiyon ke padanukram shabdavali ko prastavit evam viksit karne ka shrey Walter Christaller ko jaata hai.' Sarvapratham German bhugolvetta Walter Christaller ne Germany ki adhivason ke adhyayan ke aadhar par 1933 me kendra sthal siddhant ka pratipadan kiya. Kendra sthal ka mool kaarya apne chaaron or ke kshetra ko vastuein aur sevaein pradaan karna hai.

questions.q: जाजरील की घाटी अवस्थित है
questions.exp: Jezreel ki ghati Israel me avasthit hai. Aadhunik Israel ke uttar me Lebanon, uttar-poorv me Syria, Jordan aur poorv me West Bank aur dakshin-paschim me Misra sthit hai. Israel ke paschim me bhoomadhya saagar hai. Negev registan Israel ke kul bhoomi ke aadhe se adhik bhaag me shaamil hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने छायापुंज संसाधन की संकल्पना का सूत्रपात किया?
questions.exp: G. Zimmermann ne chhayapunj sansaadhan ki sankalpana ka sootrapaat kiya. Hartshorne ne bhugol ko kshetravarni vigyan maana hai; ye pradeshik bhugolvetta the. Inki pramukh kritiyan: Perspective in the Nature of Geography; The Nature of Geography.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शहर कर्क रेखा के सबसे पास है?
questions.exp: Prashnagat diye gaye shaharon me kark rekha ke sabse sameep Ranchi sthit hai. Bharat me kark rekha nimn rajyon se hokar guzarti hai: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Paschim Bangal, Tripura, Mizoram.

questions.q: 2011 के अनुसार भारत के निम्नलिखित राज्यों में से किस राज्य में वनों का क्षेत्र सबसे अधिक है?
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (d): 2011 ke anusaar Bharat me Arunachal Pradesh rajya me vanon ka kshetra sabse adhik hai (book ki vyakhya pratishat ke aadhar par). Sarvadhik vanavaran pratishat wale rajya: Lakshadweep 90.33, Mizoram 85.41, Andaman Nicobar 81.74, Arunachal Pradesh 79.63. Bharat me nyuntam vanavaran pratishat wale rajya Haryana, Punjab, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh evam Gujarat hain. (Dhyan do: kul kshetrafal ke hisaab se sabse zyada van Madhya Pradesh me hai.)

questions.q: निम्नलिखित युग्मों में कौन सुमेलित नहीं है? (पुस्तक – भूगोलवेत्ता)
questions.exp: 'Geographia Generalis' naamak pustak Bernhard Varenius ne likhi hai. German vidwan Varenius pehle vidwan the jinhone bhugol me dwibhaajikaran ki neev daali. Sahi: Cosmos – Humboldt; Erdkunde – Ritter; Anthropogeographie – Ratzel.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित प्रदेशों में से किसमें गर्म शीतोष्ण जलवायु नहीं पाई जाती है?
questions.exp: Garm sheetoshn jalvayu mahadweepon ke poorvi samudra tateey bhaagon me 30° se 45° (kabhi-kabhi 25°) akshanshon ke beech paayi jaati hai. Is jalvayu me greeshm ritu me garmi padti hai evam ausat taapmaan 26°C rehta hai; sheet ritu me thand padti hai tatha ausat taapmaan 13°C rehta hai. Yahan varsha mukhyatah greeshmakaal me hoti hai tatha kul varshik varsha lagbhag 100 cm hoti hai. Yah jalvayu poorvi China, madhyavarti tatha dakshin-poorvi USA, dakshin-poorvi Brazil evam Uruguay tatha Africa evam Australia ke dakshini evam poorvi bhaag me paayi jaati hai. Madhya America me nahi.

questions.q: जब वास्तविक तापहास दर शुष्क स्थिरोष्म (एडियाबेटिक) ह्रास दर से अधिक होती है तो वह वायुमण्डल में उत्पन्न करती है।
questions.exp: Saagar tal se oonchai par jaane par prati 1000 feet oonchai par 3.6°F (6.5°C prati 1000 m) taapmaan kam ho jaata hai; ise saamanya ya vastavik taap haas dar kehte hain. Nishchit aayatan wali vayu ko jab oopar le jaate hain to vahan kam vayumandaleey bhaar hone ke kaaran aayatan bad jaata hai kyunki oonchai ke saath vayudaab ghatta hai; jab nishchit aayatan wali hawa neeche utarti hai to uska aayatan ghat jaata hai. Is tarah vayu ke oordhvadhar roop se oopar ya neeche jaane ke kaaran bina atirikt ushma ke mile taapmaan me parivartan ko 'rudhoshm parivartan' kehte hain. Jab vastavik taap haas dar shushk rudhoshm haas dar se adhik ho to vayumandal me asthayitva utpann hota hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन वेलापवर्ती (पेलैजिक) समुद्री निक्षेप है?
questions.exp: Mahasagaron me milne wale jeevon tatha vanaspatiyon ke avsheshon tatha karbonik tatvon ke nikshep ko, jo ki mahasagaron me adhik gahrai par paaye jaate hain, pelagic nikshep kehte hain. Pelagic nikshepon me vibhinn prakaar ki ooz ka vitaran sarvadhik maatra me paaya jaata hai. Kul saamudrik nikshepon me 0.4% bhaag me teropod ooz, 6.4% me diatom ooz, 3.4% me radiolarian ooz aur 29.2% bhaag me globigerina ooz tatha 30.1% bhaag me laal mrittika paayi jaati hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में कौन 300 से 1000 मीटर गहराई में जल के घनत्व में तीव्र परिवर्तन दर्शाता है?
questions.exp: Saagariya jal ke taapmaan ke vipreet nimn akshanshon (ushna evam uposhna katibandh) me saagariya jal ke ghantva me 300 se 1000 m ki gahrai tak ke madhya teevra vriddhi hoti hai, parantu ucch akshanshon me ghantva me koi parivartan nahi hota hai. 300 se 1000 m gahrai wale mandal me saagariya jal ke ghantva me teevra parivartan hota hai, ise pycnocline kehte hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन महासागरों की सतह पर गर्म जल एवं गहराई के ठंडे जल के सभी महासागरों से होकर परिपथीय (सर्कयूटस) संचरण को दर्शाता है?
questions.exp: Mahasagariya jal ke taapmaan ke vitaran ke saath do tathyon ki visheshtaon ka adhyayan karte hain – satah ke jal ka taapmaan tatha gahrai ke saath taapmaan. Chunki mahasagar ka trivimiya aakaar hota hai atah uske taapmaan ke vitaran me akshansheey vistaar ke alawa gahrai ko bhi dhyaan me rakha jaata hai; isliye garm jal aur gahrai ke thande jal ko alag-alag naam se pukaarte hain. Conveyor belt sanchalan har mahasagar se hokar guzarta hai.

Inke vikas ke liye aavashyak dashaein: ye ushna katibandheey mahasagaron (25°N se 25°S) me paaye jaate hain kyunki inke jeevit rehne ke liye 20°C se 21°C taapmaan aavashyak hota hai; inke vikas ke liye vistrit antahsagariya chabootra upyukt hote hain.

Bharat ek vishaal desh hai jahan kai rajya aur kendra shasit pradesh hain; kahin zyada vikas to kahin kam vikas hua hai, to jo pradesh adhik vikas ke gaye wahan gareebi kam hai aur jahan vikas kam hua hai wahan gareebi adhik hai.

questions.exp: Udyogon ke sthaniyakaran me bazaar paksh par poornaroopen vyakhya Lösch ne 1940 me apni German pustak me ki, jiska Angrezi anuvaad 'The Economics of Location' 1954 me prakashit hua. Lösch ne udyog ke sthaniyakaran ke nyuntam laagat siddhant ka khandan karte hue bataya ki koi udyog us sthaan par sthapit kiya jaana chahiye jahan kul laagat tatha kul aay ka antar adhiktam ho na ki nyuntam laagat wale sthaan par. A. Lösch ne shatkoniya bazaar kshetron ke gatisheel santulan ki sankalpana ka pratipadan kiya.

Atah jo raashtra jis star par hai uski usi star se oopar uthna hai. Pratyek desh ke vikas ki aarthik, samajik aur sanskritik vikas ki yojanaein inhi stron me vibhajit karte hain. Pradeshik asantulan ka shuddh maap vichalan gunank nahi hai.

Jansankhya ke vyavasaayon ka prabhaav adhivas ki grih sanrachna, samajik, aarthik star, jeevan paddhati, sanskritik star aadi par spasht roop se dikhai padta hai. questions.exp: Punarnirmaan aarthik samanvay ka roop nahi hai. Classical siddhant me sakal raashtreey aay vriddhi hi vikas ka lakshya maana jaata hai, chahe sampoorn vriddhi ka vitaran samaaj ke sabhi vargon me pahunche ya nahi. Vriddhi utpaadan ke kaarakon – bhoomi, shram, poonji evam saahas ke samanvit parinaam hai. Poonji sanchay evam shram vibhajan aarthik vikas ke liye anivaarya shart maana jaata hai.

questions.exp: Aarthik vikas ke liye sansaadhan upyog ki naveentam pravidhiki ka vyavhaar aavashyak hai. Pravidhik parivartan aarthik vyavastha ko aadhunik swaroop pradaan karne me sarvadhik mahatvapurn hai. Is drishtikon se pravidhiki ke kai prakaar hote hain; kuch pravidhiki aarthik vikas prakriya me sakriya yogdan dete hain jisme vividh prakaar ke yantron aur upkarnon ke avishkaar ya parishkaar ko adhik mahatva diya jaata hai. Lekin bahya arthvyavasthaein vikasatmak kriya me sanyojan utpann nahi karti hain.

questions.exp: Manavtavaadi bhugol ke vikas ki jhalak sarvapratham 1960 ke dashak ke ant me matratmak bhugol tatha pratyakshvaad ke virodh me hua. Manavtavaadi bhugolvetta matratmak kranti ka virodh is aadhar par karte hain ki vah maanviya sambandhon, moolya evam saundaryabodh jaise maanviya muddon ko mahatva nahi deti. Manavtavaadi bhugolvetta bhugol ke adhyayan me maanav ko sakriya evam kendriya bhoomika pradaan karta hai. 'Aarthik maanav' sankalpana iski virodhi hai.

o: राष्ट्रीय एटलस एवं थीमैटिक मानचित्रण संगठन (नेटमो)
questions.exp: Prakritik kaarakon me ekroopta, krishi bhoomi upyog evam shasya pratiroop ke aadhar par Bharat ke sansaadhan vikas pradeshon ko 7 vrihad khand hetu ek niyojan pradesh R.P. Mishra dwara taiyaar kiya gaya. Iske kai pradesh rajya seemaon ke aar-paar faile hain; jahan khand ke andar pradesh smaahit kiye gaye hain. Inme pramukh sansaadhan vikas pradesh ye hain: 1. paschimi Himalay 2. poorvi Himalay 3. nichli Ganga ka maidan 4. madhya Ganga maidan 5. dakshini pathar evam pahadiyan 6. paschimi tateey maidan 7. paschimi shushk pradesh 8. dweep samooh.

questions.q: भारत में जनपद स्तरीय योजना के निर्माण एवं कार्यान्वयन का कार्य सम्पादित किया जाता है
questions.exp: Sthaniya evam prashasnik visheshtaon ke kaaran rajya se neeche ke star ke niyojan me pramukh bhoomika nibhata hai. British shasan kaal se hi janpad star par sabhi prakaar ki soochnaon ke sangrah ki achhi vyavastha rahi hai. Janpad star par niyojan ka paryavekshan zila parishad evam uske chairman dwara kiya jaata hai. Iske nirmaan evam kaaryanvayan ka kaarya zilaadhikaari dwara sampadit kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित सागरीय जीव-कटिबंधों में से किसे 'प्रकाशित मंडल' भी कहा जाता है?
questions.exp: Saagariya jeev katibandhon me epipelagic jeev katibandh 'prakashit mandal' ke naam se jaana jaata hai. Saagariya jeev katibandhon ko paanch mandalon me vibhajit kiya gaya hai: (1) epipelagic mandal – samudra ki satah se 200 m tak (sunlight zone); (2) mesopelagic mandal – 200 m se 1000 m tak (twilight zone); (3) bathypelagic mandal – 1000 m se 4000 m tak (midnight zone); (4) abyssopelagic mandal – 4000 m se 6000 m tak (abyss zone); (5) hadal pelagic mandal – 6000 m se samudra ke sarvadhik gahre bhaag tak (deepest zone).

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने सर्वप्रथम 'स्थानिक पादप' की संकल्पना का प्रतिपादन किया?
questions.exp: Paadpon ka sarvadhik mahatva hota hai, kyunki jeevmandal ke ye prathamik utpadak hote hain jo prithvi par maanav tatha praaniyon ko aahaar pradaan karte hain. Ek pradesh vishesh me kisi paadap samudaay ke sadasyon ka samooh hota hai. Paadap prajatiyon ke samajik samooh ko paadap samudaay ke aadharbhoot ikaai hote hain. Sarvapratham Augustin de Candolle ne sthaniya paadap ki sankalpana ko prastut kiya tha.

questions.q: जैविक विविधता 'हॉट स्पाट' (Hot Spot) संबंधित नहीं है
questions.exp: Jaiv vividhata hot-spot moolatah jaiv vividhata ke kshetra hote hain. Is shabd ka prayog sarvapratham British paristhitiki vaigyanik Norman Myers dwara 1988 me kiya gaya. Bharat me jaiv vividhata hot-spot mukhya roop se paschimi ghat, uttar-poorvi Bharat evam Himalay kshetra me paaye jaate hain. Vindhyan nahi.

questions.q: 'जैविक विविधता/जैवीय विविधता अधिनियम' भारत की लोकसभा ने निम्नलिखित में से किस वर्ष में पारित किया था?
questions.exp: Jaiv vividhata adhiniyam 2002 me adhiniyamit kiya gaya tha. Is adhiniyam ka uddeshya jaivik sansaadhanon ka sanrakshan, unke dharneey upyog ka prabandhan aur sthaniya samudaayon ke saath ucheet aur nyaysangat saajhakaran sansaadhan ka bhaavi peedhiyon ke liye jaiv vividhata ke sanrakshan karna aur jaivik sansaadhanon ke vitaran ki prakriya ko sunishchit karna hai. Bharat me jaiv vividhata adhiniyam (2002) ke kaaryanvayan ke liye kendra sarkar dwara 2003 me Rashtriya Jaiv Vividhata Pradhikaran (N.B.A) ki sthapana ki gayi; iska mukhyalay Chennai (Tamil Nadu) me sthit hai.

questions.q: जन्तु विसरण के निम्नलिखित प्रकारों में से कौन सा एक दीर्घकालिक सूखा के कारण होता है?
questions.exp: Praaniyon ka visaran unke apne pravaas tatha visaran se bade paimane par prabhavit hota hai. Apni utpatti ke sthaan se anya kshetron me praaniyon ka visaran ki prakriya hai. Jab deerghkaal tak sookha vyapt rehta hai to praaniyon ko ek kshetra se doosre kshetra me prasaran hona padta hai, use balaat visaran kehte hain. (Dhyan do: book me uttar ka akshar (c) chhapa hai, par vyakhya balaat visaran ki hai, isliye vikalp (a) rakha gaya.)

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 'पारिस्थितिकीय कर्मता' (निचे) से संबंधित है?
questions.exp: Paristhitik karmta (niche) se pratispardhatmak nishkaasan ka niyam sambandhit hai. Paristhitiki me samast jeevon tatha bhautik paryavaran ke madhya paraspar antarsambandhon evam vibhinn jeevon ke madhya paraspar antarsambandhon ka adhyayan kiya jaata hai. In sambandhon ke antargat jeevon ke astitva se sambandhit sabhi dashaon ko sammilit kiya jaata hai; ye dashaein jaivik evam ajaivik dono ki ho sakti hain.

questions.q: आर्द्र क्षेत्रों के आवास में विकसित होने वाली वनस्पतियों के अनुक्रम को कहा जाता है
questions.exp: Vanaspatiyon jagat ki sabse badi visheshta unki vividhta hai. Paadpon ka janm ek sthaan par hua hai jahan ve baad me paadpon ki vibhinn jalvayu pradeshon (bhoomadhyrekheey ushna aardra jalvayu se dhruveey arctic sheet jalvayu), vibhinn aavaason (saagar tal se ucch parvaton tak, sthaleey bhaagon se jaleey bhaagon tak) evam vibhinn paryavaraniya dashaon me apna anukoolan kiya hai. Jin vanaspatiyon ka janm aardra pradeshon me hota hai use jalkramak anukram me sammilit kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन युग्म सुमेलित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Shimla Dhauladhar shreni me sthit hai, jabki anya vikalp sahi sumelit hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने जनसंख्या के लॉजिस्टिक वक्र सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन किया?
questions.exp: Jansankhya ki samasya koi naveen nahi balki maanav sabhyata ke vikas ke saath-saath vividh prakaar ki jansankhya sambandhi samasyaein bhi utpann hoti rahi hain. Isi sambandh me jansankhya ke logistic vakra siddhant ko Pearl Reed ne pratipadit kiya hai. Jabki Thomas Doubleday ne jansankhya ke sambandh me aahaar siddhant ka pratipadan kiya.

questions.q: एकरमैन द्वारा विश्व जनसंख्या संसाधन प्रदेशों के विभाजन के अनुसार भारत आता है
questions.exp: Ackerman dwara varsh 1970 ee. me jansankhya, sansaadhan evam takneeki ko dhyaan me rakhte hue sampoorn vishwa ko 5 jansankhya sansaadhan pradeshon me vibhajit kiya. Uprokt teen kaarakon me unhone sarvadhik mahatva takneeki ko diya. Bharat Misra prakaar ki shreni me aata hai. Ackerman dwara diye gaye jansankhya sansaadhan pradesh nimn hain: 1. Sanyukt Rajya America prakaar ke kshetra; 2. Europe prakaar ke kshetra; 3. Brazil prakaar ke kshetra; 4. Misra prakaar ke kshetra; 5. Arctic prakaar ke kshetra. 1. USA prakaar: is prakaar ke kshetra me jansankhya kshamta evam sansaadhan anupaat nimn hai. Sanyukt Rajya America ko sansaadhan ki drishti se sarvadhik uttam kshetra hai. Samajik aur aarthik sansaadhanon ki prachurta ke kaaran logon ka jeevan star ati ucch hai. USA prakaar ke kshetra me jansankhya sansaadhan sambandh sarvadhik naveen hai. Canada, Australia, New Zealand, USA aadi desh is varg me sammilit kiye jaate hain. 2. Europe prakaar: is prakaar ke kshetra me jansankhya kshamta evam sansaadhan anupaat ucch hai. Jansankhya, sansaadhan evam takneeki ki drishti se is prakaar ke kshetra ki sthiti ati uttam hai. Is kshetra me Europe ke deshon ke alawa Japan, Israel aadi desh aate hain.

questions.q: 'आर्थिक वर्ग एवं निजी सम्पत्ति दो प्रमुख बुराइयाँ हैं जो गरीबी, बेरोजगारी एवं तीव्र जनसंख्या वृद्धि के कारण होती हैं।' निम्नलिखित में से किसने यह कहा था?
questions.exp: Karl Marx ke anusaar samaaj vargon me banta hai, jisme pratyek varg apne pradhan sansaadhan ke saath shareer ki pratyek bhaag ki kshamta ke anusaar ek alag maahaul ka nirmaan karta hai aur jo sansaadhan prapt karta hai uske adheen kaarya karta hai. Iske kaaran samaaj me vargon ka vibhajan hai. Marx ke anusaar aarthik varg tatha niji sampatti ki vyavastha ke kaaran gareebi, berozgaari tatha teevra jansankhya vriddhi jaisi samasyaein utpann hoti hain. Karl Marx ki prasiddh pustak 'Das Kapital' 1867 ee. me prakashit hui. Varg sangharsh ka siddhant Karl Marx ke vaigyanik samajvaad ka merudand hai.

questions.q: 'अनुकूलतम जनसंख्या प्रतिमान (मॉडल)' का प्रतिपादन किया था
questions.exp: Carr Saunders ke anusaar anukooltam jansankhya ka abhipraay jansankhya ki us aadarsh maatra se hai jo kisi deshkaal me uplabdh sansaadhanon tatha praudyogiki ki dasha me aarthik roop se adhiktam kalyan pradaan karti hai. Anukooltam jansankhya model ka pratipadan Carr Saunders dwara kiya gaya tha.

questions.q: 'सन्नगर' (कोनबेशन) की संकल्पना विकसित की गई थी
questions.exp: Sannagar (conurbation) ki sankalpana ka pratipadan Patrick Geddes dwara kiya gaya. Sannagar, nagaron ya upnagaron ke samooh ko kehte hain jab kai faile hue kasbe aapas me mil jaate hain to nagar maal ki rachna hoti hai. Sannagar ke kendra me ek bada nagar hota hai evam praayah usi ke naam se sannagar ka naamkaran kiya jaata hai, jaise – Delhi conurbation, Lancashire conurbation aadi.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किस देश में परंपरागत मानव अधिवास को 'कम्पुंग' कहा जाता है?
questions.exp: Malaysia me paramparagat maanav adhivaas ko kampung kaha jaata hai. Robequain ke anusaar Malaysia me bastiyon ki ikaai bikhre hue gaon hain jo ki vivekpoorn krishi ke prakaar ka nishchit aadhar prastut karte hain. Chunki is desh ki praacheen bastiyan saagar tat par milti hain, isliye praacheen kaal me suraksha ki drishti se saamuhik roop se rehna aavashyak tha. Yahan ke gaon parivartit hokar hangari ke gaon ka roop le liya hai.

questions.q: शैलों की तालचर श्रृंखला संबंधित है
questions.exp: Gondwana chattanon ka nirmaan oopari Carboniferous yug se Jurassic yug ke beech hua hai. Ye koyle ke liye vishesh mahatvapurn hain. Ye parat-daar chattanein hain aur inme machhliyon aur reengne wale jeevon ke avshesh praapt hote hain. In chattanon ka nirmaan ghatiyon me nadiyon dwara ekatra hone wale padarthon se hua hai. Damodar, Mahanadi aur Godavari ki kathaayiyan evam paschimi Rajasthan aadi me in chattanon ka sarvottam roop milta hai. Talcher shrinkhala nichle Gondwana se sambandhit hai.

questions.q: नगरीय केन्द्र का संकेन्द्रीय वृत्त सिद्धान्त प्रतिपादित किया गया है
questions.exp: Sankendriya valay siddhant ka pratipadan 1927 ee. me American samajshaastri Burgess ne kiya. Iska siddhant American nagaron, vishesh roop se Chicago ke adhyayan par aadharit hai. Burgess ke anusaar nagariya vikas ko paanch sankendriya valayon dwara samjha ja sakta hai: 1. aantarik kendriya vyapaarik kshetra; 2. sankraman peti; 3. shramik logon ke makaanon ka kshetra; 4. shreshthtar makaanon ka kshetra; 5. ucch shreni rihaayishi kshetra.

questions.q: नाभिकीय ग्रामीण अधिवास सर्वाधिक सामान्य हैं
questions.exp: Is prakaar ke gaon saamanyatah kisi jheel, talaab ya bat vriksh ke chaaron or base hote hain. Kabhi-kabhi kisi kendreeya makaan ke (mukhiya ya zameendar athwa panchayat ghar) chaaron or bhi kisi gaon ke gaon bas jaate hain. Naabhikeey gramin adhivaas nimn kshetron me paaye jaate hain: 1. Bharat ke uttari maidan; 2. Rajasthan ke paschimi bhaag; 3. Narmada basin; 4. Vindhya pathar; 5. Rajasthan ke poorvi evam dakshini tateey kshetra.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित अधिवास प्रकारों में से किसकी विशेषता 'सांस्कृतिक समरसता एवं एकता' है?
questions.exp: Saghan adhivaas aas-paas sate hue hote hain. Inki galiyan sankri hoti hain aur ye basti ke kendreeya bhaag ke chaaron or se jodti hain. Saghan bastiyan manushya ke sangathit aur samajik jeevan ke prateek hote hain, kyunki isme maanav ki aavashyaktaon ki poorti ke liye anek prakaar ke samajik, aarthik aur dhaarmik kaarya kiye jaate hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से जनसंख्या वृद्धि के 'जनांकिकीय संक्रमण प्रतिमान' विकसित किया?
questions.exp: Jansankhya vriddhi ka 'janankikiya sankraman pratimaan' Frank Notestein ne viksit kiya jabki janankikiya sankraman siddhant ka pratipadan W.S. Thompson ne viksit kiya. Unhone paschimi Europe ke deshon ke anubhavon ka prayog karke jansankhya ke kaalik pratiroop ka saamaanyikaran janmdar aur mrityudar me hone wale kaalanukramik parivartanon ke aadhar par kiya. Janankikiya sankraman ki janankikiya itihaas ki sarvadhik mahatvapurn evam abhilekhpoorn ghatna maana jaata hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने अपने प्रतिमान में उपभोक्ताओं के स्थानिक व्यवहार को स्थिर माना?
questions.exp: Apne pratimaan me upbhoktaon ke sthaniya vyavhaar ko W. Christaller ne sthir maana jabki anya sabhi vidwan audyogik sthaniyakaran ke siddhant se sambandhit the.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित विद्वानों में से किसने 'मानव पारिस्थितिकी की संकल्पना' का प्रतिपादन किया था?
questions.exp: Samast jeevon tatha bhautik paryavaran ke madhya antarsambandhon evam vibhinn jeevon ke madhya paraspar antarsambandhon ke adhyayan ko paristhitiki (ecology) kehte hain. Maanav paristhitiki ki sankalpana sarvapratham H.H. Barrows dwara pratipadit kiya gaya. Yah jeevon tatha unke paryavaran ke beech antarsambandhon ki abhivyakti tatha adhyayan se sambandhit vibhinn naamavaliyon ka paryaay hai. Paristhitiki ki sankalpanaon ke niyam evam nirupan ya rachna ka shrey Charles Darwin ko pradaan kiya jaata hai jinhone 'jeevan ke astitva ke liye sangharsh' ki bhoomika ka mahatvapurn mahatva diya.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन वनस्पति जगत विश्व के सर्वाधिक धरातलीय भाग को घेरता है?
questions.exp: Coniferous van jeevom Canada ke poorvi tateey bhaag se aarambh hokar Alaska ke paschim me sthit Atlantic pradesh tak paaye jaate hain. Is prakaar ke jeevom ko boreal van ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. Isko yahi sthaan prasiddh hai sanyukt tega (taiga) ka naam se jaana jaata hai. Dakshini golardh me sookshm-dhruveey jalvayu ka abhaav hai, atah yah jeevom wahan nahi paaya jaata hai.

questions.q: सन् 2004 में हिंदमहासागर की सुनामी के समय भारत के निम्नलिखित स्थानों में से किसके पास मैंग्रोव की प्राकृतिक अग्रिम पंक्ति सुरक्षा नहीं थी?
questions.exp: Kisi akele desh ke liye sunami jaisi aapda se nipatna sambhav nahi hai. 26 December 2004 ko sunami aane ke baad Bharat me iske khatre ko kam karne ke upaay par kaam kiya gaya. Sunami ki chetavani ko jaari karne ke liye Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning and Mitigation System (IOTWS) viksit kiya gaya. Book ka uttar (c).

questions.q: कोई प्रकोप आपदा बन जाता है जब वह प्रतिकूल ढंग से प्रभावित करता है
questions.exp: Prakritik paryavaran me aisi ghatnaein jinse bade paimane par jan-dhan (maanav aavaas, krishi aur anya aadharbhoot sanrachnaon) ki haani hoti hai, prakritik aapda kehlaati hai. Saamanyatah prakritik sankat ki tulna me tezi se ghatit hote hain. Prakritik aapdaon ke sansaar bhar ke logon ke vyaapakeekrit (generalised) anubhav hote hain. Do aapdaein na to samaan hoti hain aur na hi inme aapas me tulna ki ja sakti hai. Pratyek aapda apne niyantrak samajik-paryavaraniya ghatakon, samajik anukriya, jo yah utpann karte hain, tatha jis dhang se pratyek samajik varg isse nipatta hai, ke aadhar par vishisht hoti hai.

questions.q: वायुमण्डलीय प्राथमिक उत्पादकों द्वारा आत्मसात की गई ऊर्जा की संपूर्ण मात्रा को कहा जाता है।
questions.exp: Prathamik utpadak chlorophyll yukt paudhe hain jo prakash sanshleshan ki kriya dwara carbon dioxide (CO₂) evam jal (H₂O) ko parnharit (chlorophyll) ki upasthiti me surya ke prakash dwara glucose me parivartit karte hain, jaise kaai (shaival), ghaas evam ped aadi. Chunki hare paudhe apna bhojan swayam taiyaar karte hain, atah inhe swaposhi (autotrophs) bhi kaha jaata hai. Prathamik utpadakon dwara aatmasaat ki gayi urja ki sampoorn maatra sakal prathamik utpadakta kehlaati hai.

questions.q: भूगोल में 'प्रतिमान विस्थापन' शब्दावली का प्रयोग किसने किया था?
questions.exp: Pratimaan visthapan shabdavali ka prayog Thomas Kuhn ne kiya tha. Pratimaan visthapan, American bhautik vigyani aur darshanik dwara pehchaani gayi avdharna hai jo ki mool me ek mool parivartan ko darshata hai. Kuhn ne chintanfalak sthanantaran shabdavali ka prayog kiya tha jise Masterman (1970) ne teen shreniyon me vibhinn prakaar ko samahit kiya. Kuhn ke anusaar bhugol me chintanfalak sthanantaran ki prakriya mukhyatah Humboldt evam Ritter ke kaaryon ke roop me aarambh hui aur beesvi shatabdi ke uttarardh me adhik teevra ho gayi.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से भूगोल की किस पीठ ने मनुष्य को जैवमण्डल का घटक माना है?
questions.exp: Jaivmandal ke ghatakon ko vishesh maanne ka shrey Chicago peeth ko jaata hai. Jaivmandal reserve ki sankalpana UNESCO ne Maanav aur Jaivmandal pariyojana ka prayog karte hue ki thi aur iske upasthit anuvanshik sansaadhanon ke sanrakshan se sambandhit thi, ke ek bhaag ke roop me 1975 ee. me laagu ki gayi. Jaivmandal reserve sthal evam samudratateey paryavaranon ke aise rakshit kshetra hain jo samagra sanrakshit pranali me ankit hote hain.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 'समय एवं स्थान' के सिद्धान्त का प्रतिपादन किया था?
questions.exp: 'Samay evam sthaan' (Time and Space) ke siddhant ka pratipadan book ke anusaar Ashim Warne (?) ne kiya tha. R.J. Chorley aur Haggett in dono vidwanon ne bhaugolik vishleshan evam adhyayan me sankhyikiya ganitiya vidhiyon ka prayog kiya. Kant ne bhautik bhugol ke janmdata the tatha bhaugolik vibhajan ke aadhar par maana tatha bhugol ki nimn shaakhaon ko paribhashit kiya: ganitiya bhugol, naitik bhugol, rajneetik bhugol, vyapaarik bhugol, adhyatmik bhugol.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित जर्मन भूगोल वेत्ताओं में से किसने सामुद्रिक विज्ञान के क्षेत्र में पर्याप्त योगदान किया?
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (b) Alfred Hettner. Hettner ne bhugol ko ek kshetra vitaran vigyan maana, jiske antargat pradeshon ki pahchaan ka adhyayan kiya jaata hai. Hettner ki yah maanyata thi ki bhugol ke antargat pradeshik bhugol evam saamanya bhugol dono ki sammilit hai. Hettner ne bhugol ko kshetra ka adhyayan maana. Vistrit yaatra ke pashchat unhone 'Europe' naamak pustak ki rachna ki. Hettner ne samudra vigyan ke kshetra me vishesh yogdan diya. (Dhyan do: Gerhard Schott German samudra-vigyani ke roop me prasiddh hain.)

questions.q: निम्नलिखित आलोचनात्मक भूगोल में से कौन स्थानिक प्रतिरूपों की व्याख्या में 'सामाजिक संरचना' पर बल देता है?
questions.exp: Matratmak kranti evam sthaniya vishleshan ke viruddh pratikriya swaroop 1970 ke dashak me kranti parak bhugol ka vikas hua. Yah matratmak vishleshan evam positivistic vishleshan dwara prapt saiddhantik niyamon ko asweekaar karta hai. Krantikaari bhugol ke vikas me Antipode patrika aur Clark vishwavidyalay ka mahatvapurn yogdan raha hai. Krantikaari bhugolvettaon ka maanna hai ki badalte samajik sandarbh me utpaadan ke saadhanon me swaamitva bhi badal jaata hai jiske falswaroop samajik niyamon me bhi parivartan ho jaata hai. Atah krantikaari bhugol sthaniya pratiroopon ki vyakhya me samajik sanrachna par vishesh bal deta hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित सूती वस्त्रोत्पादक केन्द्रों में से कौन जर्मनी में स्थित है?
questions.exp: Dwitiya vishwa yuddh ke pashchat vibhajit paschimi Germany aur poorvi Germany ka 1990 me ekikaran hua. Is desh ke uttar me Baltic saagar, Uttari saagar aur Denmark aur poorv me Poland aur Czechoslovakia, dakshin me Austria tatha Switzerland aur paschim me France, Luxembourg, Belgium tatha Netherlands seemaein banate hain. Is desh ki rajdhani Berlin hai. Yahan Wuppertal sooti vastra ka mukhya kendra hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी फसल भारत की राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा मिशन में सम्मिलित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Rashtriya khadya suraksha mission ke antargat gehoon, chawal aur daalon ko sammilit kiya gaya hai taaki gareeb parivaar ko bhojan ki praapti ho sake. Iske antargat 25 kg raashan ka praavdhaan kiya gaya hai. Iske antargat tilhan ko nahi rakha gaya hai.

questions.q: निम्नलिखित में से किसने अपने औद्योगिक अवस्थापन सिद्धांत में लारेनहट के 'स्थिति त्रिभुज' का प्रयोग किया?
questions.exp: Udyogon ke sthaniyakaran ke siddhant ke pratipadan me Weber ka sarvapratham naam aata hai. Weber ne apne siddhant ki pustak 'Über den Standort der Industrien' 1909 me prakashit hui. questions.exp: El Niño ek mausami parighatna hai jiska aavirbhav dakshin America ke paschimi tat (mukhya roop se Peru) ke sameep Prashant mahasagar me hota hai. Yah mahasagariya jal ki satah ke theek neeche chalne wali ek upsatahi dhaara hai jo 3° se 36°S akshansh tak paayi jaati hai. Kuch varshon me iska vistaar dakshini Prashant me door tak hota hai. Gyatavya hai ki Peru ke tat ke paas Peru ki thandi dhaara dakshin se uttar disha me chalti hai; sharad kaal (u.go.) me vishuvat rekheey vipreet dhaara ki uttari shaakha dakshin ki or khisak jaati hai jisse El Niño ka janm hota hai. El Niño ke aagman par Peru ke tat ka taapmaan saamanya se 3°–4°C badh jaata hai. Jis varsh El Niño shaktishaali hota hai us varsh Bharat, Australia, Mexico, dakshin Africa, Philippines aadi deshon me prachand sookhe ki sthiti; Indonesia ke jangalon me aag. La Niña ke saath El Niño sakriya nahi hota.

questions.exp: Pentagonal dodecahedral siddhant ka sarvapratham pratipadan Elie de Beaumont ne kiya, Lord Kelvin ne nahi. Unhone is siddhant ke madhyam se mahadweepon ke kramik vyavastha ki vyakhya karne ka prayas kiya. Iske baad Lothian Green ne san 1857 me chatushfalak parikalpana (tetrahedral hypothesis) ka pratipadan kiya; is siddhant ke anusaar yadi ek gole ke dharatal par chaaron taraf se samaan dabaav daala jaaye to vah gola chatushfalak aakriti me parivartit ho jaayega. Is siddhant ko Green ne prithvi par laagu kiya.

questions.exp: Praani jeevan ki vibhinn jaiv kriyaon ke sanchalan ke liye oorja ati aavashyak hoti hai. Vibhinn paaritantra me sanchalit khaadya shrinkhalaon me bhojan ek poshan star se doosre poshan star me sthanantarit hota hai; doosre shabdon me bhojan ke madhyam se oorja ka abhigaman vibhinn poshan staron me hota hai. Khaadya shrinkhala ke dauraan oorja ki maatra me kramik haas hota hai; agle staron me nirantar jaari rehti hai aur prakashit oorja ki sampoorn maatra dheere-dheere jaivik ghatakon dwara ushma me roopantarit ho jaati hai. Paaristhitik tantra me oorja ka pravaah ekdisha hota hai, chakriya nahi. Sarvapratham Lindeman ne 1942 ee. me paaristhitik tantra me khaadya shrinkhala ke dauraan oorja pravaah ke sambandh me bataya. Isliye (c) galat – badhte poshan staron ke saath sapekshik kshati badhti hai.

Aise genes jinka sahi paryavaran se anukoolan nahi ho pata, ve nishkriya ho jaate hain ya nasht ho jaate hain. Jaise kaale rang ki twacha utpann karne wale genes ushna katibandh pradesh me adhik sakriya rahte hain. Is prakritik chayan prakriya ka pratipadan Charles Darwin ne kiya tha.

Vah niyativaad ke prabal samarthak the. Apni pustak 'Sabhyata evam Jalvayu' me Huntington ne sansar ki aarambhik sabhyataon evam unke kshetra ki seema par sthit 21° Celsius ki samtaap rekha me sthapit kiya. Huntington ke anusar surya ki sthiti me parivartan ke kaaran hi jalvayu me parivartan hota hai evam jalvayu ka prabhaav saare kaarakon par bhi padta hai; ye maanviya kriya-kalapon par bhi paryavaran, vishesh roop se jalvayavik prabhaavon ke paksh dharte the.

questions.exp: S. Peterson ne prithvi ke chaaron or vyaapt vayumandal ko paanch lambavat mandalon me vibhajit kiya hai: (1) kshobhmandal (parivartan mandal) (2) samtaapmandal (3) ozone mandal (4) aayanmandal (5) aaytanmandal/bahyamandal. Vayumandal ki sabse nichli parat ko 'parivartan mandal' ya 'kshobhmandal' kaha jaata hai; ise Teisserenc de Bort ne naam diya. Vibhinn mausam sambandhi ghatnaein (vashpikaran, sanghanan, kuhra, baadal, os, paala, himvarsha, olavrishti, jalvarsha, baadal ki garaj, bijli ki chamak, tadit jhanjha, toofan, chakravat, hurricane, tornado, typhoon aadi) isi mandal me ghatit hoti hain. Kshobhseema (tropopause) kshobhmandal aur samtaapmandal ko alag karti hai; yah 1 se 1.5 km moti parat hai; iski nichli seema par jet pawanein chalti hain.

questions.q: The factor which does not affect Insolation is / वह कारक जो सूर्यातप को प्रभावित नहीं करता है-
o: Angle of inclination of Sun's rays / सूर्य किरणों का नति कोण
questions.exp: Vayumandal tatha prithvi ki ushma ka pradhan srot surya hai. Saur oorja ko hi 'suryatap' (insolation) kehte hain. Dharatal par suryatap ki prapt maatra bhoomadhya rekha se dhruvon ki or parivartit hoti hai. Suryatap ko prabhavit karne wale kaarak: (1) surya ki kiranon ka saapeksh tirchhapan (2) din ki avadhi (3) prithvi se surya ki doori (4) saur kalank (5) vayumandal ka prabhav (pratyavartan, avashoshan, prakeernan) (6) ghoornan (7) parikraman. Prachalit pawan suryatap ko prabhavit nahi karti.

questions.q: The gas which has third highest percentage in dry air composition in lower atmosphere, is / वह गैस जिसका निचले वायुमण्डल में शुष्क वायु में प्रतिशत मात्रा में तीसरा सर्वाधिक है-
questions.exp: Prithvi ke chaaron taraf kai sau kilometre se hazaron kilometre ki motai me vyaapt gaseeya aavaran ko vayumandal kehte hain. Shushk vayu me gaison ka pratishat (dravyamaan): nitrogen 78.8, oxygen 20.95, argon 0.93, carbon dioxide 0.03, neon 0.002, helium 0.0005, krypton 0.0001, xenon 0.00009, hydrogen 0.00005. Vayumandal me upasthit akriya gaison me sarvadhik maatra argon (0.93%) ki hai.

questions.q: The layer(s) of the atmosphere, known as Appleton layer, is/are / वायुमण्डल की परत/परतें, जो अप्लीटन परत के नाम से जानी जाती है, वह है/हैं-
o: F1 & F2- layers / F1 & F2 - परतें
questions.exp: Aayan mandal (ionosphere) ka vistaar saagar tal se 80 se 640 km ke beech paaya jaata hai. Is mandal me oonchai ke saath kai paraton ka nirdharan kiya gaya hai: D, E, F tatha G parat. F parat ka vibhajan do up paraton me hua hai; F1 tatha F2 paraton ko sammilit roop se Appleton parat ke naam se jaana jaata hai; yah 150 se 380 km oonchai tak paayi jaati hai. D parat 80–99 km (nimn aavritti radio tarangon ko paravartit), E parat 'Kennelly-Heaviside' (99–130 km), F parat madhyam evam ucch aavritti radio tarangon ko paravartit karti hai, G parat 400 km se oopar.

questions.q: The term "air drainage" refers to / वायु अपवाह से अभिप्राय है-
o: Horizontal movement of air from cold to hot place / ठण्डे स्थान से गर्म स्थान की ओर वायु की क्षैतिज गति
Horizontal movement of airmass from cold to hot region / ठण्डे प्रदेश से गर्म प्रदेश की ओर वायुराशि की क्षैतिज गति
Cyclic inflow of air towards the centre of a cyclone / चक्रवात के केन्द्र की ओर वायु का चक्रीय अन्तर्वाह
Moving down of cold air along slopes from mountain top into the valley / ढाल के सहारे ठण्डी वायु की पर्वतशिखर से घाटी में नीचे की ओर गति
questions.exp: Parvat shikhar se dhaal ke sahare ghaati me thandi vayu ka neeche ki or sancharan ko vayu apvaah (air drainage) kehte hain. Raat ki samay parvateey dhaal thande ho jaate hain aur vayu dhaal se neeche utarti hai jise parvatiya sameer kehte hain. Ucch pathar tatha him kshetron se ghaati me behne wali thandi vayu ko avarohi (katabatic) pawanein kehte hain. Din ke samay parvateey pradeshon me dhaal garm ho jaate hain aur vayu dhaal ke saath-saath oopar uthti hai; in pawanon ko ghaati sameer kehte hain.

questions.q: 100° Centigrade temperature is equivalent to ___ degree on Fahrenheit scale. / 100° सेन्टीग्रेड तापमान फारेनहाइट मापक पर ___ डिग्री के समतुल्य होता है।
questions.exp: Degree centigrade ko Fahrenheit me badalne ka sootra F = (9/5)×°C + 32 = (9/5)×100 + 32 = 180 + 32 = 212. Atah 100°C = 212°F.

questions.q: The annual range of temperature is calculated as- / वार्षिक ताप परिसर की गणना की जाती है-
o: Difference between annual maximum and annual minimum temperatures in the last 100 years
Difference between warmest & coldest monthly means of temperature in a year / एक वर्ष में सबसे गर्म तथा ठंडे महीने के औसत तापमान के अंतर से
Difference between daily maximum temperature in a year and daily minimum temperatures
Difference between average maximum and average minimum temperatures in last 30 years
questions.exp: Varsh ke 12 maheene ke ucchatam tatha nyunatam taapkramon ka ausat nikalne par ausat varshik ucchatam tatha nyunatam taapmaan maaloom kiye jaate hain. Ucchatam tatha nyunatam taapkramon ke antar ko taapantar (taap parisar) kehte hain. Ucchatam tatha nyunatam taap ke antar ko dainik taapantar, maheene ke antar ko masik taapantar tatha varsh ke ucchatam aur nyunatam taap ke antar ko varshik taapantar kehte hain.

questions.q: Find an incorrect statement regarding pattern of wind direction in cyclones and anticyclones. / चक्रवात तथा प्रतिचक्रवात में पवनों की दिशा के प्रारूप के संबंध में असत्य कथन छाँटिये-
o: Winds blow anticlockwise in a cyclone in the northern hemisphere
Winds blow clockwise in a cyclone in Northern hemisphere / उत्तरी गोलार्द्ध में चक्रवात में पवनों की दिशा घड़ी की सुई के अनुरूप
Winds blow clockwise in a cyclone in the southern hemisphere
Winds blow clockwise in an anti-cyclone in the northern hemisphere
questions.exp: Saamanya roop me chakravat nimn vayudaab ke kendra hote hain, jiske chaaron or sankendriya samvayudaab rekhaein vistrit hoti hain tatha kendra se baahar ki or vayudaab badhta jaata hai. Uttari golardh me ghadi ki suiyon ke vipreet (pratikool) tatha dakshini golardh me ghadi ki suiyon ke anukool hawaein chalti hain. Pratichakravat me kendra par ucch vayudaab hota hai; uttari golardh me inki disha ghadi ki suiyon ke anukool aur dakshini golardh me pratikool. Pratichakravat ko 'mausam rahit parighatna' kehte hain. Chakravat ke nimn daab kendra ko chakravat ki aankh (eye) kehte hain.

questions.q: Find out the incorrect statement in context of Sub-tropical high pressure belt from the followings / उपोष्ण उच्चदाब पेटियों के संबंध में असत्य कथन छाँटिये-
o: Temperature plays important role in formation of this Belt / इस पेटी के निर्माण में तापमान महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है
Low pressure develops in high altitude above the belts / इन पेटियों के ऊपर उच्चतल में न्यून वायुदाब विकसित होता है
These are dynamically induced pressure belts / ये गति जनित दाब पेटी हैं
These are also called as Horse Latitude / इन्हें अश्व अक्षांश भी कहते हैं
questions.exp: Dharatal ki satah par ya saagar tal par prati ikaai kshetra (jaise ek varg inch ya ek varg gaj) par oopar sthit vayumandal ki samast paraton ke padne wale bhaar ko vayudaab kehte hain. Glob par 7 vayudaab peti: (1) vishuvatreekhiya nimn (2) uposhna ucch (3) upadhruveey nimn (4) dhruveey ucch. Uposhna ucch vayudaab peti dono golardhon me 30°–35° akshanshon ke madhya; iska ucch daab taapmaan se sambandhit nahi, prithvi ki dainik gati tatha vayu ke avtalan se sambandhit hai (gatijanya). Ise ashva akshansh (horse latitude) bhi kehte hain.

questions.q: Which of the following winds is associated with the Sahara desert? / निम्नलिखित पवनों में से कौन सी सहारा मरुस्थल से संबंधित है?
questions.exp: Haboob dakshini Sahara khaaskar Sudan me chalne wali dhool bhari garm evam nam hawa hai; yah greeshm kaal ke praarambh me adhik sakriya. Alps parvat ke dakshini dhaal se oopar chadhne wali hawa uttari dhaal ke sahare neeche utarti hai to garm aur shushk ho jaati hai; use Foehn kehte hain – Switzerland me prabhav, basant ritu me pighlaav, angoor ki fasal paknaa. Berg – dakshini Africa ki sthaniya garm hawa; Santa Ana – California; Khamsin – Misra ke uttari bhaag; Chinook – Rocky ke poorvi dhaal.

questions.q: Which of the following is a cold gusty wind of adriatic coast? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एड्रियाटिक तट की ठंडी तेज हवा है?
questions.exp: Bora ek shushk tatha ati thandi prachand hawa hai jo Adriatic saagar ke poorvi kinare par chalti hai. Khaaskar uttari Italy ka bhaag Bora dwara adhik prabhavit hota hai. Harmattan – Sahara registan ke poorvi bhaag me uttar-poorv tatha poorv disha se paschim disha me chalne wali garm tatha shushk hawa; Guinea tat par ise 'doctor pawan' kehte hain. Mistral – France ki Rhone ghati, Levanter – Spain, Buran – Rus evam madhya Asia ki thandi hawaein.

questions.q: Which of the followings are low clouds? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन से मेघ निचले मेघ हैं?
questions.exp: Baadalon me paryaapt bhinnata paayi jaati hai. 1932 ee. me antarrashtriya vibhajan me in sabhi kaarakon ko dhyan me rakhkar baadalon ko chaar pramukh tatha 10 up-prakaaron me vibhajit kiya: (A) ucch megh (6000–20,000 m): pakshabh, pakshabh stari, pakshabh kapasi; (B) madhya megh (2500–6000 m): madhya stari, madhya kapasi; (C) nimn megh (2500 m tak): stari kapasi, stari, varsha stari; (D) kapasi, kapasi-varsha megh. Vishuvatreekhiya kshetra me sanvahan ke baad kapasi megh banta hai.

questions.q: The unit to express absolute humidity is / निरपेक्ष आर्द्रता को प्रदर्शित करने की इकाई है-
o: Grams per cubic metre / ग्राम प्रति घन मीटर
Grams per kilogram / ग्राम प्रति किलोग्राम
Grams per cubic feet / ग्राम प्रति घन फीट
questions.exp: Vayu ke nishchit aaytan par usme upasthit kul nami ki maatra ko nirapeksh aardrata (absolute humidity) kehte hain. Yah aardrata vayu ke nishchit aaytan me jalvashp ke bhaar ko pradarshit karti hai. Ise prati ghan foot me grain tatha prati ghan centimetre me gram ke roop me pradarshit karte hain; atah ise 'gram prati ghan metre' me vyakt kiya jaata hai. Bhoomadhya rekha se dhruvon ki or tatha saagar tat se mahadweepon ke aantarik bhaagon ki or nirapeksh aardrata ki maatra ghatti jaati hai. Sheetkaal ki apeksha greeshmakaal me tatha raat ki apeksha din me nirapeksh aardrata adhik hoti hai.

questions.q: ___ clouds develop along the cold front in an Extra Tropical cyclone. / बहिरूष्ण कटिबंधीय चक्रवात में ठण्डे वाताग्र के सहारे बनने वाले मेघ ___ होते हैं।
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (c). Ve chakravateey vayu pranaliyan, jo ushna katibandh se door, madhya va ucch akshanshon me viksit hoti hain, unhe bahiroshna ya sheetoshn katibandheey chakravat kehte hain. Thanda vayu aakrami roop me ushna vayu ke neeche ghus kar use oopar uthata hai; isse pehle sheet vatagra par kapasi megh dikhte hain aur varsha hoti hai. Sheetoshn chakravaton ki utpatti se sambandhit 'dhruveey vatagra siddhant' ka pratipadan Bjerknes ne kiya. (Dhyan do: kai paathya pustakon me sheet vatagra par kapasi-varsha (cumulonimbus) megh bataye jaate hain.)

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a green house gas? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी हरित गृह गैस नहीं है?
questions.exp: Harit grih gas ka arth vatavaran ki un gaison se hai jo prakritik evam maanav janit dono hoti hain. Ye avarakt vikiran ko avashoshit karti hain evam punah chhodti hain. Vartamaan me chinta ka vishay mukhya green house gaisein: carbon dioxide (CO2), chlorofluorocarbon (CFC), methane (CH4), nitrous oxide (N2O) aadi. Kuch anya gaisein jaise nitric oxide (NO) aur carbon monoxide (CO) bhi greenhouse gaison se pratikriya karke unke sandran ko prabhavit karti hain. Oxygen green house gas nahi.

questions.q: The Cocos-Ridge is situated in the ___ / कोकोस कटक ___ में स्थित है।
questions.exp: Poorvi Prashant mahasagar me Cocos katak madhya America ke sthal damrumadhya se dakshin-paschim ki or Galapagos dweep tak vistrit hai. Isi dweep ke dakshin me ek vistrit pathar (dakshin-poorv Prashant pathar) Prashant-Antarctic basin tatha dakshin-poorv Prashant basin ko paraspar alag karta hai. Punah Prashant-Antarctic shreni dakshini-poorvi Prashant pathar se nikal kar 180° deshantar ke nikat Antarctica tak faili hai. Anya: Albatross pathar (poorvi Prashant katak), New Zealand katak, Queensland pathar (Lord Howe), Hawaii katak.

questions.q: The largest continental shelf is / वृहदतम महाद्वीपीय मग्नतट है-
questions.exp: Mahadweepon ke kinare wala bhaag jo mahasagariya jal me dooba rehta hai, uska ausat gahrai 100 fathom (1 fathom = 6 feet) tatha dhaal 1° se 3° ke beech hota hai; ise 'mahadweepiya magnatat' kehte hain. Magnaton ki chaudai par tateey sthaleey ucchavachan ka niyantran rehta hai. Saamanya roop se magnaton ki chaudai 70 km hoti hai. Udaharanarth, Siberia ke tateey kshetron ke nikat mahadweepiya magnatat 1500 km tak paayi jaati hai jo sarvadhik vistrit hai.

questions.q: The deepest point in the Atlantic ocean is / अन्ध महासागर में सबसे गहरा बिन्दु है-
questions.exp: Mahasagariya garta mahasagaron ke sabse gahre bhaag hote hain, jo mahasagariya nital ke lagbhag 7 pratishat bhaag par faile hue hain. Inki sthiti praayah tat ke sahare parvateey mekhalaon ke saamne milti hai. Atlantic mahasagar ke taton ke sahare abhinav valan ki anupasthiti ke kaaran garta kam hain; Murray ke anusaar 3000 fathom se adhik gahrai ke 19 garta – Nares, Romanche, Puerto Rico, South Sandwich aadi. Atlantic ka sabse gahra bindu Puerto Rico garta (8385 m).

questions.q: The highest tides in the world occur in the ___ / विश्व में उच्च ज्वार ___ आता है।
o: Bay of Bengal / बंगाल की खाड़ी
Bay of Fundy / फंडी की खाड़ी
Bay of Biscay / बिस्के की खाड़ी
questions.exp: Vishwa ka sabse ooncha jwar-bhaata Canada ke Nova Scotia me sthit 'Fundy ki khaadi' me aata hai. Is jwariye ubhaar ki oonchai 15 se 16 metre ke beech hoti hai kyunki yahan par do ucch jwar evam do nimn jwar prati din aate hain; atah ek jwar 6 ghante 13 minute ke bheetar zaroor aata hai. Jwar-bhaata ki utpatti se sambandhit siddhant: gurutvakarshan siddhant (1687) – Newton; gatik siddhant (1755) – Laplace; pragami tarang siddhant (1833) – William Whewell; nahar siddhant (1842) – Airy; sthaitik tarang siddhant – R.A. Harris.

questions.q: The normal interval between the spring tides and neap tides is / सामान्यतः दीर्घ ज्वार एवं लघु ज्वार के मध्य ___ का अन्तराल होता है।
questions.exp: Surya tatha Chandrama ki aakarshan shaktiyon ke kaaran saagariya jal ke oopar uthne tatha neeche girne ko jwar-bhaata kaha jaata hai. Surya, Chandrama aur prithvi ek seedhi rekha me hone par poornima tatha amavasya hoti hai; is sthiti ko 'syzygy' kehte hain; in dinon vrihat jwar utpann hota hai. Pratyek maah me do baar (amavasya aur poornima) deergh jwar aate hain. Shukla paksh tatha krishna paksh ki saptami aur ashtami ko Surya aur Chandrama samkon sthiti me hote hain, isse laghu jwar utpann hota hai. Atah deergh jwar tatha laghu jwar ke madhya 7 din ka antaraal hota hai. Ek jwar se doosre jwar ke aane me 24 ghante 52 minute ka antar hota hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a cold current? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी ठण्डी धारा नहीं है?
questions.exp: Mahasagaron me jal ke ek nishchit disha me pravaahit hone ki gati ko 'dhaaraein' kehte hain. Taapmaan ke aadhar par do prakaar – garm dhaara evam thandi dhaara. Brazil ki dhaara ucch taapmaan tatha nyoon lavanata wali garm dhaara hai; iska aavirbhav dakshini vishuvat rekheey dhaara ke Sao Roque antareep ke nikat dakshin ki or mudne se hota hai; Brazil tat ke samanantar 40° dakshini akshansh tak pravaahit hoti hai. Benguela – dakshini Atlantic ki thandi dhaara (dakshin Africa ke paschimi tat); Humboldt – dakshini Prashant ki thandi dhaara (Peru dhaara); Falkland – Antarctic saagar ki thandi dhaara.

questions.q: The ocean current which is NOT a part of the North Atlantic Gyre is / महासागरीय धारा जो उत्तरी अन्ध महासागरीय धाराओं की चक्रगति (गायर) का भाग नहीं है, वह है-
o: North Equatorial current / उत्तर विषुवतीय धारा
questions.exp: Canary dhaara, uttari vishuvateey dhaara va Gulf Stream ki dhaara uttari Atlantic mahasagar me chakragati (gyre) ka nirmaan karti hain; Labrador iska bhaag nahi. Uttari vishuvateey dhaara 0° se 10° uttari akshansh ke madhya viksit hoti hai. Gulf Stream jaldhaara lagbhag 20° uttari akshansh ke paas Mexico ki khaadi se utpann hokar uttar-poorv disha me Europe ke p. tat tak pravaahit hoti hai.

questions.q: The part of the Mid Atlantic Ridge, north to the equator, is called as / मध्य अटलांटिक कटक का वह भाग जो विषुवत रेखा के उत्तर में स्थित है, कहते हैं-
o: Rio Grande Rise / रियो ग्राण्ड उभार
questions.exp: Madhya Atlantic katak ka vah bhaag jo vishuvat rekha ke uttar me sthit hai, use Dolphin ubhaar/katak kehte hain, tatha jo dakshin me hai use Challenger ubhaar. Madhya Atlantic katak uttar me Iceland se dakshin me Bouvet dweep tak 'S' akshar ke aakaar me 14,400 km ki lambai me faila hai. Iceland aur Scotland ke beech is katak ko Wyville Thomson katak kehte hain. Greenland ke dakshin me katak chauda ho jaata hai jise Telegraphic pathar kehte hain.

questions.q: The one from the followings which is NOT a East Atlantic basin, is / निम्नलिखित में से वह एक जो पूर्वी अंध महासागर की बेसिन नहीं है, वह है-
questions.exp: Poorvi andh mahasagar ki besinon me Canary basin, Spanish basin, Cape Verde basin, Angola basin, Guinea basin aadi hain. Labrador basin paschimi andh mahasagar me sthit hai; yah uttar me Greenland ke dakshini tat se dakshin me Newfoundland ke beech 4000 m gahrai tak 40° se 50° uttari akshanshon ke beech faili hai. Canary basin do vritakaar droniyon se milkar bani hai; Spanish basin Iberian prayadweep ke paas 30° se 50° u. akshanshon ke beech 5000 m gahrai; Cape Verde basin 10° se 23.5° u. akshanshon ke beech.

questions.q: Hypsometric curve is used to depict- A. Continental shelf B. Continental slope C. Deep sea plains D. Change in salinity of ocean / उच्चतामितीय वक्र द्वारा प्रदर्शित किया जाता है-
o: A and B / A और B
questions.exp: Sthal ki oonchai evam mahasagaron ki gahrai ko ucchtamitiya vakra (hypsographic/metric curve) dwara pradarshit kiya jaata hai. Is aadhar par saagariya nital ke chaar pramukh ucchavach mandal (relief zones) paaye jaate hain: (1) mahadweepiya magnatat (2) mahadweepiya magnadhaal (3) gahra mahasagariya maidan (4) mahasagariya garta. Lavanata parivartan isse nahi dikhaya jaata.

questions.q: Albatross plateau is situated in / अल्बाट्रॉस पठार स्थित है-
questions.exp: Albatross pathar jise poorvi Prashant katak ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai, Prashant mahasagar me 1600 km ki chaudai me vistrit hai. 23° se 35° dakshini akshanshon ke madhya iski do shaakhaein ho jaati hain, jiski poorvi shaakha Chile tat ki or chali jaati hai tatha paschimi shaakha Easter Island ridge ke dakshin ki or chali jaati hai.

questions.q: Match List-I (Ocean Current) with List-II (Ocean): A. Labrador B. Brazil C. Kuroshio D. Agulhas — i. South Atlantic ii. North Pacific iii. South Indian iv. North Atlantic / सूची-I को सूची-II से सुमेलित कीजिए
questions.exp: Labrador – uttari Atlantic; Brazil – dakshini Atlantic; Kuroshio – uttari Prashant; Agulhas – dakshini Hind mahasagar.

questions.q: Which among the following are trenches of Pacific ocean? A. Qurile B. Puerto Rico C. Karmadec D. Tonga / निम्न में से कौन से प्रशान्त महासागर के गर्त हैं?
questions.exp: Mahasagariya garta mahasagaron ke sabse gahre bhaag hote hain. Prashant mahasagar me 32 garton ki khoj ki gayi hai; inme se adhikansh paschimi bhaagon me hain. Aleutian, Tuscarora, Kuril, Japan, Bonin, Mariana, Tonga, Kermadec, Mindanao garta Prashant me hain. Puerto Rico Atlantic ka hai. Gahrai (m): Mariana 11,022; Tonga 10,882; Kuril 10,498; Kermadec 10,047; Aleutian 7,679.

questions.q: Which among the following are Siliceous Ooze? A. Pteropod B. Diatom C. Globigerina D. Radiolarian / निम्न में से सिलिकायम ऊज कौन से हैं?
questions.exp: Mahasagariya nital par avsaadon ke jamaav ko mahasagariya nikshep kehte hain. Silica ansh ki adhikta ke kaaran ise 'silicious ooze' kehte hain. Silicayukt ooze do prakaar ke: (1) Diatom ooze – diatom ooze ke nirmaan atyant sookshm paudhon ke avsheshon se; (2) Radiolarian ooze – radiolaria, diatom tatha foraminifera jeevon ke avsheshon se. Calcareous ooze me pteropod ooze aur globigerina ooze aate hain.

questions.q: A reef separated from the mainland or inland shore by a deep lagoon is known as / किसी गहरे लैगून द्वारा मुख्य भूमि अथवा अंतर्देशीय तट से अलग-थलग की गई शैलभित्ति निम्नलिखित में से क्या कहलाती है?
questions.exp: Praval ek prakaar ka saagariya jeev hai jo moonge ya coral polyps ke asthipanjaron ke samekan evam sanyojan dwara hota hai. Saagariya tat se kuch door, kintu usse samanantar sthit vrihadakar praval bhitti ko avrodhak praval bhitti kaha jaata hai; tat aur praval ke beech chhichhla lagoon hota hai. Vishwa ki sarvadhik avrodhak bhitti Great Barrier Reef hai, jo Australia ke poorvi tat ke sahare 9° se 22° dakshini akshanshon ke madhya 1200 meel (1920 km) ki lambai me hai. Aakriti ke aadhar par teen prakaar: tateey, avrodhak, valayakaar (atoll).

questions.q: Which one of the following stands at trophic level IV in a food chain? / खाद्य श्रृंखला में पोषण स्तर IV पर निम्नलिखित में से कौन आता है?
questions.exp: Paaristhitik tantra me aahaar poshan padanukram me sambandh hota hai. Yah poshan kai staron me sampann hota hai jinhe poshan star kehte hain. Aahaar tatha oorja ek jeev se doosre jeev me shrinkhalabaddh roop me sthanantarit hoti hai. Star I utpadak, II prathamik upbhokta, III dwitiyak upbhokta, IV tritiyak upbhokta.

questions.q: Nitrosomonas bacteria promotes transformation of ___ / नाइट्रोसोमोनास बैक्टीरिया ___ के परिवर्तन को प्रोत्साहित करता है।
o: Nitrite into Ammonia / नाइट्राइट को अमोनिया में
Nitrite into Nitrate / नाइट्राइट को नाइट्रेट में
Ammonia into Nitrite / अमोनिया को नाइट्राइट में
Nitrate into Nitrite / नाइट्रेट को नाइट्राइट में
questions.exp: Nitrikaran vah prakriya hai, jahan ammonia, nitrikari jeevanuon (Nitrosomonas tatha Nitrobacter) dwara nitrite evam nitrate aayanon me parivartit kiye jaate hain. Nitrikaran ek aaxikaari kriya hai. Nitrikaran ke dwara utpann nitrate ko punah paudhon dwara avashoshit kiya jaata hai. Nitrosomonas ammonia ko nitrite me tatha Nitrobacter nitrite ko nitrate me badalta hai.

questions.q: Tropical evergreen forests are also called as ___ / उष्णकटिबंधीय सदाहरित वनों को ___ नाम से भी जाना जाता है।
questions.exp: Ushnakatibandheey sadabahar vanon ko ushnakatibandheey varsha van ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. Vishuvatreekhiya pradesh me jalvayu evam prakritik vanaspati me poorn saamanjasya paaya jaata hai. Varsh bhar ucch taapmaan, ucch aardrata aur pratidin hone wali varsha ke kaaran sadabahar vanaspatiyan paayi jaati hain, tatha patjhad ka sarvatha abhaav rehta hai. Prakaash sanshleshan ke liye surya ke prakaash ki prapti hetu paudhon me aapas me hod rehti hai. In vanon me ebony, taad, baans, bent, mahogany, rubber, cinchona aadi.

questions.q: The monsoon forests are also called as ___ / मानसून वनों को ___ नाम से भी जाना जाता है।
o: Tropical Deciduous forests / उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती वन
Tropical evergreen forests / उष्णकटिबंधीय सदाहरित वन
questions.exp: Mansooni jalvayu pradesh me varsha ki mausami pravritti (seasonal regime) ke kaaran parnpaati (deciduous) prakaar ki vanaspatiyon ka vikas hua hai. Sheetritu ke ant tatha greeshm ritu ke praarambh ke beech sankraman kaal (patjhad kaal) me paudhe nami ke sanrakshan ke liye apni pattiyan gira dete hain. Mansooni pradeshon me varsha ki maatra me vishamata ke kaaran kai prakaar ki vanaspatiyan; 100 se 200 cm varsha wale kshetron me parnpaati vriksh – sagaun, saal, aam, sheesham, mahua; 50 se 100 cm wale bhaagon me ghaas ke saath parnpaati van.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a primary air pollutant? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्राथमिक वायु प्रदूषक नहीं है?
questions.exp: Pradooshan avaanchhit parivartan (unwanted change) hai jo vayu, jal tatha mrida ke bhautik evam rasayanik gunon ko badal kar sajeevon ke swasthya ko prabhavit karte hain. Prathamik pradooshak – ye ve pradooshak hain jo paryavaran me usi roop me pravisht hote hain jis roop me ye utpann hue hain, jaise carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide (CO2), sulphur dioxide (SO2), particulate, aerosol, asthir yaugik aadi. Sulphur trioxide prathamik vayu pradooshak nahi hai. Dwitiyak pradooshak – ye tab utpann hote hain jab prathamik pradooshak hawa ke kisi anya padarth ke sampark me aakar ek naye roop me parivartit ho jaate hain, jaise dhuan, dhundh evam kuhasa ka mishran (smog).

questions.q: Kyoto Protocol regarding Global Warming concerns was adopted in the year / वैश्विक तापमान वृद्धि से संबंधित क्योटो संधि को वर्ष ___ में अंगीकार किया गया।
questions.exp: Kyoto Protocol jalvayu parivartan par Sanyukt Rashtra roopreekha abhisamay ka vistaar hai. Ise 11 December 1997 ko apnaya gaya, jiski pushti 2005 me ki gayi. Yah ek antarrashtriya sandhi hai, jo sadasya deshon ko baadhya karti hai ki ve antarrashtriya star par khanan utsarjan me kami karein, jisse green house utsarjan me kami ke lakshyon ko poora kiya ja sake. Viksit rashtron ne green house utsarjan me sabse adhik yogdan diya hai.

questions.q: India joined the UNFCCC in the year ___ / भारत UNFCCC के साथ वर्ष ___ में जुड़ा।
questions.exp: Bharat (UNFCCC – Sanyukt Rashtra jalvayu parivartan framework sammelan) ke saath varsh 1992 me juda. UNFCCC ki neev 'Prithvi Sammelan' (1992) me padi. Yah 9 May 1992 ko hastakshar ke liye laaya gaya aur 21 March 1994 se prabhaav me aaya. Vartamaan me iske antargat kul 197 rashtra hain. Iska uddeshya vaishvik taapmaan parivartan aur iske nipatne hetu samadhanon ko khojna tha.

questions.q: Montreal Protocol regarding concerns for ozone layer depletion was an outcome of an international convention, held in ___ / ओजोन परत के क्षरण के प्रति चिन्ताओं के संबंध में तैयार मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल एक अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मेलन का प्रतिफल है, जो कि ___ में आयोजित हुआ था।
o: Rio de Janeiro / रियो डी जेनेरो
questions.exp: Ozone parat ke kshran ke prati chintaon ke sambandh me taiyaar Montreal protocol ek antarrashtriya sammelan ka pratifal hai, jo ki Vienna me aayojit hua tha. Ozone parat ki suraksha hetu vishwa star par Vienna convention 1985 me apnaya gaya. 1988 ee. me yah kaaryashil hua. Montreal Protocol 1987 me hastakshar hua; Vienna convention sarvbhaumik ratification prapt karne wala pehla convention bana.

questions.q: The Water Act, in India was first enacted in the year ___ / भारत में पहली बार जल अधिनियम वर्ष ___ में लागू हुआ।
questions.exp: Bharat me pehli baar jal adhiniyam varsh 1974 me laagu hua. Is adhiniyam ka uddeshya jal pradooshan ko niyantrit karna tatha is par nazar banaye rakhna tha; iske antargat Kendra aur Rajya ke pradooshan niyantran board ki sthapna ka praavdhaan hai. Is adhiniyam ke anusaar nadiyon aur kuon me pradooshan niyantran board ki sahmati liye bina kisi bhi prakaar ka dooshit jal chhodna aparaadh hai.

questions.q: Travelling from the equator towards pole, what would be the correct sequence of vegetation types you would encounter? / भूमध्यरेखा से ध्रुव की ओर यात्रा करते हुए, वनस्पति प्रकारों का सही क्रम क्या होगा?
o: Tropical Rainforest - Desert Scrubs - Tundra / उष्णकटिबंधीय वर्षा वन - मरुस्थली झाड़ियाँ - टुण्ड्रा
questions.exp: Bhoomadhya rekha se dhruv ki or yatra karte hue vanaspati prakaaron ka sahi kram: ushnakatibandheey varsha van → marusthali jhaadiyan → tundra. Ushnakatibandheey varsha van – yah vanaspati vaise kshetron me paayi jaati hai, jahan varshik varsha 200 cm se adhik hoti hai, taapmaan bhar ooncha (varshik ausat 24°C) evam vayu me aardrata 70% se adhik. Marusthali jhaadiyan – 50 cm se kam varsha wale bhaagon me. Tundra – mitti me nami ki dasha ke beech; moss, lichen, kai; vishwa ki kul paadap prajatiyon me se keval 3 pratishat prajatiyan tundra me viksit hoti hain.

questions.q: Which of the following ecosystem is known as 'The land of big games'? / निम्न में से किस पारिस्थितिक तंत्र को 'बड़े शिकारों की भूमि' का नाम दिया गया है?
questions.exp: Savanna paaristhitik tantra ko 'bade shikaaron ki bhoomi' ke naam se jaana jaata hai kyunki yahan haathi, zebra, giraffe, gainda aur hiran aadi vanya-pashu paaye jaate hain. Savanna ke ghaas ke maidanon me anek prakaar ke mansahari pashu bhi paaye jaate hain jinme sher, cheetah, tendua aadi vishesh ullekhneeya hain. Kenya ka pradesh me anek prakaar ke pashuon ke paaye jaane ke kaaran ise vishaal aakar wale ushna-katibandheey jaanvaron ka 'udyaan' bhi kaha jaata hai.

questions.q: Which among the following is NOT correctly matched? (1) Prairies - Canada (2) Pampas - Argentina (3) Downs - Australia (4) Llanos - New Zealand / निम्न में से कौन सुमेलित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Llanos Venezuela (Colombia, Guyana) me hai, New Zealand me nahi. Vishwa ke ghaas sthal: Savanna – Sudan (Africa); Campos (Campas) – Brazil; Cerrado – Brazil; Llanos – Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana; Sahel – Lal saagar se lekar Atlantic mahasagar tak; Pampas – Argentina evam Uruguay; Veld – dakshin Africa; Canterbury – New Zealand; Downs – Australia; Steppe – poorvi-Europe evam madhya Asia; Parkland – Australia; Puszta – Hungary.

questions.q: The maximum population size of a biological species that can be sustained in that specific environment is known as / किसी दिए गए पारिस्थितिक तंत्र में निवासियों की पोषित हो सकने वाली अधिकतम सम्भाव्य संख्या क्या कहलाती है?
questions.exp: Kisi diye gaye paaristhitik tantra me niwasiyon ki poshit ho sakne wali adhiktam sambhavya sankhya vahan kshamta kehlaati hai. Vahan kshamta ek jaivik prajati ka adhiktam jansankhya aakaar hai jise bhojan, aavaas, paani aur upalabdh anya sansaadhanon ko dekhte hue us vishisht vatavaran dwara banaye rakha ja sakta hai. Paaristhitikiya, jansankhya santulan se mel khaati hai, jab jansankhya me mauton ki sankhya janmon ki sankhya (aavrajan aur utpravaas sahit) ke baraabar hoti hai.

questions.q: Among the following climatic factors, which one has the least effect upon terrestrial ecosystem? / निम्नलिखित जलवायु कारकों में से, जिसका स्थलीय पारिस्थितिकीय तंत्र, पर सबसे कम प्रभाव पड़ता है, वह है-
o: Conditions of sunlight / सूर्यप्रकाश की स्थिति
Availability of water / जल की उपलब्धता
questions.exp: 'Paaristhitik tantra' shabd ka sarvapratham prayog A.G. Tansley dwara san 1935 ee. me kiya gaya tha. Paaristhitik tantra do prakaar ke – prakritik aur maanav nirmit. Sthaleey paaritantra ke antargat van, ghaas, marusthal, tundra aate hain. Sthaleey paaristhitik tantra taapmaan parivartan, suryaprakash ki sthiti tatha jal ki upalabdhta aadi se atyadhik prabhavit hota hai jabki pawan ka prabhaav is paaritantra par sabse kam hota hai.

questions.q: The Milankovitch cycle plays key role in / मिलानकोविच चक्र मुख्य रूप से प्रभावित करता है-
o: Cycle of erosion / अपरदन चक्र को
questions.exp: Milankovitch chakra mukhya roop se jalvayu parivartan ko prabhavit karta hai. Milankovitch chakra yah batata hai ki prithvi ki gati me apekshakrit maamuli parivartan grah ki jalvayu ko kaise prabhavit karte hain. American Museum of Natural History ke anusar is chakra ka naam Serbian khagol bhautikvid Milutin Milankovitch ke naam par rakha gaya, jinhone san 1900 ee. ki shuruaat me prithvi ke praacheen himyug ke kaaranon ki jaanch shuru ki thi.

questions.q: Leopold Matrix is associated with / लियोपोल्ड मैट्रिक्स संबंधित है-
o: Life cycle of cyclone / चक्रवात के जीवन चक्र से
Environmental Impact Assessment / पर्यावरणीय प्रभाव मूल्यांकन से
questions.exp: Leopold matrix paryavaraniya prabhaav aakalan ki ek vidhi hai. Is matrix me lambavat aksh ke sahare prastavit kaarya yojana se prabhavit hone wali paryavaraniya dashaon ko tatha kshaitij aksh ke sahare prastavit pariyojana se sambandhit kaaryon ko darshaya jaata hai. EIA ke pramukh charan: (1) jaanch (screening) (2) prayojan (scoping) (3) baseline adhyayan (4) prabhaavon ki bhavishyavaani (prediction of impacts) – yah EIA ka sabse takneeki charan hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT included under in-situ conservation? / स्व-स्थाने संरक्षण के तहत निम्न में से कौन सा शामिल नहीं है?
questions.exp: Jeev-jantuon evam vanaspatiyon ka unke prakritik aavaas me sanrakshan sva-sthane sanrakshan (in-situ conservation) kehlaata hai. Is prakriya ke antargat sabhi sankat prajatiyon ke liye anukool paaristhitiyan taiyaar ki jaati hain. Nuksaandayak kaarakon ka upchaar karke prajatiyon ke liye swasth paaritantra ka nirmaan kiya jaata hai. Sva-sthane sanrakshan baahya sthane sanrakshan ki apeksha sasta aur aasaan hai. Isme rashtriya udyan, abhayaranya tatha aarakshit jaivmandal sammilit hain. Vanaspati udyaan baahya-sthane (ex-situ) sanrakshan hai.

questions.q: The main cause for the depletion of ozone is / ओजोन क्षरण का मुख्य कारण है-
questions.exp: Ozone parat prithvi ke vayumandal (samtaap mandal) prakritik ozone gas ki mekhala hai, jo surya dwara utsarjit haanikaarak parabaigni kiranon (ultraviolet rays) se raksha ke liye kavach ka kaarya karti hai. Ozone ke kshran ke liye zimmedar sabse mahatvapurn kaarak chlorofluorocarbon (CFCs) hai. CFC ka nirmaan chlorine, fluorine tatha carbon ke anuon se milkar hua hai. Kshobhmandal me ye nishkriya hote hain, kintu samtaapmandal me parabaigni kiranon dwara inke vighatan se chlorine mukt hoti hai jo ozone ko nasht karti hai.

questions.q: Which of the following statements regarding an ecosystem is not correct? / पारिस्थितिक तंत्र के संबंध में निम्नांकित कथनों में कौन सा सही नहीं है?
o: It is a well-structured functional unit / यह एक सुसंरचित कार्यात्मक इकाई है
The entire biosphere is an ecosystem / सम्पूर्ण जैवमण्डल एक पारिस्थितिक तंत्र है
It has a spatial component / उसका एक स्थानिक घटक है
It is a closed system / यह एक संवृत्त तंत्र है
questions.exp: 'Paaristhitik tantra' shabd ka sarvapratham prayog A.G. Tansley dwara 1935 ee. me kiya gaya tha. Saamanya roop se jaivmandal ke sabhi sanghatak (jaivik tatha ajaivik) jo paraspar kriya me sammilit hote hain, paaritantra kehlaate hain. Paaristhitik tantra ki kuch visheshtaein: (I) yah ek sushanrachit kaaryatmak ikaai hai; (II) sampoorn jaivmandal paaristhitik tantra ka ek bhaag hai; (III) paaristhitik tantra ek khula tantra hai jisme padarthon evam oorja ka satat nivesh (input) tatha bahirgaman (output) hota hai; (IV) paaristhitik tantra ki utpadakta usme oorja ki sulabhta par nirbhar karti hai.

questions.q: The chemical compounds, other than water, in acid rain are / अम्ल वर्षा में जल के अतिरिक्त जो रासायनिक यौगिक होते हैं, वे हैं-
o: Nitric acid and Sulphuric acid / नाइट्रिक अम्ल एवं सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल
Nitric acid, Hydrochloric acid and Sulphuric acid
questions.exp: Varsha jal me amlon ki maatra me upasthiti ko amla varsha kehte hain. Jab vayumandal me nami ke saath sulphur evam nitrogen ke oxide pratikriya karte hain tab iska nirmaan hota hai. Aisi varsha ka pH maan 5.6 se kam hota hai. Varsha ka jal bhi poornatah shuddh nahi hota kyunki vayumandal ki carbon dioxide varsha ke jal me ghulne se kamzor carbonic amla ka nirmaan hota hai. Maanav janit sroton se nissrit sulphur dioxide (SO2) vayumandal me pahunchkar sulphate tatha sulphuric amla (H2SO4) ka nirmaan karti hai.

questions.q: Which of the followings is NOT an example of cultural map? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सांस्कृतिक मानचित्र का उदाहरण नहीं है?
questions.exp: Uchchavach maanchitra bhautik (prakritik) maanchitra hai, saanskritik nahi. Rajnitik, jansankhya aur parivahan maanchitra maanav-nirmit (saanskritik) visheshtaon ko dikhaate hain.

questions.q: If a distance on land is measured as 3 Furlong, 79 Yards, 2 Feet and 7 inches. Its equivalent representative fraction will be / भूमि पर एक दूरी 3 फलॉंग, 79 गज, 2 फीट एवं 7 इंच मापी गई है। इसकी समतुल्य प्रतिनिधि भिन्न होगी-
Which of the followings is not a correct conversion into statement scale of an R.F. 1 : 253,440? / प्रतिनिधि भिन्न 1 : 253,440 का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही रूपान्तरण नहीं है?
questions.exp: Pratinidhi bhinn 1:253,440 ka sahi roopantaran 1 inch = 7040 gaj, 1 inch = 32 furlong evam 1 inch = 4 meel me kiya ja sakta hai. Parantu 1 inch ka 21120 inch me roopantaran nahi kiya ja sakta. Note: 1 inch = 2.54 cm; 1 gaj = 3 foot; 1 furlong = 10 chain; 1 meel = 8 furlong.

questions.q: Find out the statement which is NOT true. / असत्य कथन को छाँटिए-
o: The latitude of a place is its angular distance north or south of the equator, measured along the meridian of that place from the centre of the earth
Lines joining places with the same latitudes are called parallel
The total number of parallels of latitudes, including the equator is 179 / विषुवत वृत सहित अक्षांश समानान्तर की कुल संख्या 179 है
The number of parallel of latitudes in each of the northern and the southern hemispheres is 90 / उत्तरी एवं दक्षिणी गोलार्द्धों में से प्रत्येक में अक्षांश समान्तरों की संख्या 90 है
questions.exp: Kisi bhi sthan ka akshansh us sthan ki vah koneeya doori hai, jo vishuvat vritt ke uttar ya dakshin, us sthan ke yaamyottar par prithvi ke kendra se maapi jaati hai. 0° akshansh se kheenchi gayi kaalpanik rekha bhoomadhya rekha ya vishuvat vritt kehlaati hai. Vishuvat vritt sahit akshansh par sthit sthanon ko milane wali rekha samantar kehlaati hai. Uttari aur dakshini golardhon me se pratyek me akshansh samantaron ki sankhya 89 hai. Vishuvat rekha dono golardhon ke madhya me ubhayanishth hai; atah kul akshansh samantar ki sankhya (89 + 89 + 1 = 179) 179 hai.

questions.q: Find out the statement which is NOT true. / असत्य कथन को छाँटिए-
o: The meridians of longitude intersect the equator at right angles
All the meridians of longitude are equal in length
The meridians of longitude are circles that converge the poles / देशांतरीय याम्योत्तर वृत्ताकार होते हैं, जो ध्रुवों पर एक बिंदु पर मिलते हैं
There is an international agreement to adopt the 0° meridian of longitude as the Prime Meridian
questions.exp: Glob ya maanchitra par uttari dhruv tatha dakshin dhruv ko milane wali kaalpanik rekhaein deshantar rekha kehlaati hain. Sabhi deshantar rekhaein lagbhag bhoomadhya rekha jitni lambi hain aur vrihat vritt kehlaati hain. Deshantar rekhaon ki ganana kisi bhi deshantar rekha se ki ja sakti hai. Pradhan deshantar rekha ke nirdharan ke liye Washington D.C. (USA) me ek sammelan ka aayojan kiya gaya jisme London (England) ke poorv me Greenwich namak sthan par sthit Royal vedhshala se guzarne wali deshantar rekha ko pradhan madhyahn rekha maana gaya. Deshantar rekhaein ardh-vritt hain, poorn vritt nahi; ye vishuvat vritt ko samkon par kaatti hain.

questions.q: Lexodrome is / लेक्सोड्रोम है-
o: A straight line drawn on Mollweide's projection, joining any two points having a constant bearing
A straight line drawn on Gall's projection, joining any two points having a constant bearing
A straight line drawn on Sinusoidal's projection, joining any two points having a constant bearing
None of these / इनमें से कोई नहीं
questions.exp: Mercator prakshep par kheenchi gayi pratyek saral rekha akshansh rekha ko ek nishchit kon par kaatti hai. Is prakaar koi bhi saral rekha deshantar rekhaon ko bhi ek nishchit kon par kaatti hai. Atah aisi seedhi rekha jo Mercator chart par do sthanon ko milati hai, ek disha naupath ya rumb line ya loxodrome kehlaati hai. Chunki pratyek rekhaon ki disha bhaugolik uttar-dakshin hoti hai, atah inhe kaatne wali pratyek saral rekha ek disha naupath hoti hai.

questions.q: Which statement is correct in context of Orthomorphic projection? / कथन जो यथाकृतिक प्रक्षेप के संबंध में सही है, वह है-
o: Scale is correctly maintained in this projection
Directions of all points are correctly represented in this projection

Shapes of different areas are portrayed correctly ignoring correctness of area in this projection / इस प्रक्षेप में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों की आकृति को सही-सही चित्रित किया जाता है क्षेत्र की शुद्धता की उपेक्षा करते हुए
This projection is also known as Equi-distant projection
questions.exp: Yadi maanchitra prakshep par kisi kshetra ki vahi aakriti aati hai jo us kshetra ki glob par hai, to us maanchitra prakshep ko yathakritik prakshep (orthomorphic projection) kaha jaata hai. Mercator evam trivim prakshep yathakritik shuddh aakriti pradarshit karne ke liye yathakritik prakshep ka upyog kiya jaata hai. Samudri yatra ke liye vayu disha, mahasagariya dhaaraein aur parivahan maargon ko pradarshit karne ke liye yathakritik prakshep ka prayog kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: The statement which is NOT correct in context of the Cylindrical Equal Area Projection is / कथन जो समक्षेत्र बेलनाकार प्रक्षेप के संबंध में सही नहीं है, वह है-
o: Equality of area is maintained at the cost of distortion in shape
Scale is true only along the 45° parallel of latitudes in this projection / इस प्रक्षेप में मापनी केवल 45° अक्षांशीय समान्तर के पास ही सही होती है
Polar parallel is equal to the equator
questions.exp: Samkshetra belanakar prakshep ko Lambert ka belanakar samkshetra prakshep bhi kaha jaata hai. Is prakshep me kshetra ki samanata banaye rakhne ke liye aakaar me vikriti laani padti hai. Is prakshep me dhruveey samantar vishuvat vritt ke baraabar hoti hai tatha yah yathakritik prakshep nahi hai. Samkshetra belanakar prakshep me maapni keval 45° akshansh samantar ke paas hi sahi hoti hai, yah sahi nahi hai; is prakshep me bhoomadhya rekha apni vaastavik lambai ke baraabar hoti hai, atah bhoomadhya rekha par maapni shuddh hoti hai.

questions.q: The number of series of the topographical maps, prepared in India, is / भारत में तैयार किए जाने वाले स्थलाकृतिक मानचित्र श्रृंखलाओं की संख्या है-
questions.exp: Sthalakritik maanchitra deerghmapak par banaya gaya bahuuddeshiya maanchitra hai jo bhootal ke chhote se bhaag ka pradarshan karta hai. Is par prakritik lakshan jaise dharatal, jal-pravah, vanaspati aadi tatha maanviya lakshan jaise gaon, nagar, sadak, railmarg, nahrein aadi ko vistarpoorvak darshaya jaata hai. Bharat me sthalakritik maanchitron ki do shrinkhalaein taiyaar ki jaati hain: (1) Bharat evam nikatvarti deshon ki shrinkhala; (2) antarrashtriya shrinkhala. Bharat evam nikatvarti deshon ki shrinkhala ke maanchitron ka vistaar 4° × 4° hota hai; maapni 1:10,00,000. Antarrashtriya shrinkhala 'one to one million sheets' – 1:10,00,000.

questions.q: Isohels are used to represent the status of ___ / आइसोहेल ___ के स्तर को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए प्रयुक्त की जाती है।
questions.exp: Isohel – samaan suryaprakash ke star ko pradarshit karne ke liye prayukt ki jaati hai; arthaat samaan suryatap avadhi wale sthanon ko milane wali rekha. Samudra ke andar samaan gahrai wale sthanon ko milakar kheenchi jaane wali rekha isobath; samaan varsha wale sthanon ko milane wali rekha isohyet; samaan meghachhadan wali rekha isoneph.

questions.q: A basic difference between Choropleth and an Isopleth maps is / वर्णमात्री एवं सम-मान रेखा मानचित्रों में आधारभूत अन्तर यह है कि-
o: Isopleth maps are prepared on basis of administrative boundaries whereas Choropleth maps are prepared on basis of natural boundaries

Choropleth maps are prepared on basis of administrative boundaries whereas Isopleth maps are prepared on basis of natural boundaries / वर्णमात्री मानचित्र प्रशासनिक इकाइयों के आधार पर बनाए जाते हैं, जबकि सम-मान रेखा मानचित्र प्राकृतिक इकाइयों के आधार पर
Choropleth maps are prepared only for cultural variables whereas the Isopleth only for natural variables
Choropleth maps are prepared with different colours only whereas the Isopleth are only black and white maps
questions.exp: Varnamatri evam sam-maan rekha maanchitron me aadharbhoot antar yah hai ki varnamatri maanchitra prashasnik ikaiyon ke aadhar par bane jaate hain, jabki sammaan rekha maanchitra prakritik ikaiyon ke aadhar par. Varnamatri vidhi dwara kisi vastu ki prati ikaai kshetra ausat sankhya ya pratishat moolya jaise jansankhya ka prati varg km ghanatva, krishi bhoomi ka pratishat, vibhinn rajyon me prati vyakti rashtriya aay, prati hectare utpadan aadi pradarshit kiya jaata hai. Sam-maan rekha maanchitron me jalvayu ke tatvon jaise taapmaan, varsha, vayudaab tatha pawan veg aadi ke vitaran dikhaane ke liye prayog hota hai.

questions.q: For the following three types of maps, identify the correct descending order based on the scale starting from the largest map scale / निम्नलिखित तीन प्रकार के मानचित्रों के लिए सबसे बड़ी मापनी से शुरू करते हुए अवरोही क्रम में मापनी के आधार पर सही अनुक्रम की पहचान कीजिए-
o: Atlas map - Topographical map - Cadastral map
Cadastral map - Topographical map - Atlas map / भूसम्पत्ति मानचित्र - स्थलाकृतिक मानचित्र - एटलस मानचित्र
Cadastral map - Atlas map - Topographical map
Topographical map - Atlas map - Cadastral map
questions.exp: Bhoo sampatti maanchitra (cadastral maps) – vrihat maapni par banaya gaya kisi graam ka maanchitra, jisme kheton ki seemaein, maarg, kuein, jalashay, saarvajanik sthan aadi ko dikhaya jaata hai. Sthalakritik maanchitra (topographical maps) – jahan bhoo-sampatti maanchitra me vyaktigat bhavanon evam kheton ki seemaein ankit hoti hain, vahin sthalakritik maanchitron me sthalakritik lakshanon – ucchavach, pravah pranali, van kshetra, jalashay, gaon, nagar, parivahan maarg aadi. Atlas maanchitra – ye maanchitra kaafi chhoti maapni par banaye jaate hain; praayah 1:20000000 se chhoti maapni par.

questions.q: Consider the following statements: A climograph is drawn with the help of the monthly data of A. Rainfall B. Relative Humidity C. Wet bulb Temperature / एक क्लाइमोग्राफ मासिक आँकड़ों की सहायता से बनाया जाता है-
o: A, B and C are correct
B and C are correct / B एवं C सही हैं
questions.exp: Climograph – kisi sthan ke ausat aardrabalb taapmaan evam aapekshik aardrata aankdon ko graph paper par ek-doosre ke saamne ankit kar banaye gaye aarekh ko 'climograph' kaha jaata hai. Is aarekh ko pehli baar 'Griffith Taylor' dwara banaya gaya tha. Is aarekh ko dekhkar kisi sthan ki jalvayu sambandhi saamanya dashaon ki jaankari mil sakti hai. Atah varsha ka climograph se koi sambandh nahi hai.

questions.q: Pole cannot be shown on which of the following projections? / निम्न में से किस मानचित्र प्रक्षेप पर ध्रुव को नहीं दिखाया जा सकता?
o: Cylindrical equal area projection / समक्षेत्र बेलनाकार प्रक्षेप
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (a): samkshetra belanakar prakshep par dhruvon ko nahi darshaya ja sakta hai. Bhoo-madhya rekha ke nikatvarti kshetron ke liye yah prakshep vishesh roop se upyogi hai; isme chawal, coffee, chai, cocoa, rubber, kela, nariyal, makka tatha ganna jaisi ushnakatibandheey faslon ka vitaran dikhlaya ja sakta hai. Ise Lambert ka belanakar samkshetra prakshep bhi kaha jaata hai. (Dhyan do: Mercator prakshep par bhi dhruv anant par hone ke kaaran nahi dikhaye ja sakte; samkshetra belanakar me dhruv ek rekha ke roop me dikhte hain – book ka uttar vivaadit.)

questions.q: Sten de Geer's method is used / स्टेन-डी-गीर विधि का प्रयोग किया जाता है-
o: To show the urban population by circles and rural population by dots
To show the urban and rural population by multiple dots
To show the urban and rural population by same dots
To show urban population by spheres and rural population by dots / नगरीय जनसंख्या को गोलों में तथा ग्रामीण जनसंख्या को बिन्दुओं द्वारा दर्शाने हेतु
questions.exp: Sten de Geer vidhi me nagariya jansankhya ko golon me tatha gramin jansankhya ko binduon dwara darshane hetu prayog kiya jaata hai. Kisi nagar ki jansankhya pradarshit karne wala gola bindu ki tulna me kam sthan gherta hai. Yah is vidhi ka sabse bada gun hai. Note: Sten de Geer ki 'Stillenbaurer' vidhi me gramin jansankhya ko samaan aakaar wale binduon ke dwara tatha nagariya jansankhya ko vritton dwara pradarshit karte hain.

questions.q: A device, used in Remote sensing Technique, that gathers electromagnetic radiations, converts it into a signal and presents it in a form utilizable for obtaining information about the objects under investigation, is known as / सुदूर संवेदन तकनीकी में प्रयुक्त वह उपकरण, जो विद्युत-चुंबकीय विकिरण ऊर्जा को एकत्रित कर उन्हें संकेतकों में बदलकर उपयुक्त आकारों में प्रस्तुत करता है, कहलाता है
questions.exp: Sanvedak ek aisa yantrik upkaran hai jo door sthit lakshyon, vastuon ya drishya kshetron ke sambandh me soochnaein ko aankne ke liye vidyut-chumbakeey ya anya oorja ko ekatra karta hai tatha unhe sanketon me parivartit kar upyukt roopon me prastut karta hai. Yadyapi sabhi sanvedak moolatah dharatal ke vibhinn lakshanon se paravartit vidyut chumbakeey oorja ki vibhinnataon ko spasht karte hain, parantu ve spectral pradeshon evam bando tatha soochna prapt karne ke dhang se bhinn-bhinn vargon me rakhe ja sakte hain.

questions.q: What does the word GIS stands for? / संकेताक्षर GIS किसके लिए प्रयुक्त होता है?
o: None of these / इनमें से कोई नहीं
questions.exp: GIS ka poora naam 'Geographical Information System' bhaugolik soochna pranali hota hai.
