GIS teen shabdon se milkar bana hai – (1) bhaugolik (geographic) (2) soochna (information) (3) pranali (system). Vaastav me bhaugolik soochna pranali (GIS) ka shabdik arth ek aisa tantra hai, jo bhaugolik sansar ki soochnaon ko darshata hai. GIS computer aadharit ek aisa yantra hai jiske antargat bhoo vidya ya prithvi ke dharatal ke aankdon athva soochnaon ki prapti, sangrah, prakriyan, parichalan, vishleshan, vyavasthikaran tatha pradarshan kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Which one from the following is NOT an important component of GIS? / निम्नलिखित में से GIS के महत्वपूर्ण घटकों में सम्मिलित नहीं है-
questions.exp: Prithvi ke kshetron ke baare me soochna ke sangrah, sanchayan, vishleshan va pradarshan hetu hardware, software, aankde (data), visheshagya, sangathanon tatha sansthagat vyavastha ke tantra ko bhaugolik soochna tantra/pranali kehte hain. GIS ke mahatvapurn ghatakon me aankde, sangrah, software, hardware, prakriya/pranali, prabandhan evam pradarshan aadi ko sammilit kiya gaya hai. Jansankhya GIS ka ghatak nahi.

questions.q: Which one of the following codes given for abbreviations correctly depicts landscape models? A. DEM B. DRG C. DLG D. DTM / निम्नलिखित संक्षेपाक्षर कोड में से कौन सा कूट दृश्यभूमि प्रतिदर्श (लैंडस्केप मॉडल) को सही-सही निरूपित करता है?
o: A and B / A एवं B
B and C / B एवं C
A and D / A एवं D
C and D / C एवं D
questions.exp: Digital Elevation Model (DEM) tatha Digital Terrain Model (DTM) sankshepakshar kood drishyabhoomi pratidarsh (landscape model) ko sahi-sahi niroopit karta hai. DEM – yah model ek 3D computer graphics hai jo aamtaur par kisi grah (jaise prithvi) chandrama ya kshudragrah ke dharatal ka pratinidhitva karne ke liye oonchai data ka nirmit pratinidhitva hai; iska upyog aksar GIS me kiya jaata hai. DTM – yah model bhaugolik aakritiyon ko ubhaarne ke liye ek pramukh model hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is a GIS operation? / निम्न में से जी.आई.एस. की प्रक्रिया है-
questions.exp: Nimn me map overlaying GIS ki ek prakriya hai. Overlaying analysis operations GIS ki pehchaan hai; iske dwara maanchitra ke kai paraton ka vishleshan kiya ja sakta hai. GIS ek hi kshetra ke maanchitron ki do ya do se adhik vishyagat paraton ko overlay karna sambhav banata hai.

questions.q: Widely used active remote sensing systems include: A. RADAR B. LIDAR C. SONAR / व्यापक रूप में प्रयुक्त सक्रिय रिमोट सेंसिंग तंत्र में शामिल हैं-
o: A and B / A एवं B
A, B and C / A, B एवं C
A and C / A एवं C
B and C / B एवं C
questions.exp: Vyapak roop me sakriya remote sensing tantra me radar, lidar evam sonar ko shaamil kiya jaata hai. Radar (radio detection and ranging) ek sakriya sudoor sanvedan tantra hai jo vidyut chumbakeey spectrum ke laghu tarang bhaag me kaam karta hai. Radar me tarang doori 1 millimetre se 2 metre tak hoti hai.

questions.q: The sensitivity of a remote sensing detector to differences in signal strengths as it records the radiation flux reflected or emitted from the terrain is defined as / एक रिमोट सेंसिंग डिटेक्टर की संवेदनशीलता इसके सिग्नल सामर्थ्य को धरातल से परावर्तित या उत्सर्जित विकिरण प्रवाह के अनुसार विभेदित करता है, परिभाषित किया जाता है-
o: Spectral Resolution / स्पेक्ट्री विभेदन के रूप में
Radiometric Resolution / रेडियोमैट्रिक विभेदन के रूप में
Spatial Resolution / स्थानिक विभेदन के रूप में
Temporal Resolution / कालिक विभेदन के रूप में
questions.exp: Remote sensing detector ki sanvedansheelta iske signal saamarthya ko dharatal se paravartit ya utsarjit vikiran pravah ke anusaar radiometric vibhedan ke roop me vibhedit karta hai. Radiometric vibhedan sanvedak dwara nirgat sanket ke kul prapt bhaag ko kai bhaagon me vibhajit kiya jaata hai, jise pratyek star ko alag-alag roop me darshaya ja sake. Is prakaar dharatal ke lakshanon ke vikiran (chamak) ya paravartan me antar ke aadhar par bhed sthapit kiya ja sakta hai.

questions.q: What would be the number of grey values of an image if its radiometric resolution is '6' bits? / यदि किसी इमेज का रेडियोमैट्रिक विभेदन '6' बिट है तो इसका धूसर मान (ग्रे वेल्यू) होगी-
questions.exp: Yadi kisi image ka radiometric vibhedan '6' bit hai to iska dhoosar maan (grey value) '64' hogi. 6 bit = 2^6 = 2×2×2×2×2×2 = 64 grey maan; 8 bit = 2^8 = 256 grey maan. Adhik bit ucch vibhedan ke batate hain. IKONOS ka vibhedan 11 bit hai jo ab tak ke prayogon me sabse adhik hai.

questions.q: Remote sensing of terrain characteristics mostly based on / भू-भाग के लक्षणों का सुदूर संवेदन अधिकांशतः किस पर आधारित है?
o: on diffused reflectivity properties of terrestrial features
on conductivity properties of terrestrial features
on absorption properties of terrestrial features
on the emissivity property of terrestrial features / भूमागीय लक्षणों के उत्सर्जकता गुणधर्म पर
questions.exp: Bhoo-bhaag ke lakshanon ka sudoor sanvedan adhikanshatah bhoobhaageey lakshanon ke utsarjakta gunadharma par aadharit hota hai. Kisi padarth ke dwara vayumandal me chhodi gayi ushma ko utsarjit ushma kehte hain. Samaan taap par kisi vastu ki oorja ko vikirit karne ki kshamta tatha kisi kaali vastu ke vikiran pravah ki nishpatti ko utsarjakta kehte hain: E = Fr/Fb. Utsarjakta tarang-deergh par nirbhar karti hai; adhikansh padarthon ki utsarjakta 0.81 se 0.96 ke madhya hoti hai.

questions.q: The wavelength of visible light is / दृश्य प्रकाश का तरंग-दैर्ध्य होता है-
questions.exp: Drishya prakaash ka tarang-deerghya 0.4 se 0.7 micrometre hota hai. Film va photo sanvedkon se sanvedan ke yogya pradesh jiske oorja ka sabse adhiktam paravartansheel har band (0.5 micrometre tarangdairghya) sthit hai. Vidyut-chumbakeey spectrum ka yah vah prakaash hai jise hamari aankhein sanvedit kar sakti hain. Neela, hara, tatha laal teen drishya rangin avpravaas se sammilit hain; kisi vastu ki rangon ke prakaash ke paravartan rangon dwara spasht kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a GIS software? / निम्न में से कौन सा एक जी.आई.एस. सॉफ्टवेयर नहीं है?
questions.exp: Software, programon ka ek ekikaran hai jinhe vishesh upyog ke anuprayogon ke liye likha jaata hai. Iske dwara un kaaryon ko sampann kiya ja sakta hai jinhe karne ke liye ise upyog me samaayit kiya jaata hai. GIS ke pramukh software – ARC-VIEW, ILWIS, MAPINFO, ERDAS, PAMAP, EASI-PACE aadi hain jabki AUTO CAD GIS software nahi hai.

questions.q: GIS are designed to manipulate spatial objects, which one of the following is not a spatial object? / जी.आई.एस. की रचना स्थानिक तत्वों को मेनिपुलेट करने के लिए की गई है, निम्न में से कौन सा एक स्थानिक तत्व नहीं है?
o: An attribute data cell / एक लाक्षणिक डाटा सेल
questions.exp: GIS kabhi bhi kisi maanchitra ko usi roop me sangrah nahi karta hai aur na hi dharatal kshetron ke kisi drishya ya pratibimb ko hi sangrah karta hai. Balki yah aankdon ko sangrah karta hai, jinke antargat ekatra kiye jaate hain unke ichhanusaar drishya ya pratibimb nirmit kiye ja sakte hain. GIS me upyog hone wali soochnaon ko do vargon me baanta gaya hai: (1) dharatalaeey soochnaein (2) apradhan/lakshanik aankde. GIS me dharatalaeey soochnaon ka prastutikaran bindu aakriti, rekhiya aakriti evam bahubhuj aakriti ke maadhyam se ki jaati hai jabki laakshanik data cell ka upyog isme nahi hota.

questions.q: Which of the following waves is used by remote sensing technology satellites? / निम्न में से कौन सी तरंगें सुदूर संवेदन तकनीक के उपग्रहों द्वारा प्रयोग की जाती हैं?
questions.exp: Taapiya avarakt tarangein sudoor sanvedan takneeki ke upgrahon dwara prayog ki jaati hain. Taapiya avarakt band 8 se 14 micrometre tarang dairghya ke madhya ka bhaag hai. Is band me sudoor sanvedak ko jo oorja prapt hoti hai, vah prithvi ke dharatal se taapiya utsarjan ke kaaran hoti hai. Taapiya avarakt sanvedak adrishya pradesh ki sanvedana ko ankit karta hai.

questions.q: Which among the following is NOT a Raster File format? / निम्न में से कौन सा एक रास्टर फाइल फॉर्मेट नहीं है?
questions.exp: ECW, BMP, TIFF ek raster file format hai jabki SVG raster file format nahi hai. Raster aadharit model space ya sthan se sambandh rakhta hai jinhe chaarkhanedar cell ke roop me pradarshit karte hain. Yah ek aise bhaugolik aankdon ko pradarshit karne wala dharatal aadharit model hai pratyek cell kisi record ke saath sambandhit hota hai jo kisi lakshya ki pehchaan karta hai. Pratyek cell ek pixel kehlaata hai.

questions.q: When atmospheric particles diameter is equal to the wavelength of radiation, it is known as / जब वायुमंडलीय कणों का व्यास विकिरण के तरंगदैर्ध्य के बराबर होता है तो यह कहलाता है-
o: None of these / इनमें से कोई नहीं
questions.exp: Jab vayumandaleey kanon ka vyas vikiran ke tarangdairghya ke baraabar hota hai to yah mie prakeernan kehlaata hai. Vayumandal me vidyamaan jalvashp tatha dhoolkan is prakaar ke prakeernan ke mukhya kaaran hain. Note: vayumandaleey prakeernan karne wale kanon ke aadhar par ise teen bhaagon me baanta gaya hai: (1) Rayleigh prakeernan (2) Mie prakeernan (3) avarnatmak prakeernan (non-selective).

questions.q: Which of the following is a measure of distribution of income developed by an Italian Statistician? / निम्नलिखित में इटली के एक सांख्यिकीविद् द्वारा आय के वितरण मापन हेतु विकसित की गई विधि है-
o: Gini coefficient method / गिनी गुणांक विधि
questions.exp: Gini gunank Italy ke sankhyikivid Corrado Gini dwara 1912 me viksit aay vitaran ki asamanata maapne ki vidhi hai. Iska maan 0 (poorn samanata) se 1 (poorn asamanata) ke beech hota hai.

questions.q: The Karl Pearson's coefficient of correlation is also known as / कार्ल पियर्सन का सहसंबंध गुणांक ___ के नाम से भी जाना जाता है।
o: Product moment correlation coefficient / गुणन आघूर्ण सहसंबंध गुणांक
Deviation coefficient correlation / विचलन गुणांक सहसंबंध
By-product of standard deviation / मानक विचलन का सह उत्पाद
questions.exp: Aayog ne is prashn ka uttar (b) maana hai (book note: book ke anusaar sahi vikalp (c) hai). Karl Pearson ka sahsambandh gunank 'product moment correlation coefficient' ke naam se bhi prasiddh hai. Karl Pearson mahoday ne sabse pehle is saapeksh maap ka prayog kiya. Maanak vichalan gunank tatha vichran gunank vastutah apkiran ki ek hi maap ke do alag-alag roop hain.

questions.q: Find out the statement from the followings which is NOT correct / निम्नलिखित में से वह कथन जो सही नहीं है, को छाँटिये-
o: The sum of deviations of items about arithmetic mean is always equal to zero
Arithmetic mean is affected by extreme values

The methods of calculating arithmetic mean are different in case of exclusive, inclusive and unequal class intervals / अपवर्जी, समावेशी एवं असमान वर्ग अंतराल की स्थितियों में समांतर माध्य का परिकलन भिन्न-भिन्न तरीके से होता है
Calculation of arithmetic mean is based on all the observations
questions.exp: Samantar madhya se madon ke vichalan ka yog sada shoonya ke baraabar hota hai. Samantar madhya charam moolyon dwara prabhavit hota hai. Samantar madhya ka parikalan sabhi preekshanon par aadharit hota hai. Ganitiya madhyon me samantar madhya sabse mahatvapurn, upyogi evam lokpriya hai. Apvarji, samaveshi aur asamaan varg antaraal ki sthitiyon me samantar madhya ka parikalan bhinn-bhinn tareeke se nahi hota.

questions.q: Find out the statement from the followings which is NOT correct / निम्नलिखित में से वह कथन जो सही नहीं है, को छाँटिये-
o: Median remains unaffected if the size of the largest value changes
Median divides the distribution into two equal parts
The median of a distribution is its first quartile as well / किसी वितरण प्रारूप की माध्यिका उसका प्रथम चतुर्थक होती है
Mean and median are the same in a precisely symmetrical distribution
questions.exp: Kisi vitaran praroop ki madhyika uske adhiktam moolya wale maan me parivartan se aprabhavit rehti hai. Kisi vitaran praroop ki madhyika use do samaan bhaagon me baant deti hai. Poorn samroop vitaran ka madhya va madhyika samaan hote hain. Kisi samank-shreni ke moolyon ko aarohi athva avarohi kram me vyavasthit karne ke pashchat jo moolya shreni ke madhya me sthit hota hai use shreni ki madhyika kehte hain. Madhyika prathamik chaturthak nahi, dwitiya chaturthak hai.

questions.q: Dispersion in statistics refers to / सांख्यिकी में परिक्षेपण दर्शाता है-
o: The extent to which values in a distribution differ from the average of the distribution / वितरण मूल्यों का मान वितरण के औसत मान से कितना भिन्न है
The extent to which values in a distribution depend upon the average of the distribution
Explanation about why values in a distribution differ from the average
Examine the reasons of difference between values in a distribution and their average
questions.exp: Sankhyiki me parikshepan yah darshata hai ki vitaran moolyon ka maan vitaran ke ausat maan se kitna bhinn hai. Isme kendriya pravritti maap ya ausat pratinidhik maap to hota hai kintu yah maan aankdon me vidyamaan parivartansheelta ko nahi darshata hai. Doosre shabdon me ausat vitaran ke keval ek pahlu ke baare me batata hai. Parikshepan ke maap aankdon ke vikheraav ke baare me batate hain aur vitaran ke maamle me behtar jaankari pradaan karte hain.

questions.q: The relationship of mean, mode, median is shown as / माध्य, माध्यिका व बहुलक के मध्य सम्बन्ध है
questions.exp: Madhya, madhyika va bahulak ke madhya paraspar nishchit sambandh hota hai. Yadi aavritti vitaran sammit hai to inke teeno ka moolya samaan hota hai tatha iske vipreet yadi shreni me aavritti vitaran asammit hai to inke moolyon me antar hota hai. Madhya − bahulak = 3 (madhya − madhyika); arthaat Z = 3M − 2X̄. Kisi asammit baarambarta vitaran ke samantar madhya, bahulak va madhyika me kinhi do maan diye ho to teesre ka maan gyaat kiya ja sakta hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is a relative measure of dispersion? / निम्न में से कौन सा परिक्षेपण का सापेक्षिक माप है?
questions.exp: Parikshepan ka saapekshik maap vichran gunank hota hai. Maanak vichalan gunank tatha vichran gunank vastutah apkiran ki ek hi maap ke do alag-alag roop hain. Maanak vichalan ki saapeksh maap ko maanak vichalan gunank kehte hain, tatha ise pratishat me vyakt karne par vichran gunank kehlaata hai. Vichran gunank ke aadhar par do ya adhik samank-shreniyon ke vichran ka tulnatmak adhyayan kiya jaata hai; jis shreni ka vichran gunank jitna kam hoga utni hi vah shreni adhik sthir, ek roop evam sajatiya maani jaati hai. Karl Pearson ne sabse pehle ise prastut kiya.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a measure of central tendency? / निम्न में से कौन सा एक केन्द्रीय प्रवृत्ति का माप नहीं है?
questions.exp: Samantar madhya, madhyika evam bahulak kendriya pravritti maap hain jabki madhya vichalan kendriya pravritti ki maap nahi hai. Kendriya pravritti ki maap se hamara taatparya samank-shreniyon ke saankhyikiya madhya se hai. Saankhyikiya madhya vah moolya hai jo poori shreni ka pratinidhitva karta hai. Kisi samank-shreni ke samantar madhya athva bahulak athva madhyika se shreni ke vibhinn pad-moolyon ke vichalanon ke samantar madhya ko madhya-vichalan kehte hain.

questions.q: A graph of cumulative frequency distribution is called / संचयी आवृत्ति वितरण का आलेख कहलाता है-
questions.exp: Yadi oordhvadhar aksh par baarambarta ke sthan par sanchayi baarambarta ke moolya likhkar koi aalekh kheencha jaaye to us aalekh ko ogive vakra ya sanchayi aavritti vakra kehte hain. Jab kisi varganter ki aavritti me usse poorv ke samast vargantaron ki aavrittiyan jod di jaati hain to use sanchayi aavritti vitaran kehte hain. Aalekh ke dando ki oopari bhuja ke madhya binduon ko seedhi rekhaon dwara mila dene se prapt aalekh ko baarambarta bahubhuj kehte hain.

questions.q: Which graph shows line of perfect equality? / निम्न में से किस ग्राफ में समान वितरण रेखा दिखाया जाता है?
questions.exp: Lorenz vakra graph me samaan vitaran rekha ko dikhaya jaata hai. Max Lorenz naamak ek prasiddh vidwan ne kisi samank-shreni ke apkiran (dispersion) ko aalekhi vidhi ke dwara pradarshit karne ke liye sabse pehle ek vishesh prakaar ka sanchayi pratishat vakra banaya tha, jise unke naam par Lorenz vakra ki sangya di gayi.

questions.q: Which one of the following values of correlation coefficient (r) is not correctly matched with degree of relationship? / सहसम्बन्ध गुणांक (r) का कौन सा मान सम्बन्ध श्रेणी से सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
questions.exp: Sah-sambandh ke parimaan ko sah-sambandh gunank ke dwara vyakt karte hain. Sah-sambandh ki shrenee ke shaabdik vivechan me 'ucch', 'madhyam' va 'nimn' shabdon ka prayog kiya jaata hai. Ucch stareey dhanatmak sah-sambandh, madhyam stareey dhanatmak sah-sambandh tatha nimn stareey dhanatmak sah-sambandh us dasha me kahe jaate hain jab sah-sambandh gunank ke maan kramashah +0.75 se 1, +0.25 se 0.75 tatha 0 se adhik va 0.25 se kam hota hai. 'r' ka maan kabhi 1 se oopar nahi hota.

questions.q: Which is NOT a methods of arranging deviations? / निम्न में से कौन सी विचलन-माध्य रीति नहीं है?
questions.exp: Paras (range) – kisi samank-shreni me sabse bade moolya (largest value) tatha sabse chhote moolya (smaller value) ka antar us shreni ka vistaar, parisar ya paras kehlaata hai: R = L − S. Madhya vichalan, maanak vichalan tatha chaturthak vichalan, vichalan-madhya reeti hain; paras vistaar seema vidhi ka bhaag hai. Paras ki upyogita: yah apkiran gyaat karne ki ek ati saral vidhi hai, jiske anusaar kisi sthan ya pradesh ki varshik varsha ke vistaar athva vahan ke dainik, masik ya varshik taapantaron ki ganana ki jaati hai.

questions.q: Which of the following are the examples of "Exclusive Class Intervals"? A. 0-10, 10-20, 20-30 B. 11-20, 21-30, 31-40 C. 10.5-20.5, 20.5-30.5, 30.5-40.5 D. 11.5-20.5, 21.5-30.5, 31.5-40.5 / "अपवर्जी वर्गान्तर" के उदाहरण हैं-
o: A & B are true / A और B सही हैं
A & C are true / A और C सही हैं
B & D are true / B और D सही हैं
C & D are true / C और D सही हैं
questions.exp: Apvarji varganter/shreni (exclusive class intervals) paddhati ka upyog un shrinkhalaon ke liye kiya jaata hai, jisme ek varg ki oopari seema agle varg ki nichli seema ban jaati hai. Jaise: 0-10, 10-20, 20-30; 10.5-20.5, 20.5-30.5, 30.5-40.5; 5-10, 10-15, 15-20, 20-25. Isme oopari seema ko baahar rakha gaya hai, lekin nichli seema ko varg antaraal me shaamil kiya gaya hai. Nirantar charon ke data (avayav) ke liye yah vidhi sabse upyukt hai.

questions.q: Which value is NOT true regarding Nearest Neighbor Index? / निकटतम पड़ोसी सूचकांक के संदर्भ में कौन सा मूल्य सही नहीं है?
questions.exp: Nikatatam padosi soochkank (NNI) kisi bhi kendra ka uske sameep sthit kendra se kisi bhi disha me uska sambandh niroopit karta hai. Sarvapratham iska prayog Clark evam Evans ne san 1954 ee. me kiya tha. Is soochkank ki sahayata se bastiyon ke antaraal ko pradarshit kiya jaata hai. NNI(R) = R̄o / R̄e, jahan R̄o = ausat avalokit doori, R̄e = ausat apekshit doori. Nikatatam padosi soochkank ke sandarbh me 0, 1 va 2.15 moolya sahi hain (seema 0 se 2.15); −2 sambhav nahi.

questions.q: Which is NOT a comparative scaling techniques? / निम्न में से कौन सी तुलनात्मक स्केलिंग तकनीक नहीं है?
o: Verbal frequency scale / वर्बल फ्रीक्वेंसी स्केल
questions.exp: Tulnatmak maapni vah aalekhi maapni hai, jisme ek se adhik maap pranaliyon me dooriyan pradarshit ki jaati hain. In maapniyon ko banane ka uddeshya maanchitra me bhinn-bhinn maapon ki ikaiyon (units of measurement) jaise meel, kilometre, metre, gaj, kadam tatha pity aadi me dooriyan gyaat karna hai. Kabhi-kabhi in maapniyon ke dwara samay evam dooriyon ka tulnatmak pradarshan bhi kiya jaata hai. Tulnatmak scaling takneek me rank order, constant sum evam paired comparison aadi sammilit hain; verbal frequency scale nahi.

questions.q: Which of the following sampling method is based on probability? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्रतिदर्श प्रणाली संभाव्यता पर आधारित है?
questions.exp: Stratbaddh pratidarsh pranali sambhavyata par aadharit hoti hai. Pratidarsh adhyayan me samagra ki samast ikaiyon ka alag-alag adhyayan nahi kiya jaata hai apitu usme keval kuch chhanti gayi pratinidhi ikaiyon ke gahan adhyayan dwara samast ke liye nishkarsh prapt kiye jaate hain. Vaastavik adhyayan ke liye jo ikaiyan chuni jaati hain unhe pratinidhi ikaiyan athva pratidarsh ikaiyan kehte hain. Jis prakaar dainik jeevan me kisi vastu ke namoone ka pareekshan karke us vastu ki samast maatra ke lakshanon ki sahi-sahi jaankari prapt ki jaati hai.

questions.q: A researcher is interested in studying the prospects of a particular product in an rural area. What tool should be prefer for study? / एक अनुसंधानकर्ता किसी ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में एक उत्पाद विशेष की संभावनाओं के अध्ययन हेतु इच्छुक है। इस अध्ययन हेतु किस उपकरण को वरीयता देनी चाहिए?
questions.exp: Ek anusandhaankarta kisi gramin kshetra me ek utpaad vishesh ki sambhavnaon ke adhyayan hetu ichhuk hai to is adhyayan hetu prashnavali upkaran ko vareeyata deni chahiye. Prashnavali shaikshik evam samajik shodh ke kshetra me ek samanya shodh tareeka hai jise respondent ke paas dak dwara bheja jaata hai. Phir prashnavali ke sabhi prashnon ke uttar ke liye respondent se aagrah kiya jaata hai. Yah vyaktigat saakshaatkar se sasta padta hai. Isme hum kam samay evam kam kharche me hi ek bade kshetra ya jansankhya me apne vishay se sambandhit sarvekshan kar sakte hain. (Book ka uttar (c).)

questions.q: Which is the main objective of research? / शोध का मुख्य ध्येय क्या है?
o: To review the literature / साहित्य की समीक्षा करना
To summarize what is already known / पहले से ज्ञात का सारांश करना
To get esue esceesdemeiece degeree / अकादमिक उपाधि प्राप्त करना
To discover new facts or to make fresh interpretation of known facts / नये तथ्यों की खोज करना अथवा ज्ञात तथ्यों की ताजा व्याख्या करना
questions.exp: Shodh ka mukhya dhyeya naye tathyon ki khoj karna athva gyaat tathyon ki taaza vyakhya karna hai. Anusandhan ya shodh kisi bhi nireekshan ya vichaar ka kramabaddh evam vastunishth sameeksha hai jiske dwara kisi naye tathya ki khoj ki jaati hai athva kisi gyaat siddhant ka saamaanyeekaran kiya jaata hai aur antatah kisi parichalana ka niyantran hota hai. Shodh jaanch ki ek aisi prakriya hai, jisme hum chhupi hui cheezon ko saamne laate hain. Isme vaigyanik tareekon ka kramabaddh evam buddhimata poorn prayog kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Sampling error decreases with the / नमूना लेने में गलती निम्न में से किसके साथ घटती जाती है?
o: decrease in sample size / नमूने के आकार में कमी
increase in sample size / नमूने के आकार में वृद्धि
process of randomization / यादृच्छीकरण की प्रक्रिया
process of analysis / विश्लेषण की प्रक्रिया
questions.exp: Namoona lene me galti namoone ke aakaar me vriddhi ke saath ghatti jaati hai. Anusandhan kaaryon me namoone (sampling) ka mahatvapurn sthan hai. Is vidhi ke prayog se na keval samay evam dhan ki bachat hoti hai varan shodh ki jaane wali ikaiyon ki sankhya me kami ho jaane se anusandhan kaarya apekshakrit saral ho jaata hai. Anusandhaan vishay ke samuchit gyaan ke abhaav me athva galat dhang se chune gaye pratidarsh (namoone) ke adhyayan se samagra ke baare me prapt nishkarsh doshpoorn, bhraamak evam vaastavikta se poornatah bhinn ho sakte hain.

questions.q: Research ethics do not include / शोध नैतिकता किसे शामिल नहीं करती है?
questions.exp: Anusandhan ek seemit kshetra me kisi samasya ka sarvangin vishleshan hai, isme samasya ka gahan adhyayan kiya jaata hai jo nyaayanishth evam vastunishth pramaanon par aadharit hota hai. Yah ek lambi prakriya hai jisme dhairya ki param aavashyakta hoti hai. Anusandhan ke nishkarshon ki pushti pramaanon dwara ki jaani chahiye aur kisi bhi avishvasneey aur galat tareeke se iske nishkarshon par sampaadit nahi karna chahiye. Atah shodh naitikta me imaandaari, nyaayanishthata evam vastunishthata ko shaamil kiya jaata hai jabki vyaktiparakta ko shaamil nahi kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: The conclusions/findings of which type of research can not be generalized to other situations? / निम्न में से किस प्रकार के अनुसंधान के सारांशों/निष्कर्षों को अन्य स्थितियों में सामान्यीकृत नहीं किया जा सकता है?
o: Pure Science Research / शुद्ध विज्ञान अनुसंधान
Causal Comparative Research / कारणात्मक तुलनात्मक अनुसंधान
questions.exp: Varnanatmak anusandhan ke saaranshon/nishkarshon ko anya sthitiyon me saamanyeekrit nahi kiya ja sakta hai. Iske antargat hum spasht paribhashit samasya ka varnan karte hain. Yah vishesh roop se atyant kathin ya dono prakaar ka ho sakta hai. Yah 'kya' hai ko spasht karne ke liye uparyukt soochna ka sangrah karta hai, iske liye kalpanik niyojan aavashyak hai. Yah anusandhan sankhyatmak evam gunatmak dono ho sakta hai.

questions.q: Which among the following is NOT a consideration in selecting a research problem? / शोध समस्या के चयन में निम्न में से किसको दृष्टिगत नहीं रखा जाता है?
questions.exp: Shodh samasya ke chayan me moolyankan ko drishtigat nahi rakha jaata hai, jabki isme ruchi, prasangikta evam naitik mudde ko drishtigat rakha jaata hai. Isme samasya ke sabhi sambhavit samadhanon ke liye parikalpana ki jaati hai tatha inhi parikalpanaon se samasya ka samadhan hota hai. Parikalpana kisi bhi nireekshan ya ghatna ki ek prastavit vyakhya hai jiska prayogon ya kaaryon dwara pareekshan kiya jaata hai.

questions.q: Which among the following is NOT a method of primary data collection? / निम्नलिखित में से प्राथमिक आँकड़े संगृहीत करने की विधि नहीं है
questions.exp: Jo aankde kisi anusandhaankarta ya sanstha ke dwara pehli baar ekatrit kiye jaate hain unhe prathamik aankde kehte hain. Ye maulik roop se ekatrit kiye jaate hain. Prathamik ya maulik aankdon ko prathamik vidhiyon dwara prapt karte hain. In vidhiyon me paryavekshan (avlokan), prashnavali, saakshaatkar tatha anusuchi aadi ko sammilit kiya jaata hai. Prathamik aankde ekatrit karne ki anya vidhiyon me sudoor sanvedan (remote sensing) tatha vayu photochitra (aerial photography) vishesh ullekhneeya hain. Vyaktigat pralekh/jangadana dwitiyak aankde hain.

questions.q: What is the name of conceptual framework in which the research is carried out? / उस सैद्धांतिक ढाँचे का क्या नाम है जिसके अंतर्गत शोध संचालित किया जाता है?
o: Synopsis of Research / शोध का संक्षिप्त प्रस्ताव
questions.exp: Shodh abhishilp, us saiddhantik dhaanche ka naam hai jiske antargat shodh sanchalit kiya jaata hai. Shodh abhishilp ek aisi sanrachna ya roopreekha hai jo na keval adhyayan ko vyavasthit banakar usse sahi maarg pradaan karti hai varan adhyayan se sambandhit vivaadpoorn dashaon ko bhi niyantran me rakhne me sahayak hoti hai. Vaastav me jis prakaar kisi vishaal bhavan ka nirmaan praarambh karne se pehle uska vyavasthit naksha taiyaar kar lena aavashyak hai, usi prakaar anusandhan kaarya praarambh karne se pehle anusandhan praroop ka nirdharan atyant aavashyak hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a data collection method? / निम्न में से कौन सा एक आँकड़े संकलित करने का तरीका (विधि) नहीं है?
o: Postal Survey Questionnaire / डाक सर्वेक्षण प्रश्नावली
questions.exp: Ek aankde sankalit karne ke tareekon (vidhiyon) me shodh prashn ko sammilit nahi kiya jaata hai jabki asanrachit saakshaatkar, daak sarvekshan prashnavali evam anusuchi ko sammilit kiya jaata hai. Saakshaatkar vidhi ke antargat soochnadaata se vyaktigat sampark sthapit karke paraspar vaartalaap ke dwara aankde va soochna ekatrit karte hain. Prashnavali vidhi me anusandhaankarta anusandhan vishay se sambandhit samast prashnon ki ek prashnavali taiyaar karta hai. Anusuchi vidhi se shikshit evam ashikshit dono prakaar ke soochnadaataon se soochna va aankde prapt kiye ja sakte hain. Sarkar dwara jangadana ke aankde isi vidhi dwara ekatrit kiye jaate hain.

questions.q: A research report is brief of / एक शोध रिपोर्ट में किसका प्रस्तुतीकरण किया जाता है?
o: Data Collection / आँकड़ों के संग्रहण का
Data Editing / आँकड़ों के सम्पादन का
questions.exp: Ek shodh report me shodh prakriya ka prastutikaran kiya jaata hai. Anusandhan (shodh) ek prakriya hai jisme kramabaddh kaarya shaamil hote hain. Saamanyatah anusandhan ke 10 sopaan hain: 1. anusandhan samasya ka pratipadan 2. vistrit mudrit saamagri sarvekshan 3. parikalpana ka pratipadan 4. shodh ki roopreekha 5. sample ki roopreekha tay karna 6. data sankalan 7. data vishleshan 8. parikalpana ki jaanch 9. saamaanyeekaran evam vyakhya 10. nishkarsh evam riport.

questions.q: Which sampling technique is used if population is not homogeneous? / अगर समष्टि समरूपता नहीं रखता हो तो किस प्रतिचयन विधि का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.exp: Agar samashti samroopta nahi rakhta ho to stratbaddh pratichayan vidhi ka upyog kiya jaata hai. Stratbaddh pratichayan vidhi bhinn-bhinn gunon ya lakshanon wali ikaiyon ke samooh se pratidarsh chhantne me vishesh upyogi hoti hai. Kyunki iske dwara samagra ki bhinn-bhinn visheshta wali ikaiyon ke samoohon se pratidarsh chune jaate hain, atah ye pratidarsh samagra ka adhik vaastavik pratinidhitva karte hain.

questions.q: Plagiarism includes- A. Copy other's work without referencing B. Copy one's own work C. Publishing other's work in the name of oneself D. Republication of own work in another journal / प्लेजियरिज्म (साहित्य चोरी) में शामिल है-
o: A, B and C are true
A, B, C and D are true / A, B, C और D सही हैं
A, B and D are true
B, C and D are true
questions.exp: Plagiarism (sahitya chori) me bina sandarbh diye doosre ke kaam ki nakal karna, apne swayam ke kaam ki nakal karna, swayam ke naam se kisi doosre ke kaam ko prakashit karwana tatha doosre patra-patrikaon me apne poorv me prakashit kaam ka punah prakashan karwana aadi shaamil hai. Sahityik chori kisi aur ke kaam ya vichaaron ko aapki sahmati ke saath ya bina unki sahmati ke bina poorn swikriti ke aapke kaam me shaamil karke unhe apne kaam ke roop me prastut karna hai. Note: pareekshaon ke niyamon ke tahat jaanboojh kar ya laaparvahi se sahityik chori anusandhanatmak apraadh hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT a reference citing style? / निम्न में से कौन सी सन्दर्भ उद्धरण शैली नहीं है?
questions.exp: American Psychological Association (APA) aur Modern Language Association (MLA) patron, reporton aur academic nibandhon me prayog ki jaane wali mukhya udharan shailiyan hain. (APA) mukhya roop se samajik vigyan me prayog kiya jaata hai, jabki (MLA) ka upyog udaar kala aur maanviki sambandhi vishyon me kiya jaata hai. Chicago/Turabian shaili aamtaur par vyavsaay, itihaas aur lalit kala dwara upyog ki jaati hai jabki 'Harvard' sandarbh udharan shaili hai – 'HARWARD' naam ki koi shaili nahi.

questions.q: Which one of the following is a technique of multivariate analysis? / निम्न में से कौन सी बहुचर विश्लेषण विधि है?
questions.exp: Principal component bahuchar vishleshan vidhi hai jabki shesh teeno pramaap vichalan, saadharan sahsambandh tatha samantar madhya bahuchar vishleshan vidhi nahi hai. Principal component ek saankhyikiya prakriya hai jo sahsambandh visheshtaon ke avlokanon ko orthogonal parivartan ki sahayata se rekhiy roop se asambaddh visheshtaon ke ek set me parivartit karti hai. In nai roopantarit visheshtaon ko pradhan ghatak (principal component) kaha jaata hai.

questions.q: The term Geography was first coined by ___ / भूगोल शब्द का सर्वप्रथम प्रतिपादन ___ ने किया था?
questions.exp: 'Bhugol' shabd ka sarvapratham prayog (pratipadan) Eratosthenes mahoday ne kiya tha. Inhone bhugol ko ek alag adhyayan shastra ke roop me sthapit karne ka prayas kiya. Eratosthenes ne tatkaalin gyaat prithvi ko paanch katibandhon me vibhajit kiya tha – ek ushna katibandh, do sheetoshn katibandh tatha do sheet katibandh. Eratosthenes pratham vidwan the jinhone Egypt ke 'gnomon' ki sahayata se vishuvat rekha ki sahi lambai gyaat ki thi aur yah bataya ki prithvi ki paridhi 25000 meel hai (vastutah 24860 meel). Eratosthenes dwara likhi gayi pustak me vasyogya vishwa ko 'ecumene' kaha gaya.

questions.q: Who amongst the following has been called the founder of Geodesy? / निम्न में से किसे भूगणित का प्रतिपादक कहते हैं?
questions.exp: Eratosthenes mahoday ko bhoogaņit ka pratipadak kehte hain. Eratosthenes teesri shatabdi isa poorv me ek khyatiprapt ganitagya aur khagol vigyani the. Adhikansh itihaskar maante hain ki adhyayan ke ek prithak shaakha ke roop me bhugol ki sthapna Eratosthenes ne hi ki thi; isliye Eratosthenes ko 'bhugol ka janak' bhi kaha jaata hai. Inhone 'Geographica' naamak pustak likhi. Eratosthenes ne surya ki uttarayan aur dakshinayan sthitiyon ki vedh karke surya ke kraantivritt tal ki tirchhaput ki maap ki thi aur prithvi ki paridhi ki ganana ka ullekhneeya prayas kiya.

questions.q: Immanuel Kant, who propounded the "Gaseous Hypothesis" about the origin of the earth, was a/an ___ philosopher. / पृथ्वी उत्पत्ति के संबंध में वायव्य राशि परिकल्पना प्रतिपादित करने वाले इमैनुअल काण्ट ___ दर्शनशास्त्री थे।
questions.exp: Prithvi utpatti ke sambandh me 'vayavya raashi parikalpana' pratipadit karne wale 'Immanuel Kant' German darshanshaastri the. 1755 ee. me pratipadit yah parikalpana Newton ke gurutvakarshan ke niyamon par aadharit hai. Sarvapratham Kant ne yah maan liya ki praacheen kaal me brahmand me dainik aadya padarth bikhre hue the. Praarambh me ye padarth atyant kathor, sheetal tatha gatiheen the. Taap tatha bhraman gati ke parinaamswaroop praarambhik sheetal tatha gatiheen vayavya padarth ek tapt tatha gatisheel neeharika (nebula) me parivartit ho gaya. Note: Immanuel Kant mahoday ko aaram kursi wala darshnik bhugolvetta ke roop me jaana jaata hai.

questions.q: Geography was first divided into General and Special by / भूगोल को सर्वप्रथम 'सामान्य' एवं 'विशिष्ट' के रूप में विभाजित किया गया-
questions.exp: Bernhard Varenius pramukh German bhugolvetta the jinhone bhugol ko sarvapratham 'saamanya' evam 'vishisht' bhugol ke roop me vibhajit kiya. Saamanya bhugol me samast prithvi ke bhautik tathyon ka kramabaddh varnan tatha vishisht bhugol me pradeshik varnan kiya, jinme maanviya paksh ki pradhanta hai. Varenius mahoday un aadhunik vidwanon me se pratham the jinhone saamanya evam vishisht bhugol ke beech upyukt aadharbhoot antar ko apni pustak me spasht kiya.

questions.q: The approach in geography which states that actions are motivated by cognitive process is the sense of / भूगोल में वह दृष्टिकोण जो यह कहता है कि कर्म संज्ञानात्मक प्रक्रिया से प्रेरित होते हैं, यह सार है-
questions.exp: Bhugol me yah drishtikon jo yah kehta hai ki 'karm sangyanatmak prakriya se prerit hote hain', yah saar vyavaharvaad ka hai. Vyavaharvaad ke vikas me William Kirk ka yogdan mahatvapurn maana jaata hai. Vyavaharvaad ka moolbhoot sanghatak ya ghatna kriyavigyan (phenomenology) hai jo moolya nirpeksh aur vastunishth adhyayan ko maanta hai tatha manushyon ke anubhav evam sangyan ko adhik mahatva pradaan karta hai. Vyavaharpark bhugol me maanav vyavahar (aacharan) ko sarvadhik mahatvapurn maana jaata hai.

questions.q: Who from the following was NOT a Greek Geographer? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन यूनानी भूगोलवेत्ता नहीं था?
questions.exp: Herodotus, Homer, Eratosthenes Yunani bhugolvetta the jabki Claudius Ptolemy ek Roman bhugolvetta (book ke anusaar) tha. Ptolemy ek mahaan khagolshaastri bhi the, jinhone khagolshaastra ki prasiddh pustak 'Almagest' ki rachna ki. Avlokan, anveshan tatha lekhan dwara Ptolemy ne ganitiya bhugol, maanchitrakala aur saamanya bhugol ke kshetra me ati mahatvapurn yogdan diya hai. Kuch anya Yunani bhugolvettaon ke naam: Thales, Hecataeus, Plato, Aristotle, Pytheas, Polybius, Hipparchus, Posidonius aadi.

questions.q: The famous monumental work in Geography, known as "The Almagest", was scripted by ___ / भूगोल में एक स्मरणीय लेखन कार्य जो अलमागेस्ट के नाम से जाना जाता है, ___ ने लिखा था।
questions.exp: Bhugol me ek smaraneeya lekhan kaarya jo 'Almagest' ke naam se jaana jaata hai, jise Claudius Ptolemy ne likha tha. Ptolemy ki 'Almagest' naamak pustak khagolshaastra ki prasiddh pustak hai jo deerghkaal tak aakashiya pindon ki gatividhiyon se sambandhit jaankari ke liye maanak sandarbh granth ke roop me pratishthit raha. Ptolemy ne us samay tak gyaat sabhi mahatvapurn sthanon ki ganitiya sthiti ka nirdharan kiya tha. Ptolemy ke vishwa ke vishay me vistrit jaankari ke liye kai prakaar ke yantron dwara prekshan aur anveshan kaarya bhi kiya.

questions.q: The author of the book "Kitab-al-Hind" is / पुस्तक "किताब-अल-हिन्द" के लेखक हैं-
questions.exp: Bahu-aayami lekhak Al-Biruni khagol vigyan, darshan, bhugol, bhoogarbhshaastra, ganit, bhoo-aakriti vigyan, aushadhi vigyan tatha kai bhashaon ke gyaata the. Apni yatraon ke dauraan poorvavarti Yunani, Roman, Bharatiya vidwanon ki pustakon ke adhyayan, khule mastishk aur kathor parishram tatha vishisht lekhan dwara Al-Biruni madhyakaal ke mahatvapurn bhugolvetta ban gaye. Pramukh granth: 1. Kitab-al-Hind 2. Tarikh-al-Hind 3. Al-Qanun-al-Masudi 4. Athar-al-Baqiya 5. Kitab-al-Jamahir 6. Kitab-al-Saidana. Unhone Patanjali ke prasiddh Sanskrit granth 'Mahabhashya' ka Arabi bhasha me anuvaad bhi kiya tha.

questions.q: Who amongst the following was NOT a determinist? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक निश्चयवादी नहीं है?
o: Vidal de La Blache / विडाल डी ला ब्लॉश
Alexander von Humboldt / अलेक्जेंडर वॉन हम्बोल्ट
questions.exp: Diye gaye vikalp me Alexander von Humboldt, Carl Ritter, Demolins nishchayvaadi bhugolvetta the jabki Francisi bhugolvetta Vidal de la Blache sambhavvaad ke pratipadak maane jaate hain. Maanav-paryavaran sambandhon ki vyakhya me Blache 'manushya' ko pradhan maanate the. Maanav bhugol ko ek prithak vigyan ke roop me sthapit karne wale German bhugolvetta Friedrich Ratzel ne Darwin (1859 ee.) ke prakritik chayan aur prakritik avashishtavaad ka sweekaar kiya. Beesvi sadi ke pratham do dashakon me American bhugolvid kumari Ellen Churchill Semple Ratzel ki shishya tatha unke nishchayvaadi vichaaron ki prabal samarthak thi.

questions.q: The book "Britain and the British seas" was authored by ___ / "ब्रिटेन एण्ड द ब्रिटिश सीज" पुस्तक ___ ने लिखी।
o: Halford J. Mackinder / हैल्फोर्ड जे. मैकिण्डर
questions.exp: 'Britain and the British Seas' naamak pustak Halford J. Mackinder mahoday ne likhi. Mackinder ke bhugolvettaon Richthofen aur Ratzel ke vichaaron se bahut prabhavit the va niyativaad ke samarthak the aur unhone Britain me niyativaadi vichardhara ka prachar kiya. Mackinder ki anya rachnaein: 1. Itihaas ki bhaugolik dhuri 2. Loktantrik aadarsh evam yathaarth 3. Rashtra aur aadhunik vishwa 4. Gol vishwa evam shanti ki vijay.

questions.q: The famous script "Civilization and Climate" is written by / प्रसिद्ध कृति "सिविलाइजेशन एण्ड क्लाइमेट" के लेखक हैं-
questions.exp: Prasiddh kriti 'Civilization and Climate' ke lekhak American bhugolvetta 'Ellsworth Huntington' hain. Huntington ek mahaan vichaarak, lekhak aur khojyatri the. Ve ek maanvatavaadi pratibha ke dhani the. Unhone do darjan se adhik (28) pustakein aur lagbhag 30 pustakon me sahlekhan kiye. Kuch pustakein: Asia ki naadi (1907), Palestine aur iska roopantaran (1911), maanav bhugol ke siddhant (1920), prithvi aur surya (1923), prajatiyon ke lakshan (1924), aarthik bhugol ke siddhant (1940).

questions.q: Concept of Spatial Organization was presented by / स्थानिक संगठन की संकल्पना प्रस्तावित की है-
questions.exp: Sthaniya sangathan ki sankalpana German school dwara prastavit ki gayi. Kshetreey bhinnata ya sthaniya upagam bhaugolik adhyayan ki ek pramukh upagam hai. Unneesvi shatabdi ke antim dashak (1898 ee.) me Richthofen ne apne ek lekh me kshetreey bhinnata ki sankalpana prastut ki; unhone bhugol ko 'prithvi ke kshetron ka adhyayan' kaha. Hettner ne German bhasha me prakashit apne lekhon ke maadhyam se kshetreey bhinnata ke spashtikaran ko hi bhugol ka mukhya uddeshya bataya.

questions.q: Which medieval geographer extensively improved Ptolemy's works? / किस मध्ययुगीन भूगोलवेत्ता ने टॉलमी के कार्यों में व्यापक सुधार किया था?
questions.exp: Al-Idrisi naamak madhyayugin (Arab) bhugolvetta ne Ptolemy ke kaaryon me vyapak sudhaar kiye the. Al-Idrisi dwara taiyaar kiya gaya vishwa maanchitra bhugol jagat ke liye unki vishisht den hai. Unhone Ptolemy ki rachnaon ka gambhirata se adhyayan kiya tha aur usse bahut adhik prabhavit the. Unhone us samay gyaat kshetron ke liye chhote-chhote maanchitron ka nirmaan kiya tha. Arab saagar aur Caspian saagar ki sahi sthiti pehli baar Al-Idrisi ke maanchitra me pradarshit ki gayi thi.

questions.q: Who among the following is known as father of modern geography? / निम्न में से कौन आधुनिक भूगोल के पिता के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.exp: Bhaugolik chintan ke itihaaskaar ekmat se Humboldt ko aadhunik bhugol ka sansthapak maante hain. Humboldt ne ek vaigyanik vishay ke roop me bhugol ko sansthapit karne ka atyant mahatvapurn aur agraniya kaarya kiya tha. Unhone bhugol ki kai sankalpanaon ka pratipadan kiya tha. Humboldt ki pramukh rachnaein: 1. Rhineland basalt 2. Geognosy 3. naye mahadweep ke bhoomadhya rekheey pradesh ki yatra 4. madhya Asia 5. Mexico aur Cuba ka pradeshik bhugol 6. Kosmos – yah Humboldt ki sarvadhik mahatvapurn pustak hai jo 1845 ee. se 1862 ee. ke madhya paanch khandon me prakashit hui.

questions.q: Which among the following groups represents possibilism? / निम्न में से कौन सा समूह संभववाद को निरूपित करता है?
o: Blache, Brunhes, Sauer / ब्लाश, ब्रून्श, सॉवर
questions.exp: Sambhavvaad beesvi shatabdi ke poorvaardh me viksit Francisi vichardhara hai, jo maanav paryavaran sambandh (antahkriya) ki vyakhya me maanav prayatnon tatha kriyaon ko adhik mahatva deti hai. Vidal de la Blache ko sambhavvaad ka pratipadan maana jaata hai. Francisi vidwan Lucien Febvre ne 'sambhavvaad' (possibilism) shabd ka sarvapratham (1922 ee.) prayog kiya. Febvre ne sambhavvaad ki vistrit vyakhya apni pustak 'Itihaas ki Bhaugolik Bhoomika' me ki. Febvre mahoday ne sambhavvaad ko spasht karte hue likha ki 'kahin bhi anivaaryataein nahi hain balki sarvatra sambhavnaein vidyamaan hain aur manushya in sambhavnaon ke swami ke roop me unke prayog ka nirnaayak hai.' Pramukh samarthak: Blache, Febvre, Carl Sauer, Isaiah Bowman aadi.

questions.q: The principle in which the effect of natural environment on humans is considered paramount / वह सिद्धांत जिसमें प्राकृतिक पर्यावरण का मानव के ऊपर प्रभाव को सर्वोपरि माना गया है
questions.exp: Niyativaad moolatah unneesvi sadi ke uttaraardh me viksit ek German bhaugolik vichardhara hai jo maanav-prakriti antahkriya ki vyakhya prakriti (paryavaran) ko sarvashaktimaan aur samast maanav vyavahar tatha maanviya kriyaon ki niyantrak maankar karti hai. Is vichardhara ke anusaar manushya prakriti ki vishisht den hai aur samast maanviya kriyaein prakritik paryavaran dwara niyantrit hoti hain. Niyativaadi vichardhara ke anusaar prakritik dashaein manushyon ke shaareerik gathan evam rang roop se lekar unke bhojan, vastra, aashray aadi prathamik aavashyaktaein, vibhinn vyavsaay, samaj, sanskriti aadi ka nirdharan bhi karti hai. Pramukh samarthak: Kant, Humboldt, Ritter, Ratzel, Semple tatha Huntington.

questions.q: Who among the following is known as the founder of Modern Human Geography? / निम्न में से किसे आधुनिक मानव भूगोल के संस्थापक के रूप में जाना जाता है?
o: Carl O Sauer / कार्ल ओ सॉवर
questions.exp: German bhugolvetta Friedrich Ratzel ko aadhunik maanav bhugol ke sansthapak ke roop me jaana jaata hai. Friedrich Ratzel (1844–1904 ee.) Humboldt aur Ritter ke pashchat aadhunik yug ke teesre pramukh bhugolvetta the. Ratzel pratham bhugolvetta the jinhone maanav bhugol ko prithak vigyan ke roop me sthapit karane ka agraniya kaarya kiya tha. Unhone maanav bhugol ko ek prithak vigyan ke roop me sthapit kiya. Isiliye Ratzel ko 'maanav bhugol ka janak' kaha jaata hai. Pramukh rachnaein: 1. bhoomadhya saagariya tat ke jeev 2. maanav bhugol pratham khand (1882 ee.) tatha dwitiya khand (1891 ee.) 3. rajnitik bhugol 4. Germany ka pradeshik bhugol 5. prithvi aur jeevan.

questions.q: The study of 'who gets what, where and how is' / कौन कहाँ, क्या, कैसे प्राप्त करता है, का अध्ययन है-
questions.exp: Kalyanparak bhugol ka vah upagam jo samaj me vyaapt asamanata se sambandhit prashnon (questions of inequality) par bal deta hai. Kalyanparak upagam ka aarambh 1970 ee. ke dashak me hua tha. Is upagam ke antargat vikas aur pragati ke sankuchit aarthik aadhar se aage badhkar jeevan ki gunavatta par dhyan kendrit kiya jaane laga. 1980 ee. ke dashak me American bhugolvetta Smith (D.M. Smith) ne maanav bhugol me kalyanparak upagam ko prayog tatha mahatva ko pratishthit kiya. The basic focus of the welfare approach is on who gets what, where and how.

questions.q: "There are no necessities, but everywhere possibilities." Credit is given to this statement / 'कोई अनिवार्यताएँ नहीं है, परन्तु प्रत्येक स्थान पर संभावनाएँ ही है।' इस कथन हेतु श्रेय दिया जाता है-
questions.exp: 'Koi anivaaryataein nahi hain, parantu pratyek sthan par sambhavnaein hi hain.' Is kathan ka shrey Febvre ko diya jaata hai. Lucien Febvre P. Vidal de la Blache ke hi shishya the tatha unhone san 1924 ee. me apni pustak (Geographical Introduction to History) me sarvapratham Blache ke maanav pradhan vichardhara ko aage badhaya tatha thos roop pradaan kiya. Atah sambhavvaad evam sambhavna jaise shabdon ka sarvapratham prayog Febvre ne hi kiya tha.

questions.q: Which of the following 'Puranic Dwipa' (Mythological islands) belongs to the continent of Australia? / निम्न पौराणिक द्वीपों में से कौन सा एक ऑस्ट्रेलिया महाद्वीप से सम्बन्धित है?
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (b): Pauranik dweepon me Shaak dweep Australia mahadweep se sambandhit hai. Shaak dweep me dakshin-poorvi Asia tatha poorvi dweep samooh (East Indies) bhi; yah ushna evam aardra jalvayu ka kshetra hai tatha van kshetra se aavrit hai. Note: puraanon me samast prithvi sataha ko saat bhookhandon (land masses) me vibhakt bataya gaya hai: (i) Jambu dweep (ii) Pushkar dweep (iii) Shaak dweep (iv) Shalmali dweep (v) Kush dweep (vi) Plaksh dweep (vii) Kraunch dweep.

questions.q: Which one from the following was the largest volcanic eruption in the 20th century? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विश्व में 20वीं शताब्दी का सबसे बड़ा ज्वालामुखी उद्भेदन रहा है?
o: Mount St. Helens / माउण्ट सेन्ट हेलेन्स
questions.exp: 20vi shatabdi ka sabse bada jwalamukhi udbhedan 1912 ee. me Alaska prayadweep ke Novarupta me hua tha. 6 June ko shuru hone wale 60 ghanton ke dauraan anumanit roop se 15 ghan km magma visfot karke roop me fat gaya tha jo Kilauea (Hawaii) me 230 varshon ke visfot ke baraabar hai. 1980 me Mount St. Helens (Washington) dwara visfot magma ka lagbhag 30 guna hai. Visfot ke door sthan hone ke kaaran vaigyanikon ne 1918 ee. tak site ka daura nahi kiya; unhone us ghaati ko 'das hazaar dhoomrapanon ki ghaati' kaha.

questions.q: Which one of the following statements is NOT an evidence proposed by Wegner? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन वेगनर द्वारा प्रस्तुत प्रमाण नहीं है?
o: Jig-Saw-fit setting of continents / महाद्वीपों की जिग-सॉ-फिट सेटिंग
Extinction of lemmings / लेमिंग जीवों का विलुप्त होना
questions.exp: German mausamvid Alfred Wegener ne san 1912 ee. me mahadweepiya pravaah siddhant ka pratipadan kiya tatha bataya ki vartamaan mahadweepon ko milakar bhaugolik ekroopta di ja sakti hai, jise unhone saamya sthapan (jig-saw-fit) kaha. Carboniferous yug me sabhi sthalkhand aapas me jude hue the. Is sthalpind ko unhone 'Pangaea' ki sangya se abhihit kiya tatha uske chaaron or ek mahasagar ka vistaar tha jise unhone 'Panthalassa' kaha. Wegener ne pramaan prastut kiye: 1. Atlantic ke dono taton par bhaugolik ekroopta; 2. Atlantic ke dono taton par chattanon me paaye jaane wale jeevashm (fossil) evam vanaspatiyon ke avsheshon me paryaapt samanata; 3. Scandinavia ke uttari bhaag me paaye jaane wale lemming naamak chhote-chhote jantu adhik sankhya me paschim ki or bhaagte hain parantu aage sthal na milne ke kaaran samudra me jalamagn ho jaate hain; isse yah pramaanit hota hai ki ateetkaal me jab sthalkhand ek me mile the. Atah lemming jeevon ka vilupt hona Wegener ke mahadweepiya pravaah siddhant ka pramaan nahi hai.

questions.q: The minor plate "Caroline plate" lies between / छोटी प्लेट "कैरोलिन प्लेट" ___ के बीच स्थित है।
o: Antarctic and Pacific plate / अंटार्कटिक और प्रशांत महासागरीय प्लेट
Philippine and Indian plate / फिलिपीन व इंडियन प्लेट
South America and Pacific plate / दक्षिण अमेरिका व प्रशांत महासागरीय प्लेट
Central America and Pacific Plate / मध्यवर्ती अमेरिका और प्रशांत महासागरीय प्लेट
questions.exp: Book ka uttar (b): chhoti plate 'Caroline plate' Philippine va Indian plate ke beech sthit hai. (Dhyan do: aam taur par Caroline plate ko Philippine aur Prashant plate ke beech maana jaata hai.) Anya pramukh chhoti plate: Prashant mahasagariya plate – iska vistaar Alaska se Antarctic plate tak Prashant mahasagar ke nital par hai; Arabian plate – iska adhikansh Arab prayadweep ka bhoo-bhaag; Indo-Australian-New Zealand plate – Bharat tatha Australian dono upmahadweep sammilit; Nazca plate – dakshin America va Prashant mahasagariya plate ke beech; Cocos plate – madhya America aur Prashant mahasagariya plate ke beech.

questions.q: Find out the incorrect sentence from the followings / निम्नलिखित में से असत्य कथन छाँटिये
o: The release of energy, causing an earthquake, usually occurs along a fault / भूकम्प उत्पन्न कारक ऊर्जा प्रायः भ्रंश के किनारे ही निकलती है
Epicentre is the nearest point on the surface, to the focus / अधिकेन्द्र भूतल पर उद्गम केन्द्र के समीपतम बिन्दु होता है
All natural earthquakes take place in the Asthenosphere / सभी प्राकृतिक भूकम्प दुर्बलमंडल में आते हैं
The focus of an earthquake is also called as Hypocenter / भूकम्प का उद्गम केन्द्र अवकेन्द्र भी कहलाता है
questions.exp: Sabhi prakritik bhookamp durbalmandal me aate hain, yah kathan asatya hai (adhikansh bhookamp sthalmandal me aate hain). Bhookamp bhoopatal ki kampan athva lehar hai jo dharatal ke neeche ya oopar chattanon ke lacheelepan ya gurutvakarshan ki samsthiti me kshanik avyavastha hone par utpann hota hai. Vigyan ki vah shaakha jisme bhookampiya lehron ka seismograph yantra dwara ankan karke adhyayan kiya jaata hai, bhookamp vigyan kehlaata hai. Jis jagah se bhookamp ka kampan praarambh hota hai, use bhookamp mool (focus) kehte hain. Jahan par sabse pehle bhookampiya lehron ka anubhav kiya jaata hai, use bhookamp kendra (epicentre) kehte hain.

questions.q: Which one of the followings has slowest rate of movement? / निम्नलिखित में से किसकी गति न्यूनतम है?
o: East Pacific rise / पूर्वी प्रशान्त महासागरीय उभार
questions.exp: Saamanya va utkraman chumbakeey kshetra ki pattiyon jo madhya-mahasagariya katak ke samanantar hain, plate pravaah ki dar samajhne me vaigyanikon ke liye sahayak siddh hui hain. Pravaah ki dar bhi bahut bhinn hai. Arctic katak ki pravaah dar sabse kam hai (2.5 cm prati varsh se bhi kam). Easter dweep ke nikat dakshin Prashant mahasagar me poorvi Prashant ubhaar, jo ki Chile se 3,400 km paschim ki or dakshin Prashant mahasagar me hai, iski pravaah dar sarvadhik (jo 5 cm prati varsh se bhi adhik) hai.

questions.q: Which of the followings is NOT an example of Divergent Boundaries? / अपसारी सीमा का एक उदाहरण नहीं है-
o: Boundary between Indian and Antarctic plates / इंडियन प्लेट एवं अंटार्कटिक प्लेटों के बीच की सीमा
Boundary between Nazca and Pacific plates / नजका एवं प्रशांत महासागरीय प्लेटों के बीच की सीमा
Boundary between Pacific plate and philippine plate / प्रशांत महासागरीय प्लेट एवं फिलिपीन प्लेट के बीच की सीमा
questions.exp: Rachnatmak plate kinaron ko apsaari plate seema ya sanrachi plate seema bhi kehte hain. Plate ke seemant bhaag ko plate kinara kehte hain, jabki do plateon ke madhya sanchalan seema ko plate seema kehte hain. Rachnatmak seema apsaari mandal ko pradarshit karti hai, jahan par lava ka nirantar oopar ki taraf apvah hota rehta hai. Mahasagariya plateon ka madhya mahasagariya katak ke sahare algaav hota hai tatha vilom hue plate vipreet dishaon me gatisheel hote hain. Apsaari seema ke udaharan: Indian plate evam Antarctic plate ke beech ki seema; Nazca evam Prashant mahasagariya plate ke beech ki seema; madhya Atlantic katak. Note: Prashant mahasagariya plate evam Philippine plate ke beech ki seema apsaari seema ka udaharan nahi hai.

questions.q: Find out the incorrect sentence from the followings / निम्नलिखित में से असत्य कथन छाँटिये-
o: Tectonic earthquakes originate due to sliding of rocks along a fault plane / चट्टानों में भ्रंशतल के सहारे खिसकने के कारण विवर्तनिक भूकम्प उत्पन्न होते हैं
The body waves generate surface waves / काय तरंगें धरातलीय तरंगों को उत्पन्न करती हैं
P-waves vibrate parallel to the direction / P तरंगें, तरंग दिशा के समानांतर कम्पन करती हैं
S-waves are similar to sound waves / S तरंगें ध्वनि तरंगों जैसी होती हैं
questions.exp: 'S' tarangein dwitiyak athva jal tarangein evam prakaash tarangon ke samaan hoti hain, jinme kanon ki gati lehar ki disha ke samkon par hoti hai. Isi kaaran inhe aadi lehrein bhi kehte hain. Sankshep me inhe 'S' lehar kehte hain, jo ki taral bhaag me praayah lupt ho jaati hain. Atah ye tarangein keval thos padarthon ke hi maadhyam se chalti hain. 'P' tarangein teevra gati se chalne wali tarangein hain jo dharatal par sabse pehle pahunchti hain; inhe prathamik athva anudairghya tarangein kaha jaata hai. 'L' tarangein adhikendra par sabse baad me pahunchti hain kyunki inki gati sabse kam hoti hai; inka prabhaav jal evam thal dono par hota hai; ye tarangein sarvadhik vinashkaari hoti hain. (P lehrein dhvani tarangon jaisi hoti hain.)

questions.q: Exfoliation is mainly a type of ___ weathering / अपशल्कन मुख्यतः ___ अपक्षय का एक प्रकार है-
questions.exp: Apashalkan mukhyatah bhautik apakshay ka ek prakaar hai. Vegvaan vayu ke sampark me aa jaane se dheeli parten chattanon se alag hoti rehti hain. Is prakaar chattan kramashah dheere-dheere nagn hoti jaati hain. Yah kriya usi prakaar ghatit hoti hai, jaise ki fal se chhilka utaara jaata hai. Yah prakriya itni mand gati se hoti hai ki iska avlokan nahi ho paata hai. Paraton ke is prakaar ukhadne ka falswaroop oopar uthi chattanon, chhoti-chhoti pahadiyan gol ho jaati hain. Ranchi shahar ke paas kanke gumbad apashalkan apakshay ka sundar udaharan prastut karta hai. Ise 'onion apakshay' bhi kaha jaata hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an example of young fold mountain? / निम्न में से कौन सा नवीन वलित पर्वत का उदाहरण नहीं है?
questions.exp: Caledonian parvatikaran ki kriya Palaeozoic yug ke vibhinn yugon me sampann hui tatha iska nirmaan Silurian–Devonian tatha Permian yug me sampann hua. Is parvat nirmaan ghatna ke samay uttari America ka Appalachian, Europe me Scotland ke parvat tatha Bharat ke Aravali, Mahadeo tatha Satpura parvaton ka srijan hua. Vartamaan samay me inka vaastavik roop nahi milta. Jabki Himalaya, Andes, Rocky, Alps, Pyrenees, Apennine aadi naveen valit parvaton ka nirmaan Alpine parvatikaran ke falswaroop hua.

questions.q: Which one of the following is a fault mountain? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भ्रंशोत्थ पर्वत है?
questions.exp: Kshaitij sanchalan ke dwara tanaav moolak bal ke kaaran jab do bhranshon ke beech ka bhaag yathavat rehe evam kinaare ke bhaag neeche dhans jaaein, to oonche uthe bhaag ko bhranshotth parvat kehte hain. Inka dhaal ekdam khada aur shikhar samtal hota hai. Jaise – Europe me Vosges aur Black Forest, Pakistan me Salt Range, California me Sierra Nevada aadi bhranshotth parvat ke udaharan hain. Note: vishwa ka sarvadhik vistrit block parvat Sierra Nevada (USA) hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a volcanic mountain? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ज्वालामुखी पर्वत नहीं है?
o: Mt. Sierra Nevada / माउण्ट सियारा नेवादा
questions.exp: California ka Sierra Nevada parvat vishwa ke sabse adhik vistrit block parvat hai. Iski lambai 643 km, chaudai 80 km evam oonchai 3657 m hai. Europe mahadweep me Vosges tatha Black Forest evam Pakistan me 'Salt Range' block parvat ke pramukh udaharan hain. Jwalamukhi parvat ke pramukh udaharan: 1. Mount Kilimanjaro (Tanzania) 2. Mount Fujiyama (Japan) 3. Vesuvius (Italy) 4. Aconcagua (Chile) 5. Cotopaxi (Ecuador) 6. Mount Mayon (Philippines).

questions.q: The name of the waterfall, which is located on the borders of Zambia and Zimbabwe is / जाम्बिया और जिम्बाब्वे की सीमाओं के सहारे स्थित जलप्रपात का नाम है-
questions.exp: Victoria jal prapat dakshin-madhya Africa me Zambia aur Zimbabwe ki seema par Zambezi nadi par sthit hai. Ise varsh 1989 me vishwa viraasat suchi me bhi sammilit kar liya gaya hai. Jalprapat (water falls) – jab nadiyon ka jal oonchai se khade dhaal se atyadhik veg se neeche ki or girta hai to use jalprapat kehte hain. Iska nirmaan chattanon ki sanrachna me vishamata, asamaan apardan, bhookhand me utthaan, bhransh kagaron aadi ke kaaran hota hai. Vishwa ke anya jal prapat: Angel prapat – Venezuela (979 m); Tugela prapat – dakshin Africa (948 m); Ribbon prapat – California (491 m); Niagara prapat – USA tatha Canada (55 m).

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an example of zonal soil? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कटिबंधीय मृदा का उदाहरण नहीं है?
questions.exp: Jalod mrida katibandheey mrida ka udaharan nahi hai; yah ajonal ya apradeshik mrida ka udaharan hai. Katibandheey mrida (zonal soil) ke antargat un mittiyon ko sammilit kiya gaya hai jinka nirmaan suvaahit (well drained) dashaon me hua hai. Inke parichhedik mrida ko poornata viksit evam praudh mrida kaha jaata hai. In mittiyon ka nirmaan deerghkaal tak ek sthan vishesh ki vanaspati tatha jalvayu ke beech paaraspaarik kriyaon ke falswaroop hota hai. Is mandaliya mrida shreni ke antargat 6 upshreniyon (suborders) tatha 21 vrihat mrida vargon (great soil groups) ka nirdharan kiya gaya hai; inke udaharan hain – prairie mrida, laterite mrida, tundra mrida, chernozem, podzol mrida aadi.

questions.q: The landmarks "valley sinks" are associated with / "घाटी रंध्र" स्थलाकृतियाँ सम्बन्धित हैं
questions.exp: 'Ghaati randhra' sthalakritiyan bhoomigat jal se sambandhit hain. Varsha-jal ka vah ansh jo bhoomi ke dwara sokh liya jaata hai, bhoomigat jal kehlaata hai. Bhoomigat jal se bani sthalakritiyon ko karst sthalakritiyan kehte hain, jo ki poorvi Yugoslavia ke Adriatic tat ke choona-patthar kshetra ke sthalakritiyon ke naam ke aadhar par rakha gaya hai.

questions.q: Cirque is also known as / सर्क नाम से भी जाना जाता है-
questions.exp: Cirque himnad ki ghaati ke sheersh bhaag par ek ardhvrittakaar ya katore ke aakaar ka vishaal gahra garta hota hai, jiska paarsh ya kinara khada (lambvat) hota hai. Dekhne par cirque ardhgolakar rangmanch (amphitheatre) ke samaan lagte hain. Cirque ka aakaar neeche ki or aaraamkursi ke samaan dikhta hai. Isi kaaran ise 'himgahvar' ya 'himgarta' bhi kehte hain. Cirque ko vibhinn sthanon par alag-alag naamon se bhi jaana jaata hai. Jaise – Corrie, Kar (German), CWM (Wales), Scandinavia me Botn evam Jedal ityadi.

questions.q: In high latitudes, very deep glacial troughs filled with sea water and making up shorelines, are known as / उच्च अक्षांशों में गहरी हिमनद गर्तें, जिनमें समुद्री जल भर जाता है तथा जो समुद्री तटरेखा निर्मित करते हैं, ___ कहलाते हैं।
questions.exp: Ucch akshanshon me gahri himnad garten, jinme samudri jal bhar jaata hai tatha jo samudri tatrekha nirmit karte hain fiord kehlaate hain. Fiord ek prakaar ka tat tatha kinara hota hai. Fiord dono golardhon me milte hain, parantu ye mukhya roop se New Zealand, Chile, Alaska, British Columbia, Labrador, Greenland, Norway aadi me adhiktar milte hain. Fiord himnad dwara saagariya bhaag me ghus jaati hai jinki deewal khade dhaal wali hoti hai. Fiord ke mukh ke paas (sthal ke or) adhik gahra hota hai tatha saagar ki or kuch door jaane par uthla ho jaata hai.

questions.q: The Glacial control theory was propounded by ___ / हिमानी नियंत्रण सिद्धान्त का प्रतिपादन ___ ने किया।
o: Hall and Dana / हॉल एवं डाना
questions.exp: Himani niyantran siddhant ka pratipadan Daly mahoday dwara kiya gaya tha. Daly mahoday ne apne is siddhant ka pratipadan 1915 ee. me us samay kiya tha, jab unko yah vishwas ho gaya ki saagaron me praval bhittiyon ka nirmaan Pleistocene himkaal se sambandhit hai. Pleistocene himkaal ke samay saagariya jal ke him me badal jaane ke kaaran saagar tal me 33 se 38 fathom tak ka avtalan (lowering) ho gaya. Saagariya jal ke taapmaan me avtalan ke kaaran jo bhi praval the, ve mar gaye. Saagar tal me avtalan ke kaaran mahadweepiya taton evam dweepon ke sahare apradit chabootre tatha sopanon ka nirmaan hua. Himkaal ke avsaan ke baad him ke jal me parinat ho jaane ke kaaran saagar tal punah 33 se 38 fathom tak oopar uth gaya.

questions.q: The discontinuity, lying between upper core and lower core of the earth, is known as / पृथ्वी के ऊपरी कोर एवं निचले कोर के मध्य अवस्थित असम्बद्धता कहलाती है-
questions.exp: Prithvi ke oopari kor evam nichle kor ke madhya avasthit asambaddhta Lehmann asambaddhta kehlaati hai. Prithvi ke aantarik bhaag me paaye jaane wale asambaddhtaein: 1. Conrad asambaddhta – oopari crust evam nichli crust ke madhya; 2. Mohorovicic asambaddhta – nichli crust evam oopari mantle ke madhya; 3. Repetti asambaddhta – oopari mantle evam nichli mantle ke madhya; 4. Gutenberg asambaddhta – nichli mantle evam baahya kor ke madhya; 5. Lehmann asambaddhta – baahya evam aantarik kor (antartam) ke madhya.

questions.q: Narrow fingerlike embankment of sand constructed by littoral drift and connected by main land, into the open water or bay is known as / तटीय प्रवाह के द्वारा खुले जल या खाड़ी में बनाया जाने वाला सँकरा, उंगलीनुमा बालुका तटबंध जिसका एक सिरा मुख्य भूमि से जुड़ा होता है, कहलाता है-
questions.exp: Tateey pravah ke dwara khule jal ya khaadi me banaya jaane wala sankara, ungleenuma baaluka tatbandh jiska ek sira mukhya bhoomi se juda hota hai, spit kehlaata hai. Jab saagariya malbe ka nikshep is tarah hota hai ki rodhika ka ek roop me jal ki or nikla hota hai to use spit ya bhujika kehte hain. Spit ka ek bhaag tat ke sheershsthal se sanlagn rehta hai tatha doosra saagar ki or nikla tatha khula rehta hai. Bharat ke poorvi tatha paschimi tateey bhaagon me kai spit ka vikas hua hai; yatha – Odisha tat par Chilka jheel ke mukh me 50 km lambi spit, Kalingapatnam ke paas 16 km lambi spit, Kakinada khaadi ke poorv me 12 km lambi spit, Pulicat jheel ke poorv me 60 km lambi spit, Kochi ke paas Vembanad jheel me viksit 22 evam 25 km lambi spit mahatvapurn hain.

questions.q: Find out the correct statement about Seif. / सीफ के सन्दर्भ में सही कथन छाँटिये-
o: Seif are Parabolic dunes / सीफ परवलयिक बालुका स्तूप होते हैं
Seif has only one wing / सीफ केवल एक भुजा वाले बालुका स्तूप हैं
Seif and Barchans are same dunes / सीफ और बरखानसमान बालुका स्तूप हैं
Seif are aligned perpendicular to wind direction / सीफ प्रचलित पवनों की दिशा के समकोण पर बनते हैं
questions.exp: Seif keval ek bhuja wale baaluka stoop hote hain. Seif pawan ki disha me uske samanantar nirmit lambe-lambe stoopon ko kehte hain. Inhe pawananuvartee ya anudairghya stoop kaha jaata hai. Stoopon ka pawanavartee dhaal (windward slope) mand tatha pawanavimukhi dhaal (leeward slope) teevra hota hai. Saamanya roop me ye stoop aantarik marusthaleey bhaagon me nirmit hote hain. Australia, Libya tatha Sahara ke marusthalon me in stoopon ke anek udaharan milte hain. Is tarah ke stoop ko rekhiya stoop (linear dune), ret katak (sand ridge), seif, alab stoop (alab dunes) aadi naamon se bhi jaana jaata hai.
